sourcePolicy.name: Lexifold TOEIC word list
sourcePolicy.attribution: Lexifold TOEIC word list; adapted from NGSL 1.2, TSL 1.2 and NAWL 1.2 by Browne, Culligan and Phillips.
sourcePolicy.note: Lexifold publishes headwords, levels, order and source information. Meanings, examples, translations and audio are not included in the TSV.

example.en: We will have an important staff meeting in the main conference room at two o'clock.
example.zh: 我們將於下午兩點在主會議室召開一場重要的全體員工會議。

words.mnemonic: 基礎商務動詞，常與 meeting (開會)、experience (具備經驗) 搭配。

example.en: Our marketing team will do everything possible to meet the project deadline.
example.zh: 我們的行銷團隊將竭盡全力在專案截止日前完成。

words.mnemonic: 職場行動必備動詞，常搭配 business (洽商) 或 research (做市調)。

example.en: The financial director said that our quarterly revenue increased significantly.
example.zh: 財務總監表示我們本季度的營收顯著成長。

words.mnemonic: 轉述發言或主管報告重點的關鍵動詞，常接 that 子句。

example.en: The regional sales manager will go to Chicago on business next Monday.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理將於下週一前往芝加哥出差。

words.mnemonic: 出差與行程常客，go on business 意指公務出差。

example.en: All employees must wear their identification badges inside the building.
example.zh: 所有員工在大樓內部皆必須配戴身分識別證。

words.mnemonic: 多益公告常見字，搭配複數名詞指全員，如 all staff 或 all employees。

example.en: Ms. Clark is one of the most qualified candidates for the managerial opening.
example.zh: 克拉克女士是該主管職缺中最具資格的應徵者之一。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀與聽力極高頻句型：one of the + 複數名詞 (其中之一)。

example.en: The department head answered several questions about the proposed annual budget.
example.zh: 部門主管回答了數個關於擬定之年度預算的問題。

words.mnemonic: 會議討論主題必備介系詞，或用於數字前表示約略數額。

example.en: Please let us know if you need to modify your flight reservation.
example.zh: 若您需要修改航班預訂，請儘速告知我們。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信最標準客套句型：Please let me know / let us know。

example.en: For more information regarding the product launch, please contact our support center.
example.zh: 如需更多有關產品發布的資訊，請聯絡我們的客服支援中心。

words.mnemonic: 公告、廣告文宣末尾固定句型：For more information (如需更多資訊)。

example.en: Customers who place an order before noon will get a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 中午前下單的顧客將可享有九折優惠。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業情境指取得核准 (get approval) 或享有折扣 (get a discount)。

example.en: Our courier service offers premium options like overnight delivery and signature confirmation.
example.zh: 我們的快遞服務提供諸如隔夜送達與簽收確認等尊榮選項。

words.mnemonic: 舉例說明服務或產品特色常用的介系詞，意為如同、例如。

example.en: The board members think that opening a branch in Tokyo will boost international sales.
example.zh: 董事會成員認為在東京設立分公司將有助於推動國際銷售。

words.mnemonic: 會議中表達商業看法或評估方案的核心動詞。

example.en: You can make a hotel reservation directly through our corporate travel portal.
example.zh: 您可以直接透過我們的企業差旅平台預訂飯店。

words.mnemonic: 高頻搭配動詞：make a reservation (預約)、make a decision (做決策)。

example.en: The flight from London arrived on time despite unfavorable weather conditions.
example.zh: 儘管天候不佳，自倫敦起飛的班機仍準時抵達。

words.mnemonic: 交通與會議考點：on time (準時)、in time (及時)。

example.en: Please see the attached PDF for a detailed overview of the conference schedule.
example.zh: 請查閱附件 PDF 以取得會議時程的詳細概述。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信高頻句型：Please see the attached document (請參閱附件)。

example.en: Our total online revenue was up fifteen percent in the second quarter.
example.zh: 我們第二季度的線上總營收成長了百分之十五。

words.mnemonic: 財報與業績常用 up 表增長，亦常搭配 set up (架設) 或 sign up (報名)。

example.en: We need to order some replacement toner cartridges for the office printers.
example.zh: 我們需要為辦公室印表機訂購一些備用碳粉匣。

words.mnemonic: 採購與庫存對話中常用的數量限定詞，指某些或若干用品。

example.en: The manager spoke with two other applicants before reaching a final hiring decision.
example.zh: 經理在做出最終錄取決定之前，與另外兩位應徵者進行了晤談。

words.mnemonic: 商務對比或篩選人選常用的形容詞，常與 applicants 或 options 搭配。

example.en: The popular office chair is temporarily out of stock due to high customer demand.
example.zh: 由於顧客需求量大，這款熱門辦公椅目前暫時缺貨。

words.mnemonic: 多益商務必考片語：out of stock (缺貨)、out of office (休假/不在辦公室)。

example.en: Maintaining good communication with our suppliers is vital for supply chain stability.
example.zh: 與供應商保持良好溝通對於供應鏈的穩定至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 評價服務品質或產品狀況常用的基礎形容詞。

example.en: Our human resources division seeks creative people with solid analytical skills.
example.zh: 我們的人力資源部門正在尋找具備扎實分析能力的創新型人才。

words.mnemonic: 代表全體同仁或求職者的人才稱呼，商務中指具備專業能力的人才。

example.en: The corporate profit margin improved considerably over the past fiscal year.
example.zh: 在過去這一個會計年度中，企業的利潤率有了顯著提升。

words.mnemonic: 財務報表與績效回顧核心詞：fiscal year 代表會計年度。

example.en: Management must take immediate action to address workplace safety concerns.
example.zh: 管理層必須立即採取行動以解決職場安全疑慮。

words.mnemonic: 多益常考搭配：take action (採取行動)、take advantage of (善用)。

example.en: The product presentation went very well and received enthusiastic applause from investors.
example.zh: 產品發表會進行得非常順利，並獲得投資人熱烈的掌聲。

words.mnemonic: 評估專案或表現常用的副詞，片語 as well as (以及) 多益極常見。

example.en: The express shipment arrived late because the transport flight was grounded by fog.
example.zh: 快捷貨件延遲送達，是因為運輸班機受到濃霧影響而停飛。

words.mnemonic: 說明業務延誤、退貨或取消原因的標準連接詞。

example.en: The corporate client was very satisfied with our comprehensive technical support.
example.zh: 該企業客戶對我們全面的技術支援服務感到非常滿意。

words.mnemonic: 加強形容詞語氣的程度副詞，常用於客戶滿意度調查。

example.en: The keynote speaker just finished setting up the projector for the presentation.
example.zh: 主講嘉賓剛剛為簡報架設好了投影機。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 1/2 常考時態提示詞，表剛剛完成或正好及時 (just in time)。

example.en: Every brand new commercial copier comes with an all-inclusive two-year warranty.
example.zh: 每台全新商用影印機皆附帶為期兩年的全包式保固。

words.mnemonic: 產品規格與購買條件必備句型：come with (隨附/附帶)。

example.en: He will work closely with the design team to develop our new brand logo.
example.zh: 他將與設計團隊緊密合作以開發我們的新品牌商標。

words.mnemonic: 職場核心動詞，搭配 work on (致力於)、work closely with (密切合作)。

example.en: Authorized technicians must use protective gear when operating the heavy machinery.
example.zh: 合格技術人員在操作重型機具時必須穿戴防護裝備。

words.mnemonic: 操作設備與落實政策常見動詞，片語 make use of 意為善加利用。

example.en: Early bird tickets for the international trade summit are now available online.
example.zh: 國際貿易峰會的早鳥票現在已可於線上購買。

words.mnemonic: 活動公告高頻副詞，提示當前狀態或促銷開放時機。

example.en: Please enter your employee credentials and then click the verification button.
example.zh: 請輸入您的員工憑證，然後點擊驗證按鈕。

words.mnemonic: 工作流程步驟指南（SOP）中標示前後順序的連接詞。

example.en: The corporate retreat package covers lodging and also includes complimentary meals.
example.zh: 企業研討營套裝方案涵蓋住宿，並且包含免費餐點。

words.mnemonic: 合約與宣傳文案補充福利常用的副詞，常配合 not only... but also。

example.en: The software enterprise plans to expand into emerging Southeast Asian markets.
example.zh: 這家軟體企業計劃拓展進入新興的東南亞市場。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業擴張考點：expand into (打入市場) 或 look into (調查)。

example.en: This special corporate parking rate is available only to permanent staff members.
example.zh: 此專案企業停車優惠僅提供給正職員工。

words.mnemonic: 規章政策限制條款的核心限定詞，強調專屬性或限制範圍。

example.en: Our hiring managers are looking for candidates who demonstrate strong leadership.
example.zh: 我們的招募經理正在尋找展現出卓越領導力的應徵者。

words.mnemonic: 求職與徵才極高頻片語：look for (尋找)、look forward to (期盼)。

example.en: If you want to update your delivery address, please contact customer support immediately.
example.zh: 若您想要更新配送地址，請立即與客服中心聯繫。

words.mnemonic: 顧客服務信函常用句型：want to do something (想要做某事)。

example.en: The vice president will give an opening speech at the regional sales conference.
example.zh: 副總裁將在區域銷售會議上發表開幕致詞。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 高頻搭配：give a presentation / give a speech (演講/簡報)。

example.en: First quarter earnings reports revealed a ten percent increase in net operating profit.
example.zh: 第一季財報顯示營業淨利成長了百分之十。

words.mnemonic: 季度財報專用語：first quarter 指第一季 (Q1)。

example.en: The human resources department scheduled an orientation session for all new employees.
example.zh: 人力資源部門為所有新進員工安排了一場到職培訓說明會。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場聽力主角：new employee (新員工)、new product (新產品)。

example.en: Implementing electronic billing is an efficient way to reduce paper waste.
example.zh: 導入電子帳單是減少紙張浪費的一種有效途徑。

words.mnemonic: 商務提案必備詞彙：an efficient way to do something (做某事的有效方式)。

example.en: You can find all previous project archives stored in the shared cloud folder.
example.zh: 您可以在共享雲端資料夾中找到所有過往的專案存檔。

words.mnemonic: 商務對話與辦公指引常用詞，片語 find out 意為查明真相或獲得訊息。

example.en: Our overseas export volume has grown significantly over the past three years.
example.zh: 在過去這三年期間，我們的海外出口量有了大幅增長。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：over the past + 時間 (在過去...期間)，需搭配現在完成式。

example.en: Please do not hesitate to reach out if you experience any technical difficulties.
example.zh: 如果您遇到任何技術困難，請隨時與我們聯絡。

words.mnemonic: 商務信件結尾標準詢問：if you have any questions (若有任何問題)。

example.en: A brief question-and-answer session will be held immediately after the keynote presentation.
example.zh: 主旨演講結束後將隨即舉行簡短的問答環節。

words.mnemonic: 會議時程與交貨時間常用時間介系詞，表示在某活動之後。

example.en: Online purchases made before noon qualify for free same day delivery service.
example.zh: 中午前完成的線上購物可享有當日免費宅配到府服務。

words.mnemonic: 物流出貨重點考詞：same day delivery (當日送達)、business day (工作天)。

example.en: The first thing we should discuss on this morning's agenda is the quarterly expenditure.
example.zh: 今天上午議程中我們首要討論的事項是季度支出。

words.mnemonic: 會議討論要點常用口語詞：the first thing on the agenda (議程首要事項)。

example.en: Most registered attendees arrived early to collect their seminar registration packets.
example.zh: 大多數已報名的與會者都提早抵達以領取研討會報到資料袋。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀調查結果與問卷統計最常用的形容詞/代名詞。

example.en: We need to order additional packaging materials to fulfill all pending client orders.
example.zh: 我們需要訂購額外的包裝耗材以完成所有待處理的客戶訂單。

words.mnemonic: 採購與業務請購必備動詞，片語 in need of 意為需要。

example.en: How much funding will be allocated to the employee wellness program this year?
example.zh: 今年將提撥多少資金給員工身心健康計畫？

words.mnemonic: 詢問預算與花費的固定問法：how much + 不可數名詞。

example.en: The interview panel agreed that Mr. Gomez is the right candidate for the position.
example.zh: 面試小組一致認為戈梅茲先生是擔任該職位的合適人選。

words.mnemonic: 招募常用 the right candidate 表最理想人選；亦有 right now (馬上)。

example.en: I am currently in a client conference, but I will call you back before five o'clock.
example.zh: 我目前正在與客戶開會，但我會在五點前回電給您。

words.mnemonic: 電話商務必考片語：call back (回電)、get back to someone (回覆某人)。

example.en: The revised safety protocol means that all factory workers must wear protective helmets.
example.zh: 修訂後的安全規範意味著所有工廠作業人員皆必須配戴安全帽。

words.mnemonic: 解釋新政策或合約條款意義的常用動詞，常接 that 子句。

example.en: The newly upgraded automated system operates even faster than the previous model.
example.zh: 新升級的自動化系統運作起來甚至比先前的機型更為迅速。

words.mnemonic: 用於加強比較級語氣 (even faster) 或片語 even though (雖然)。

example.en: Please sign your name here on the receipt to acknowledge delivery of the parcel.
example.zh: 請在收據的這裡簽名，以確認已收到包裹。

words.mnemonic: 快遞簽收與櫃檯接待高頻指示副詞：sign here (在此簽名)。

example.en: Many experienced engineers attended the regional technology expo last Friday.
example.zh: 許多資深工程師上週五參加了該區域科技博覽會。

words.mnemonic: 接可數複數名詞，多益聽力短對話常詢問人數或客群數量。

example.en: Handling such sensitive financial data requires strict compliance with privacy standards.
example.zh: 處理如此敏感的財務資料必須嚴格遵守隱私權標準。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀舉例與定義極高頻片語：such as (諸如、例如)。

example.en: According to the financial report, company sales increased by eight percent last month.
example.zh: 根據財務報告，公司銷售額上個月增長了百分之八。

words.mnemonic: 過去時間指標詞：last month (上個月)、last year (去年)；動詞意為持續。

example.en: The resort hotel offers dedicated supervision activities for guests traveling with a child.
example.zh: 該度假飯店為帶兒童出遊的旅客提供專門的託兒照料活動。

words.mnemonic: 飯店服務與員工福利常見詞：child care (托兒服務)。

example.en: The supervisor will tell the team about the upcoming revisions to the project timeline.
example.zh: 主管將向團隊說明專案時程即將做出的修訂。

words.mnemonic: 商務通訊句型：tell someone about something (告訴某人某事)。

example.en: We really appreciate your patience while our technical team resolves the server issue.
example.zh: 在我們的技術團隊排查伺服器問題時，我們非常感謝您的耐心等候。

words.mnemonic: 多益書信常用客氣加強詞：really appreciate (非常感謝)。

example.en: The committee chairman decided to call an emergency meeting to review the tender bid.
example.zh: 委員會主席決定召開緊急會議以審查投標文件。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻商業搭配：call a meeting (召開會議)、conference call (電話會議)。

example.en: All employees should submit their completed reimbursement forms before the end of the month.
example.zh: 所有員工應在月底之前提交填寫完畢的報帳請款單。

words.mnemonic: 截止期限關鍵時間詞：before the deadline (在截止日期之前)。

example.en: Our company has grown from a local enterprise into an international manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們公司已從一家在地企業成長為國際製造商。

words.mnemonic: 多益最核心主體：company policy (公司政策)、parent company (母公司)。

example.en: Interested applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their resumes through our career website.
example.zh: 強烈建議有興趣的應徵者透過我們的求職網站投遞履歷。

words.mnemonic: 招募管道或溝通途徑標準介系詞，片語 go through 意為仔細審查。

example.en: The company's primary internal database was down for routine maintenance overnight.
example.zh: 公司的主要內部資料庫昨晚因例行維護而暫停服務。

words.mnemonic: IT故障與設備維修高頻詞：server is down (伺服器停擺)；break down (故障)。

example.en: Passengers must show a valid photo ID and boarding pass before entering the gate area.
example.zh: 旅客在進入登機門區域前必須出示有效身分證件與登機證。

words.mnemonic: 機場安檢必備動作：show your ID (出示證件)；名詞 trade show (商展)。

example.en: Performing routine lubrication can substantially prolong the service life of factory machinery.
example.zh: 進行定期潤滑可大幅延長工廠機具的使用壽命。

words.mnemonic: 設備保養與人事平衡必考：service life (使用壽命)、work-life balance (工作與生活平衡)。

example.en: The man who led the engineering workshop has over fifteen years of industry experience.
example.zh: 主持該工程工作坊的男士擁有超過十五年的產業經驗。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 1/2 常考主詞或提問對象；字根衍生 manpower (人力)。

example.en: Airline passengers may change their departure date without paying any penalty fee.
example.zh: 航空公司旅客可以變更出發日期而無需支付任何罰金。

words.mnemonic: 行程更動與票務高頻動詞：change reservation (變更預約/機票)。

example.en: The annual corporate banquet will take place in the grand ballroom of the hotel.
example.zh: 年度企業晚宴將於飯店的富麗宴會廳舉行。

words.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：take place (舉行)、place an order (下訂單)。

example.en: Establishing strong partner ties is essential for the company's long-term financial success.
example.zh: 建立穩固的夥伴關係對於公司的長期財務成功至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 商業經營關鍵詞：long-term goal (長期目標)；as long as (只要)。

example.en: The courier scheduled the package delivery between two and four in the afternoon.
example.zh: 快遞人員已將包裹配送時段排定在下午兩點到四點之間。

words.mnemonic: 時間與地點範圍經典介系詞：between A and B (在A與B之間)。

example.en: Please feel free to ask our customer service representative if you need any assistance.
example.zh: 如果您需要任何協助，請隨時向我們的客服專員詢問。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信與服務極高頻客氣片語：feel free to (請隨時/別客氣)。

example.en: The original quote was deemed too high, so the purchasing agent negotiated for a discount.
example.zh: 最初的報價被認為過高，因此採購專員進行了議價以爭取折扣。

words.mnemonic: 商務談判表示超出預算常用 too high / too expensive；放句尾表「也」。

example.en: The accounting division is still waiting for the client to confirm invoice details.
example.zh: 會計部門仍在等待客戶確認發票詳細資訊。

words.mnemonic: 表示進度尚在處理中：still pending (仍在審核中/尚未定案)。

example.en: Our support technicians are trained to identify and solve technical problems quickly.
example.zh: 我們的支援技術人員受過專業訓練，能夠迅速發現並解決技術問題。

words.mnemonic: 客服與維修的核心搭配：solve a problem (解決問題)、technical problem (技術故障)。

example.en: The senior research associate was asked to write a comprehensive report on market trends.
example.zh: 資深研究專員受命撰寫一份關於市場趨勢的綜合報告。

words.mnemonic: 職場公文必備動作：write a report (寫報告)、write a proposal (寫提案)。

example.en: All orders placed prior to eleven in the morning are processed on the same day.
example.zh: 所有在上午十一點前下達的訂單都會在同一天處理完畢。

words.mnemonic: 電商與出貨關鍵詞：the same day (同一天)；the same as (與...相同)。

example.en: Visitors are requested to park their cars in the designated parking lot adjacent to the hall.
example.zh: 訪客請將車輛停放在大廳旁的專用停車場內。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場場景考點：parking lot (停車場)；a lot of (許多)。

example.en: Partnering with the logistics firm represents a great opportunity for our expansion.
example.zh: 與該物流公司合作為我們的業務擴張代表了一個絕佳的機會。

words.mnemonic: 商機讚許詞：great opportunity (大好機會)、great success (巨大成功)。

example.en: Potential clients can try the enterprise cloud software for thirty days free of charge.
example.zh: 潛在客戶可以免費試用這款企業級雲端軟體三十天。

words.mnemonic: 促銷活動必備動詞：try out (試用體驗)；try to do (努力做某事)。

example.en: Employees must submit an official written request before taking annual leave.
example.zh: 員工在請特休假之前必須提交正式的書面請假申請。

words.mnemonic: 多益人資必考雙重用法：動詞離開、名詞請假 (annual leave 特休、sick leave 病假)。

example.en: Please retain your package tracking number to monitor your shipment progress online.
example.zh: 請妥善保留您的包裹追蹤號碼，以便於線上查詢貨物運送進度。

words.mnemonic: 物流與客服必查：tracking number (追蹤單號)、a number of (許多)。

example.en: Both parties agreed to the amended terms and signed the commercial partnership contract.
example.zh: 雙方皆同意修改後的條款，並簽署了商務合作合約。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約與協議高頻搭配：both parties (雙方)、both A and B (兩者皆)。

example.en: Company policy allows developers to use their own personal laptops under supervision.
example.zh: 公司政策允許開發人員在受監管的前提下使用個人的筆記型電腦。

words.mnemonic: 個人設備與獨立作業常用：on one's own (獨自)、own business (自己的事業)。

example.en: The automated assembly line was paused to replace worn mechanical parts.
example.zh: 自動化組裝線暫時停機，以更換磨損的機械零件。

words.mnemonic: 製造業與工廠極高頻：spare parts (備用零件)；片語 take part in (參加)。

example.en: The sales director emphasized several key points regarding international market growth.
example.zh: 銷售總監著重強調了幾項關於國際市場增長的關鍵要點。

words.mnemonic: 會議發言摘要常用：key point (關鍵要點)、main point (主要重點)。

example.en: There is little doubt that the proposed budget reductions will impact marketing activities.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，擬定之預算縮減將會對行銷推廣活動產生影響。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀常見修飾不可數名詞表否定 (little doubt 毫無疑問)；a little 表少量。

example.en: Our technical support hotline is open twenty-four hours a day to help registered users.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援專線全天候二十四小時開放，隨時為註冊用戶提供協助。

words.mnemonic: 客服宗旨用語：help someone with something (協助某人某事)；help desk (諮詢台)。

example.en: Attendees are warmly encouraged to ask questions at the conclusion of the workshop.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎與會人員在工作坊結束時踴躍提問。

words.mnemonic: 問答環節必備動詞：ask questions (提問)；ask for approval (請求核准)。

example.en: Our latest batch of electronic components meets all strict industrial quality standards.
example.zh: 我們最新一批電子零組件符合所有嚴格的工業品質標準。

words.mnemonic: 多益最經典考點！meet 除了見面，更常考「符合/滿足」：meet standards, meet deadlines。

example.en: The orientation program for newly recruited employees will start promptly at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 新進員工到職培訓計畫將於上午九點整準時開始。

words.mnemonic: 會議、專案或機具啟動的核心動詞：start a project (啟動專案)。

example.en: The human resources manager arranged a session to talk about employee benefits and healthcare.
example.zh: 人力資源經理安排了一場說明會，以討論員工福利與健保制度。

words.mnemonic: 商談必備動詞：talk about (討論某事)、talk with (與某人交談)。

example.en: If you notice something wrong with your online billing statement, notify customer service at once.
example.zh: 若您發現線上對帳單有任何異常之處，請立即通知客戶服務部。

words.mnemonic: 客戶問題反饋常用句型：something wrong (有異常/出問題)。

example.en: Management decided to put together a special committee to oversee the office relocation.
example.zh: 管理層決定籌組一個專責委員會來督導辦公室搬遷事宜。

words.mnemonic: 商務片語高頻考點：put together (組建/彙整)、put off (延期)。

example.en: The guest requested another room on an upper floor away from street traffic noise.
example.zh: 該房客要求換到遠離街頭交通噪音的高樓層另一間客房。

words.mnemonic: 飯店服務與更換選項必備字：another room (另一間房)、one another (彼此)。

example.en: Through consistent product innovation, our company has become a leader in green energy technology.
example.zh: 透過持續的產品創新，我們公司已成為綠色能源科技領域的領導者。

words.mnemonic: 企業發展歷程與地位轉變常態動詞：become a leader (成為領先者)。

example.en: The commercial bank offers very competitive interest rates on corporate expansion loans.
example.zh: 該商業銀行針對企業擴張貸款提供極具競爭力的利率優惠。

words.mnemonic: 多益財務重要考點！名詞常考「利息」：interest rate (利率)；show interest in (對...展現興趣)。

example.en: Our international distribution network delivers consumer goods to over fifty countries globally.
example.zh: 我們的國際配送網路將消費性商品送達全球五十多個國家。

words.mnemonic: 跨國貿易與物流高頻考名詞：across the country (全國各地)、foreign country (外國)。

example.en: The facility manager decided to replace the old computer servers with energy-efficient models.
example.zh: 廠房主管決定將老舊的電腦伺服器更換為節能型機種。

words.mnemonic: 設備淘汰與更新對話常見詞：replace old equipment (更換老舊設備)。

example.en: Each team member is expected to submit a weekly progress update by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 每位團隊成員均須在週五下午前提交每週進度更新報告。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：each 後接單數名詞與單數動詞。

example.en: The corporate foundation provides annual scholarships to local vocational school students.
example.zh: 該企業基金會每年向在地職業學校的學生提供獎學金。

words.mnemonic: 企業社會責任 (CSR) 與實習招募常考單字。

example.en: Passengers arriving late for boarding will not be permitted to enter the aircraft.
example.zh: 登機遲到的旅客將不被允許進入機艙。

words.mnemonic: 交通延誤與繳費罰款必考：late fee (滯納金/逾期罰款)。

example.en: Our new marketing strategy generated high customer engagement across digital platforms.
example.zh: 我們的新行銷策略在各數位平台上帶來了高度的客戶參與。

words.mnemonic: 評價指標必備詞：high quality (高品質)、high priority (高優先級)。

example.en: The sales team explored three different distribution channels to reach younger demographics.
example.zh: 銷售團隊探索了三種不同的經銷管道以觸及年輕消費族群。

words.mnemonic: 方案比較常用詞：different from (與...不同)。

example.en: All clearance items in the retail store are currently marked fifty percent off.
example.zh: 零售店內的所有清倉商品目前皆標示為半價優惠。

words.mnemonic: 促銷打折最核心用語：20% off (打八折)；take a day off (請假一天)。

example.en: The next executive board meeting will be convened on the second Tuesday of November.
example.zh: 下一次執行董事會會議將於十一月的第二個星期二召開。

words.mnemonic: 物流與時程關鍵詞：next day delivery (隔日配送)、next week (下週)。

example.en: All departments must submit their annual expenditure reports before the end of December.
example.zh: 所有部門必須在十二月底前提交年度支出報告。

words.mnemonic: 截止時間常考片語：by the end of the month (月底前)。

example.en: Many employees choose to live near the subway station to reduce their daily commute time.
example.zh: 許多員工選擇住在捷運站附近以縮短每日通勤時間。

words.mnemonic: 員工通勤生活描寫動詞；亦可作形容詞 /laɪv/ live broadcast (現場直播)。

example.en: Please keep your mobile phones on silent while the training seminar is in progress.
example.zh: 培訓研討會進行期間，請將手機保持靜音狀態。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力會場公告高頻連接詞：while + 進行中事件。

example.en: Our international freight service transports electronic parts to destinations around the world.
example.zh: 我們的國際貨運服務將電子零組件運往世界各地的目的地。

words.mnemonic: 跨國企業文宣高頻片語：around the world / throughout the world (全球各地)。

example.en: The newly hired interns will undergo intensive safety orientation over the next week.
example.zh: 新聘實習生將在接下來的一週接受密集的安全到職訓練。

words.mnemonic: 時程規劃基礎詞：twice a week (每週兩次)、next week (下週)。

example.en: Effective communication plays an essential role in fostering cross-departmental collaboration.
example.zh: 有效的溝通在促進跨部門合作中扮演著至關重要的角色。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場閱讀極高頻片語：play an important role in (在...中扮演要角)。

example.en: The company introduced a flexible policy that allows staff to work from home on Fridays.
example.zh: 公司推出了一項彈性政策，允許員工在週五居家辦公。

words.mnemonic: 遠距辦公現代多益必考：work from home (WFH, 在家上班)。

example.en: Workers should never operate hazardous machinery without wearing the proper protective goggles.
example.zh: 工人在未配戴適當防護護目鏡的情況下，絕不得操作危險機具。

words.mnemonic: 安全規章與禁令強調用語：should never do (絕不應當做某事)。

example.en: The room rate includes complimentary high-speed internet access and daily breakfast.
example.zh: 房費包含免費高速網路連線與每日早餐。

words.mnemonic: 合約與費用明細核心字：tax included (含稅)、include breakfast (附早餐)。
roots: clud 關閉 → 關進去、包含

example.en: Employees who complete the online project management course will receive a recognized certificate.
example.zh: 完成線上專案管理課程的員工將獲得認可的結業證書。

words.mnemonic: 在職訓練常用詞：training course (培訓課程)；of course (當然)。

example.en: Our creative department handles all graphic design in-house rather than hiring an external agency.
example.zh: 我們的創意部門在內部自行處理所有平面設計，而非外聘外部機構。

words.mnemonic: 商務極高頻片語：in-house (公司內部自行處理的)。

example.en: The financial analyst finalized the quarterly earnings report ahead of the board meeting.
example.zh: 財務分析師在董事會會議前完成了季度盈餘報告。

words.mnemonic: 職場最核心名詞/動詞：financial report (財報)、report to (向主管回報)。
roots: port 攜帶 → 帶回消息

example.en: Special discounted lodging rates are available for corporate travel groups of ten or more.
example.zh: 十人以上的企業差旅團體可享有專案住宿折扣優惠。

words.mnemonic: 商務差旅考點：group rate / group discount (團體優惠價)。

example.en: In case of severe weather emergencies, staff will be notified via our automated text alert system.
example.zh: 萬一發生惡劣天候緊急狀況，將透過自動簡訊警報系統通知全體員工。

words.mnemonic: 多益必考條件句型：in case of (萬一發生/在...情況下)。

example.en: The woman who gave the opening keynote speech serves as chief technology officer of the firm.
example.zh: 發表開幕主題演講的女士擔任該公司的技術長。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力短對話 Part 3 常見提問對象：What does the woman suggest?

example.en: The scheduled shuttle bus service departs from terminal one around every twenty minutes.
example.zh: 定時接駁巴士大約每二十分鐘自第一航廈發車一次。

words.mnemonic: 聽力表示大約時間或費用常客：around three o'clock (大約三點)。

example.en: Business travelers are strongly advised to book their flight tickets at least two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 強烈建議商務旅客至少提前兩週預訂機票。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻動詞！book = reserve (預約訂位)：book a flight, book a room。

example.en: The resort hotel provides spacious connecting suites tailored for guests traveling with family.
example.zh: 該度假飯店提供專為攜眷出遊旅客設計的寬敞連通套房。

words.mnemonic: 人資福利與飯店套餐考點：family plan (家庭方案)、family leave (家庭照顧假)。

example.en: There seems to be an error in the final calculation of the shipping charges on this invoice.
example.zh: 這份發票上最終運費的計算似乎出現了一處錯誤。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信委婉提出問題的用語：There seems to be a problem。

example.en: Please let the front desk clerk know if you require an iron or extra towels in your room.
example.zh: 若您客房內需要熨斗或額外毛巾，請告知櫃檯接待人員。

words.mnemonic: 商務郵件高頻客氣句型：Please let me know (請告知我)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you again for your patience.
example.zh: 我們對造成的不便深表歉意，並再次感謝您的耐心配合。

words.mnemonic: 客服道歉信結尾高頻句：Thank you once again (再次感謝您)。

example.en: What kind of warranty coverage is provided with the commercial laser printer?
example.zh: 這款商用雷射印表機隨附何種保固保障？

words.mnemonic: 詢問規格常用：what kind of (哪一種)；形容詞 kind assistance (親切協助)。

example.en: Please keep your original purchase receipts for at least thirty days to facilitate warranty claims.
example.zh: 請妥善保留原始購買收據至少三十天，以便辦理保固理賠。

words.mnemonic: 商務溝通片語：keep in mind (牢記在心)、keep updated (隨時保持最新資訊)。

example.en: We were very pleased to hear that your company was awarded the regional trade contract.
example.zh: 我們非常高興得知貴公司榮獲該區域貿易合約。

words.mnemonic: 商務社交致賀常客：hear from someone (收到某人來信/消息)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters upgraded its internal payroll system to automate tax calculations.
example.zh: 企業總部升級了內部薪資核算系統，以實現稅額自動計算。

words.mnemonic: IT與辦公科技核心詞：computer system (電腦系統)、operating system (作業系統)。

example.en: Safety inspectors conduct thorough maintenance checks on factory elevators every six months.
example.zh: 安全檢查員每六個月對工廠電梯進行一次全面的維護檢查。

words.mnemonic: 頻率周期考點：every year (每年)、every six months (每六個月)。

example.en: The seminar presenter will answer audience questions during the final twenty minutes of the session.
example.zh: 研討會主講人將在會議最後二十分鐘回答現場觀眾的提問。

words.mnemonic: 會議問答標準詞：question and answer (Q&A 問答環節)。

example.en: Employees may purchase discounted meals in the company cafeteria during lunch hours.
example.zh: 員工可以在午休時間於公司員工餐廳購買優惠餐點。

words.mnemonic: 多益介系詞大考點：during 後接表示期間的名詞 (如 during the meeting)。

example.en: Our customer support agents are always ready to assist users with technical software issues.
example.zh: 我們的客戶支援專員隨時準備好協助使用者解決軟體技術問題。

words.mnemonic: 企業承諾常見頻率副詞，表示持續不變的優質服務態度。

example.en: Securing this overseas government contract was a big milestone for our growing business.
example.zh: 拿下這筆海外政府合約是我們成長中企業的一個重大里程碑。

words.mnemonic: 形容商機或規模常用：big opportunity (大好良機)。

example.en: The committee agreed to set a firm deadline for the submission of all design bids.
example.zh: 委員會同意為所有設計競標文件的繳交設定嚴格的最後期限。

words.mnemonic: 極高頻職場片語：set a deadline (設定截止日期)、set up (架設/創立)。

example.en: The government launched an initiative to provide low-interest loans to small businesses.
example.zh: 政府推出了一項向小型企業提供低利貸款的輔導方案。

words.mnemonic: 商業分類常見名詞：small business (中小型企業)。

example.en: A recent market study shows that consumers prefer eco-friendly packaging for cosmetics.
example.zh: 最近一項市場研究顯示，消費者偏好化妝品採用環保包裝。

words.mnemonic: 多益報告常客：market study (市場研究)、conduct a study (進行研究)。

example.en: All factory operators must strictly follow the safety instructions displayed on the bulletin board.
example.zh: 所有工廠操作人員皆必須嚴格遵守公告欄上所張貼的安全守則。

words.mnemonic: 守規矩必備動詞：follow the guidelines / follow the rules (遵守規範)。

example.en: The keynote presentation is scheduled to begin promptly at nine o'clock in the morning.
example.zh: 主旨演講預定於上午九點整準時開始。

words.mnemonic: 會議活動開場動詞：begin promptly at (在...準時開始)。

example.en: The vice president will announce an important policy change during today's press conference.
example.zh: 副總裁將在今日的記者會上宣布一項重大的政策變動。

words.mnemonic: 重要性說明標準詞：play an important role in (扮演要角)。

example.en: Since the senior project manager was out of the office, her deputy led the client consultation.
example.zh: 由於資深專案經理不在辦公室，由她的代理人主持客戶諮詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考法：表時間「自從」（搭配現在完成式）或表原因「既然/因為」。

example.en: Our marketing division plans to run a promotional campaign on popular social media platforms.
example.zh: 我們的行銷部門計劃在熱門社群媒體平台上推行一場宣傳促銷活動。

words.mnemonic: 多益常考「經營管理/執行活動」：run a business (做生意), run a campaign。

example.en: The historical office complex is currently under renovation to improve accessibility for all visitors.
example.zh: 這座歷史悠久的辦公園區目前正在整修中，以提升所有訪客的無障礙便利性。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻片語結構：under construction (施工中)、under warranty (在保固期內)。

example.en: Employees must remember to turn off all air conditioning units and office lights before leaving.
example.zh: 員工在離開辦公室前務必記得關閉所有冷氣機與辦公室照明。

words.mnemonic: 關閉與繳交設備動詞片語：turn off (關閉電源)、turn in (呈繳報告)。

example.en: Only a few tickets remain available for the annual charity banquet this weekend.
example.zh: 本週末舉行的年度慈善晚宴目前僅剩為數不多的票券可供購買。

words.mnemonic: 修飾可數複數名詞：a few (少數幾個/一些)；few (幾乎沒有)。

example.en: All workshop attendees should bring their employee identification badges to access the building.
example.zh: 所有工作坊與會者皆應攜帶其員工識別證以進入大樓。

words.mnemonic: 商務會談常客：bring about (促成)、bring up (在會議中提出討論)。

example.en: Passengers who take advantage of our early booking discount can save up to thirty percent.
example.zh: 善用我們早鳥預訂優惠的旅客最多可節省百分之三十的費用。

words.mnemonic: 多益促銷經典用法：early bird discount (早鳥優惠)。

example.en: Please hand in your finalized expense reimbursement forms to the accounting department by noon.
example.zh: 請於中午前將填寫完畢的差旅報銷單交至會計部門。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室交公文必備片語：hand in (繳交)、hand out (發放講義)。

example.en: The corporate contract clearly states that all cancellation requests must be submitted in writing.
example.zh: 企業合約中明確陳述所有取消申請皆必須以書面方式提出。

words.mnemonic: 正式文件陳述條款動詞；名詞 state of the art (最先進的技術)。

example.en: Our regional marketing headquarters will move to a newly constructed office park next month.
example.zh: 我們的區域行銷總部將於下個月搬遷至新建成的辦公園區。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室搬遷公告考點：move to a new location (搬遷至新址)。

example.en: We offer a thirty-day money-back guarantee if customers are not completely satisfied with the product.
example.zh: 若客戶對產品不甚滿意，我們提供三十天內無條件全額退費保證。

words.mnemonic: 客戶退款保證標準詞彙：money-back guarantee (不滿意退費保證)。

example.en: The consultant presented verified facts and figures to support the corporate restructuring proposal.
example.zh: 顧問提出了經過查證的事實與數據，以支持企業組織重整的提案。

words.mnemonic: 會議提案用片語：facts and figures (事實與數據)、in fact (事實上)。

example.en: We intended to dispatch the shipment today; however, severe weather forced a temporary delay.
example.zh: 我們原定今日發貨；然而，惡劣天候迫使出貨暫時延後。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀轉折語氣之王，標誌著條件受限或狀況生變。

example.en: Unauthorized personnel are strictly prohibited from entering the chemical storage area.
example.zh: 未經授權人員嚴禁進入化學品儲存區域。

words.mnemonic: 工廠安全區域標誌：restricted area (管制區)、smoking area (吸菸區)。

example.en: The hotel provides free breakfast.
example.zh: 這家飯店提供免費早餐。

words.mnemonic: provide someone with something。
roots: vid 看 → 事先看顧、供應

example.en: Please print your full legal name clearly on the conference registration badge.
example.zh: 請在研討會報到識別證上清晰正楷填寫您的法定全名。

words.mnemonic: 填表必備欄位：full name (全名)；brand name (品牌名稱)。

example.en: Employees should carefully read the revised travel reimbursement policy before booking tickets.
example.zh: 員工在訂票前應仔細審閱修訂後的差旅費報銷規定。

words.mnemonic: 簽約或實施政策常客：read carefully (仔細閱讀)。

example.en: Our current staff referral program offers cash incentives when you recommend a friend for an open position.
example.zh: 我們的內部員工推薦計畫在您推薦朋友應徵職缺成功時提供現金獎勵。

words.mnemonic: 企業招募方案常用：refer a friend (推薦朋友求職)。

example.en: Utility invoices and office rental payments are due on the first day of each month.
example.zh: 水電費帳單與辦公室租金於每個月的第一天到期應付。

words.mnemonic: 財務出帳周期：end of the month (月底)、last month (上個月)。

example.en: The newly opened regional distribution hub can store a large inventory of consumer electronics.
example.zh: 新啟用的區域經銷物流中心可存放大量的消費性電子產品庫存。

words.mnemonic: 描述規模常用：large quantity (大量)、at large (普遍地/整體而言)。

example.en: The regional sales manager will travel to London on business for three consecutive days.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理將前往倫敦連續出差三天處理公務。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的字首之一：on business (出差)、business hours (營業時間)。

example.en: Refunds cannot be issued for returned merchandise without an original store receipt.
example.zh: 退換商品若未檢附原始店家收據，恕無法辦理退款。

words.mnemonic: 政策限制常見介系詞：without prior notice (恕不另行通知)。

example.en: For more detailed information regarding hotel amenities, please inquire at the front desk.
example.zh: 欲了解更多關於飯店休閒設施的詳細資訊，請向接待櫃檯洽詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益不可數名詞大考點：for more information (如需更多資訊)。

example.en: Our downtown branch will officially open for business next Monday at eight-thirty.
example.zh: 我們的市中心分行將於下週一上午八點半正式開門營業。

words.mnemonic: 開店與職缺核心詞：open for business (營業)、job opening (職缺)。

example.en: Please include your confirmed order number when contacting customer service regarding delivery.
example.zh: 就配送問題與客戶服務部聯繫時，請隨附您的確認訂單編號。

words.mnemonic: 商業採購核心考點：place an order (下訂單)、out of order (故障)。

example.en: The engineering corporation won a lucrative contract to build government infrastructure facilities.
example.zh: 這家工程公司贏得了一項興建政府公共基礎設施的巨額標案。

words.mnemonic: 公家機關與投標常考：government regulation (政府規章)。

example.en: Positive word of mouth from satisfied customers helped our new product gain market traction quickly.
example.zh: 滿意顧客良好的口耳相傳，幫助我們的新產品迅速在市場上建立聲勢。

words.mnemonic: 行銷高頻必考片語：word of mouth (口碑行銷)。

example.en: Please report any technical issue.
example.zh: 請回報任何技術問題。

words.mnemonic: issue 可表示問題或發布。

example.en: Conducting thorough market research is crucial prior to launching products overseas.
example.zh: 在向海外推出產品之前，進行徹底的市場調查至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 商管必背字：market share (市場占有率)、market research (市調)。

example.en: Clients can pay their consulting invoices conveniently via electronic bank transfer.
example.zh: 客戶可以透過電子銀行轉帳便捷地支付其顧問諮詢費用帳單。

words.mnemonic: 付款與注意力高頻動詞：pay by credit card (刷卡付款)、pay attention to (注意)。

example.en: The enterprise strives to build lasting relationships with its corporate suppliers and clients.
example.zh: 該企業致力於與其企業供應商及客戶建立長久穩固的合作關係。

words.mnemonic: 商務擴張與公關常用：build relationships (建立關係)。

example.en: Please hold the line while I transfer your call to the technical service department.
example.zh: 請稍候別掛斷，我將為您把電話轉接至技術服務部。

words.mnemonic: 電話英語與主辦會議極高頻：hold the line (電話稍候)、hold a meeting (開會)。

example.en: Our award-winning customer service department handles inquiries promptly around the clock.
example.zh: 我們屢獲殊榮的客戶服務部門全天候迅速處理顧客諮詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的主題名詞：customer service (客服)、service charge (服務費)。

example.en: Heavy equipment should be placed securely against the back wall of the factory storage bay.
example.zh: 重型設備應穩固地放置在工廠倉儲區的後牆邊。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 1 常見方位介系詞：leaning against the wall (靠在牆上)。

example.en: Industry experts believe that renewable solar energy adoption will accelerate over the coming decade.
example.zh: 產業專家認為，在未來的十年間，再生太陽能的普及將會加速。

words.mnemonic: 商業演說表達樂觀展望時常用：believe that (深信/認為)。

example.en: The second quarter fiscal earnings report will be presented to shareholders on Thursday.
example.zh: 第二季度會計盈餘報告將於週四向股東呈報。

words.mnemonic: 財報與步驟標記詞：second quarter (第二季/Q2)、second floor (二樓)。

example.en: Even though initial production was delayed, the engineering team finished the project ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 儘管初期生產有所延誤，工程團隊仍提前完成了專案。

words.mnemonic: 轉折句型重點：even though (即使/儘管)。

example.en: We would love to welcome your delegation to our annual international software summit.
example.zh: 我們非常樂意歡迎貴代表團出席我們的年度國際軟體峰會。

words.mnemonic: 邀請函常用客氣句型：would love to (非常樂意做某事)。

example.en: Sales increased by fifteen percent.
example.zh: 銷售額增長了百分之十五。

words.mnemonic: 可以是名詞或動詞。

example.en: Human resources published a job advertisement for a bilingual corporate communications specialist.
example.zh: 人力資源部門刊登了一則徵求雙語企業傳播專員的徵才廣告。

words.mnemonic: 徵才招聘核心字：job opening (職缺)、job description (工作職責說明)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee reviewed the proposed marketing plan during this morning's session.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會在今天上午的會議中審查了擬定的行銷方案。

words.mnemonic: 職場規劃必備詞：business plan (商業計畫書)、plan to (打算做某事)。

example.en: As a result of the targeted promotional campaign, third quarter retail sales surged twenty percent.
example.zh: 由於精準推廣活動的成效，第三季零售額大幅增長了百分之二十。

words.mnemonic: 因果關係極高頻轉折片語：as a result of (由於...的結果)。

example.en: Mr. Sterling is currently away on a business trip, but his assistant can answer your inquiries.
example.zh: 史特林先生目前出差在外，但他的助理可以回答您的洽詢。

words.mnemonic: 不在辦公室常用答覆：away on business (出差中)；right away (立刻)。

example.en: The training seminar leader cited several successful examples of corporate brand turnaround.
example.zh: 培訓研討會講師列舉了數個企業品牌成功轉型翻身的範例。

words.mnemonic: 會議舉例最常見片語：for example (例如)。

example.en: If a delivery disruption happens to occur, customers will receive immediate automated notification.
example.zh: 萬一碰巧發生出貨配送中斷，顧客將收到即時自動通知。

words.mnemonic: 事件發生描寫動詞：happen to (碰巧)。

example.en: We are delighted to offer you the position of senior financial analyst at our corporate headquarters.
example.zh: 我們非常榮幸能向您提供企業總部資深財務分析師的職位。

words.mnemonic: 求職錄取與商業優惠必備：job offer (錄取通知)、special offer (特別優惠)。
roots: fer 攜帶 → 帶到面前

example.en: The internship program provides promising young professionals with hands-on corporate experience.
example.zh: 該實習計畫為極具潛力的年輕專業人士提供寶貴的企業實務經驗。

words.mnemonic: 實習培訓與消費市場客群詞彙：young professionals (青年專業人才)。

example.en: The downtown commercial bank branch closes promptly at five o'clock on weekday afternoons.
example.zh: 市中心商銀分行於平日下午五點整準時結束營業打烊。

words.mnemonic: 營業時間公告核心詞：close at 5 PM；片語 close a deal (達成交易)。

example.en: All newly hired administrative employees must attend our comprehensive orientation program.
example.zh: 所有新聘行政人員皆必須參加我們全面的到職培訓計畫。

words.mnemonic: 人資培訓方案：training program (培訓計畫)、loyalty program (會員積點計畫)。

example.en: Ms. Reynolds was appointed to lead the international software development initiative.
example.zh: 雷諾茲女士獲任命領導這項國際軟體開發倡議。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場領導力與因果搭配：lead to (導致)、lead a team (帶領團隊)。

example.en: Corporate clients can buy office furniture in bulk to receive substantial volume discounts.
example.zh: 企業客戶可以大宗批量購買辦公家具，以獲得豐厚的量大折扣。

words.mnemonic: 採購基礎動詞：buy in bulk (大宗購買)、buy online (線上購買)。

example.en: We completely understand your frustration regarding the unexpected shipment delay.
example.zh: 我們非常能體諒您對於無預警貨物延誤所感到的沮喪。

words.mnemonic: 客服書信展現同理心必用動詞：understand your concern (體諒您的關切)。

example.en: We would like to thank all participating vendors for their valuable contributions to the trade expo.
example.zh: 我們由衷感謝所有參展廠商對本次貿易博覽會所做出的寶貴貢獻。

words.mnemonic: 商務社交信函第一句或結尾句：Thank you for your cooperation (感謝您的合作)。

example.en: The corporate conference center is not far from the international airport terminals.
example.zh: 該企業會議中心距離國際機場航廈並不遙遠。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力短對話方位詞：not far from (離...不遠)；as far as (就...而言)。

example.en: Order your replacement supplies today to qualify for free express courier dispatch.
example.zh: 今日下單訂購您的耗材補充品，即可享有免費快捷快遞出貨服務。

words.mnemonic: 促銷呼籲行動常客：call us today (今天就致電我們)。

example.en: Standard corporate office hours are from nine in the morning until five in the evening.
example.zh: 標準企業辦公營業時間為上午九點至下午五點。

words.mnemonic: 營業與辦公時間多益必考：business hours / office hours (營業/辦公時間)。

example.en: Full-time university students are eligible for a twenty percent discount on exhibition passes.
example.zh: 全職大學生可享有展覽入場證八折優惠。

words.mnemonic: 學生票價促銷與實習生招募考點：student discount (學生優惠)。

example.en: Local retailers face intense competition from multinational online e-commerce platforms.
example.zh: 在地零售商正面臨來自跨國線上電商平台的激烈競爭。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場商業挑戰動詞：face challenges / face competition (面臨挑戰/競爭)。

example.en: We hope to conclude the contract negotiations with the overseas supplier by Friday.
example.zh: 我們期盼能在週五之前敲定與海外供應商的合約談判。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信期許句型：We hope that... / hope to do something。

example.en: The design team presented an innovative idea for the eco-friendly product packaging.
example.zh: 設計團隊針對環保產品包裝提出了一個創新的構想。

words.mnemonic: 腦力激盪常用詞：innovative idea (創新點子)。

example.en: Implementing digital automation helped our factory reduce overall operating costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 導入數位自動化幫助我們的工廠將整體營運成本降低了百分之十。

words.mnemonic: 商業財務高頻詞：operating costs (營運成本)、at all costs (不惜一切代價)。

example.en: The upgraded machinery consumes significantly less electricity than earlier models.
example.zh: 這台升級後的機具耗電量明顯低於早期的機種。

words.mnemonic: 修飾不可數名詞：less money / less time；片語 no less than (不少於)。

example.en: Please confirm whether the executive conference room has been reserved for our client briefing.
example.zh: 請確認高階會議室是否已被預訂作為我們的大客簡報之用。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與會議必考：conference room (會議室)、room service (客房服務)。

example.en: The early registration promotional discount remains valid until midnight this coming Friday.
example.zh: 早鳥報名促銷優惠將持續有效，直到本週五午夜為止。

words.mnemonic: 多益截止日期關鍵介系詞：valid until (有效期限至...)、until further notice (直到另行通知)。

example.en: The main reason for the flight cancellation was heavy snowfall across the regional airport.
example.zh: 航班取消的主要原因是區域機場普降大雪。

words.mnemonic: 解釋狀況必用片語：the reason for (做...的原因)。

example.en: All job applicants are requested to complete the online background verification form.
example.zh: 所有應徵者皆須填妥線上背景查核表格。

words.mnemonic: 行政事務極高頻詞：application form (申請表)、fill out a form (填表)。

example.en: Our marketing division plans to spend twenty percent of its budget on social media advertisements.
example.zh: 我們的行銷部門計劃將百分之二十的預算花費在社群媒體廣告上。

words.mnemonic: 預算配置與時間管理動詞：spend money on (在...上花錢)。

example.en: Mr. Chen was recently appointed as the new head of the corporate legal department.
example.zh: 陳先生最近獲任命為企業法務部門的新任主管。

words.mnemonic: 職銜稱謂常客：department head (部門主管)、headquarters (總部)。

example.en: Corporate business travelers can reserve a rental car directly through our travel agency partner.
example.zh: 企業商務旅客可以直接透過我們的合作旅行社預訂租賃車輛。

words.mnemonic: 差旅租車必備字：rental car (租賃車)、car rental agency (租車公司)。

example.en: New staff members will learn company compliance rules during their first week of orientation.
example.zh: 新進員工將在到職培訓的第一週學習公司的法規遵從守則。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重用法：既表示「學習技巧」，也常在書信中表示「得知消息」(learn that)。

example.en: The corporate position requires a high level of proficiency in international commercial law.
example.zh: 該企業職位要求具備高水準的國際商務法專業能力。

words.mnemonic: 職場能力要求標準搭配：entry level (初階/社會新鮮人職位)、high level (高階)。

example.en: Clients who prefer to discuss their loan applications in person are welcome to visit our branch.
example.zh: 偏好親自洽談貸款申請的客戶，竭誠歡迎蒞臨我們的分行。

words.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：in person (親自/本人親臨)。

example.en: The prospective candidate possesses extensive experience in supply chain optimization.
example.zh: 該準應徵者在供應鏈最佳化方面具備豐富的實務經驗。

words.mnemonic: 履歷要求核心字：relevant experience (相關經驗)、work experience (工作經驗)。

example.en: Once payment authorization is received, the warehouse will dispatch your order immediately.
example.zh: 一旦收到付款授權確認，倉庫將立即發送您的訂單。

words.mnemonic: 條件連接詞極高頻：once + 主詞 + 動詞 (一旦...就...)。

example.en: Rewards program members receive exclusive access to our seasonal product pre-orders.
example.zh: 紅利積點會員可享有我們季節性新品預購的專屬禮遇。

words.mnemonic: 團隊與會員制詞彙：team member (團隊成員)、staff member (員工)。

example.en: The purchasing manager ensured that we have enough inventory to fulfill peak season orders.
example.zh: 採購經理確保我們備有充裕的庫存以應付旺季的訂單需求。

words.mnemonic: 庫存與資源必考形容詞：enough time (充裕的時間)、enough inventory (足夠庫存)。

example.en: The ferry service across the harbor was suspended due to unusually bad weather conditions.
example.zh: 由於異常惡劣的天候狀況，跨港渡輪服務暫停行駛。

words.mnemonic: 天候與服務故障常用詞：bad weather (壞天氣)、bad condition (狀況不佳)。

example.en: The express train provides direct transportation between the international airport and city center.
example.zh: 這班快捷特快車在國際機場與市中心之間提供直達接駁交通。

words.mnemonic: 交通地理位置常用詞：city center (市中心)、city hall (市政府)。

example.en: The special corporate travel package covers three nights in a deluxe executive room.
example.zh: 這套專案企業差旅套票涵蓋在豪華商務客房連續住宿三晚。

words.mnemonic: 飯店訂房與快遞出貨必備：per night (每晚)、overnight delivery (隔夜送達)。

example.en: With the updated software system, staff will be able to process customer invoices in seconds.
example.zh: 透過升級後的軟體系統，員工將能夠在數秒內處理完客戶發票。

words.mnemonic: 多益能力表達最核心片語：be able to + 原形動詞 (能夠做某事)。

example.en: Our dedicated technical support team is available twenty-four hours a day to assist registered clients.
example.zh: 我們的專職技術支援團隊全天候二十四小時提供協助，隨時服務註冊客戶。

words.mnemonic: 客服中心核心招牌：technical support (技術支援)、customer support (客戶支援)。
roots: port 攜帶 → 從下撐住

example.en: The electronics manufacturer introduced an entirely new product line of smart home sensors.
example.zh: 這家電子製造商推出了一個全新系列的智慧家庭感測器產品線。

words.mnemonic: 工廠製造與行銷高頻詞：production line (生產線)、product line (產品線)。

example.en: The research team will present their latest quarterly findings at the global summit tomorrow.
example.zh: 研究團隊將於明天的全球高峰會上發表他們最新的季度調查成果。

words.mnemonic: 動詞 /prɪˈzɛnt/ (發表簡報)；形容詞 /ˈprɛznt/ (出席在場的)。
roots: sent 在 (esse) → 在面前、呈現

example.en: Both sides in the contract dispute reached an amicable agreement without entering litigation.
example.zh: 合約爭議的雙方在未進入訴訟程序的情況下達成了和解協議。

words.mnemonic: 商務談判協議用語：both sides (雙方)、on the other hand (在另一方面)。

example.en: The newly remodeled conference hall is quite spacious and can accommodate up to three hundred people.
example.zh: 全新改裝的會議廳相當寬敞，最多可容納三百人。

words.mnemonic: 程度修飾副詞：quite a few (相當多個)、quite good (相當不錯)。

example.en: Although production expenses rose slightly, net company profits remained remarkably steady.
example.zh: 雖然生產費用略有上升，但公司的淨利潤仍保持得相當穩定。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀長篇轉折連接詞，引導讓步子句。

example.en: Please make sure that all office computers are properly shut down before the holiday weekend.
example.zh: 在連續假期週末前，請務必確認所有辦公室電腦皆已妥善關機。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室指令極高頻片語：make sure (確保/務必)。

example.en: Both legal teams spent several days negotiating the final payment terms of the acquisition agreement.
example.zh: 雙方法務團隊花了數天時間協商收購協議的最終付款條款。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約與策略大考點：terms and conditions (合約條款)、long-term (長期)。

example.en: All employees should submit their annual leave requests at least two weeks before their departure date.
example.zh: 所有員工應在出發日期至少兩週前提出特休假申請。

words.mnemonic: 規定期限極高頻片語：at least (至少)。

example.en: Company hiring policy strictly enforces equal employment opportunities regardless of gender or age.
example.zh: 公司招募政策嚴格落實平等就業機會，不論性別或年齡皆一視同仁。

words.mnemonic: 就業防歧視政策常考詞：regardless of age (不論年齡)。

example.en: Our online travel agency provides exceptionally low prices on domestic airline tickets.
example.zh: 我們的線上旅行社提供極為低廉的國內機票價格。

words.mnemonic: 促銷文案高頻詞：low price (低價)、low cost (低成本)。

example.en: A prominent industry keynote speaker was invited to speak about emerging artificial intelligence trends.
example.zh: 一位知名產業特邀演講嘉賓受邀針對新興人工智慧趨勢發表演說。

words.mnemonic: 演說動詞；電話英語常用：May I speak to Mr. White?

example.en: Customer support guarantees that all email inquiries will be answered within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 客戶服務承諾所有電子郵件諮詢皆將在二十四小時內獲得回覆。

words.mnemonic: 時效限制介系詞大考點：within 24 hours (二十四小時內)。

example.en: The application process takes a week.
example.zh: 申請流程需要一週時間。

words.mnemonic: process an application。
roots: cess 走 → 前進的過程

example.en: The convention center is conveniently situated near multiple accessible public transportation links.
example.zh: 會展中心地理位置優越，鄰近多條便利的大眾交通接駁網絡。

words.mnemonic: 公共公關考點：public transportation (大眾運輸)、public relations (公關/PR)。

example.en: Corporate sales representatives often travel across the state to meet prospective commercial clients.
example.zh: 企業業務代表經常出差走訪全州以拜訪潛在商業客戶。

words.mnemonic: 頻率副詞常客，出現在日常辦公作息描寫。

example.en: Our senior supervisors will train newly recruited staff members on automated software tools.
example.zh: 我們的資深主管將針對自動化軟體工具培訓新進員工。

words.mnemonic: 人資動詞培訓；交通名詞火車：take a train (搭火車)。

example.en: Please complete and submit your quarterly sales forecast report as soon as possible.
example.zh: 請盡速填寫並呈繳您的季度銷售預測報告。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信最通用片語：as soon as possible (ASAP, 盡快)。

example.en: The final renovation costs were actually lower than our original architectural estimate.
example.zh: 最終的裝修費用實際上低於我們原先的建築估算。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 3/4 修正對方觀點時常用副詞。

example.en: Management decided to upgrade the existing facility rather than construct an entirely new warehouse.
example.zh: 管理層決定升級現有設施，而不是興建一座全新的倉庫。

words.mnemonic: 多益必考二選一偏好句型：rather than (而不是)。

example.en: Guests staying in the deluxe corner suite enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view of the harbor.
example.zh: 入住豪華邊間套房的旅客可飽覽海港令人屏息的全景風光。

words.mnemonic: 飯店訂房核心賣點：ocean view (海景)；觀點 point of view。

example.en: Engineering and marketing divisions worked together to ensure the successful rollout of the device.
example.zh: 工程與行銷部門通力合作，以確保該裝置成功推向市場。

words.mnemonic: 團隊合作核心詞：work together (合作)、put together (組合/組建)。

example.en: The hiring committee will carefully consider all candidate credentials before scheduling interviews.
example.zh: 招募委員會將在安排面試前仔細考慮所有候選人的資歷。

words.mnemonic: 決策常用動詞，後接名詞或 V-ing：consider doing something。
roots: sider 星星 → 觀星思索

example.en: Our store guarantees the lowest price on all name-brand office supplies this season.
example.zh: 本季本店保證所有知名品牌辦公用品皆為最低價。

words.mnemonic: 商業銷售核心字：reasonable price (合理價格)、price tag (標價籤)。

example.en: The regional subsidiary received comprehensive capital funding from its European parent company.
example.zh: 該區域子公司從其歐洲母公司獲得了全面的資金挹注。

words.mnemonic: 商業組織多益常考：parent company (母公司)。

example.en: The technical staff worked hard throughout the weekend to restore the crashed database server.
example.zh: 技術人員整個週末都在辛勤工作以恢復崩潰的資料庫伺服器。

words.mnemonic: 職場工作態度：work hard (努力工作)；hard copy (紙本印刷件)。

example.en: Both contracting parties have agreed to the revised terms outlined in the merger document.
example.zh: 雙方締約當事人皆同意合併文件中列出的修訂條款。

words.mnemonic: 多益法律商業大考點：party 指契約雙方，如 third party (第三方)、both parties (雙方)。

example.en: Our restaurant chain partners with local organic farmers to source fresh seasonal vegetables.
example.zh: 我們的連鎖餐廳與在地有機農民合作以採購新鮮的當季蔬菜。

words.mnemonic: 採購與商務社區關係常用：local business (在地商家)、local branch (在地分行)。

example.en: Rigorous quality control inspections are conducted at every stage of the manufacturing process.
example.zh: 製造過程的每一個階段皆實施嚴格的品質管制檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 品管必背片語：quality control (品管/QC)、under control (在控制中)。

example.en: The courier service reported that your replacement package has already been delivered to reception.
example.zh: 快遞服務回報表示您的換貨包裹已經送達接待櫃檯。

words.mnemonic: 進度狀態確認詞，常搭配現在完成式 (has already been delivered)。

example.en: The facility director addressed employee concerns regarding improved ventilation in the workshop.
example.zh: 廠房主管回應了員工對於改善車間通風情況的關切。

words.mnemonic: 多益書信開頭常用：To Whom It May Concern (敬啟者)。

example.en: The company launched a new product.
example.zh: 公司推出了一項新產品。

words.mnemonic: 常出現在 sales 或 marketing。

example.en: Failure to meet market demand could cause the company to lose valuable market share to rivals.
example.zh: 無法滿足市場需求可能會導致公司將寶貴的市場份額拱手讓給競爭對手。

words.mnemonic: 虧損與流失搭配：lose money (賠錢)、lose market share (失去市占率)。

example.en: The public relations team crafted an inspiring success story highlighting our client partnership.
example.zh: 公關團隊精心打造了一篇鼓舞人心的成功案例故事，突顯我們與客戶的合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: 公關行銷常用 success story (成功故事)；亦可指建築樓層 (ten-story building)。

example.en: The engineering team has almost completed the functional testing phase of the new machine.
example.zh: 工程團隊已經差不多完成了新機器的功能測試階段。

words.mnemonic: 進度接近完成用語：almost finished (快完成了)、almost never (幾乎從不)。

example.en: Corporate sales are expected to continue their strong upward trend throughout the coming quarter.
example.zh: 預計在即將到來的季度中，企業銷售額將繼續保持強勁的上升趨勢。

words.mnemonic: 趨勢與合約延續動詞：continue to grow (持續成長)。
roots: tin 握住 → 連在一起持續

example.en: Company sales representatives will be stationed at our exhibition stand during the trade fair.
example.zh: 在貿易博覽會期間，公司業務代表將進駐我們的展覽攤位。

words.mnemonic: 展覽攤位名詞：exhibition stand；縮寫代表 stand for。

example.en: The chief executive commended the whole marketing team for their outstanding annual performance.
example.zh: 執行長讚揚了整個行銷團隊在年度的卓越表現。

words.mnemonic: 強調全員或完整期間：the whole team (整個團隊)、on the whole (整體而言)。

example.en: The final budget proposal has not yet been approved by the corporate finance committee.
example.zh: 最終預算提案尚未獲得企業財務委員會的核准。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：not yet (尚未)，搭配完成式；as yet (迄今)。

example.en: Corporate clients can secure preferential room rates by booking through our travel desk.
example.zh: 企業客戶透過我們的差旅服務台預訂，可鎖定優惠客房費率。

words.mnemonic: 旅館與金融超核心名詞：room rate (房價)、interest rate (利率)。

example.en: Our customer care center is committed to addressing every client complaint professionally.
example.zh: 我們的客戶關懷中心致力於專業地處理每一項客戶投訴。

words.mnemonic: 福利與服務考點：customer care (客戶關懷/客服)、health care (醫療保健)。

example.en: Financial analysts expect company profits to increase substantially over the coming fiscal year.
example.zh: 財務分析師預期公司利潤將在即將到來的會計年度大幅成長。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻句型：expect to do / expect someone to do (預期...做...)。
roots: spect 看 → 向外看、期待

example.en: The revised parking regulations will take effect starting on the first day of next month.
example.zh: 修訂後的停車管理辦法將自下個月第一天起正式生效。

words.mnemonic: 政策生效必背片語：take effect (生效)、have an effect on (對...產生影響)。
roots: fect 做 → 做出的結果

example.en: Automated sorting machines sort incoming courier packages by postal destination code.
example.zh: 自動分揀機依據郵遞目的地代碼對進廠快遞包裹進行分類。

words.mnemonic: 物流與郵務常考動作：sort packages (將包裹分類)。

example.en: This quarter recorded the highest customer satisfaction score we have ever achieved.
example.zh: 本季度創下了我們歷來所取得的最高客戶滿意度評分。

words.mnemonic: 最高級強調用語：the best... ever (史上最佳)。

example.en: Please let the support desk know if there is anything else we can do to assist you.
example.zh: 若有任何其他我們能為您提供協助的事項，請告知支援服務台。

words.mnemonic: 客服客氣詢問結尾句：Is there anything else I can help you with?

example.en: A power surge in the electrical grid caused a temporary shutdown of the assembly line.
example.zh: 電網中的電湧導致了組裝線的暫時停工。

words.mnemonic: 故障原因分析核心詞：cause a delay (導致延遲)。

example.en: Raw material costs are projected to fall by five percent over the upcoming autumn quarter.
example.zh: 預計在即將到來的秋季，原料成本將下降百分之五。

words.mnemonic: 指標下降動詞：prices fall (價格下跌)；亦可指秋季 (in the fall)。

example.en: Our purchasing director succeeded in closing a major supply deal with the overseas manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們的採購總監成功與海外製造商敲定了一筆重大供應協議。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重必考點：deal with (應對處理)、close a deal (達成交易)。

example.en: Complimentary bottled water and fresh fruit are provided in all guest rooms daily.
example.zh: 所有客房每天均提供免費瓶裝礦泉水與新鮮水果。

words.mnemonic: 飯店設施與辦公設備：bottled water (瓶裝水)、water cooler (飲水機)。

example.en: The billing clerk will send the updated commercial invoice to your accounting office today.
example.zh: 出納人員今天會將更新後的商業發票發送至您的會計室。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信與出貨核心動詞：send an email (寄信)、send an invoice (寄發票)。

example.en: The corporate policy allows full-time employees to take two days of personal leave each quarter.
example.zh: 企業政策允許全職員工每季享有兩天事假。

words.mnemonic: 規章政策句型：allow someone to do something (准許某人做某事)。

example.en: A customer service specialist will contact you as soon as your account inquiry is processed.
example.zh: 一旦您的帳戶洽詢處理完畢，客服專員將儘快與您聯絡。

words.mnemonic: 承諾回覆時間常用片語：as soon as possible (儘速)、coming soon (即將推出)。

example.en: All newly hired factory workers are required to watch an introductory workplace safety video.
example.zh: 所有新進工廠員工皆必須觀看一段職場安全簡介影片。

words.mnemonic: 在職訓練常用動詞：watch a video (觀看影片)；片語 watch out (小心)。

example.en: Annual sales commissions are calculated based on overall target revenue achievements.
example.zh: 年度業務佣金係根據整體目標營收達成率計算。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考分詞片語：based on (根據/以...為基礎)。

example.en: The product launch conference will probably be scheduled for the third week of September.
example.zh: 新產品發布會很可能會排定在九月的第三週舉行。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 3/4 討論不確定行程常用的猜測副詞。

example.en: The corporate consultant suggested that the firm streamline its logistics fulfillment operations.
example.zh: 企業顧問建議該公司應精簡其物流履約作業。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 題幹最愛問：What does the speaker suggest?
roots: gest 攜帶 → 從下提出

example.en: Corporate sales revenue has grown steadily over the past three fiscal quarters.
example.zh: 在過去的三個會計季度中，企業銷售額穩定成長。

words.mnemonic: 完成式關鍵時間介系詞片語：over the past three years (在過去三年中)。

example.en: A severe thunderstorm caused a sudden power outage that temporarily halted factory operations.
example.zh: 一場嚴重的雷陣雨導致突發停電，工廠作業因此暫時停擺。

words.mnemonic: 設備與能源重點詞彙：power outage (停電)、power plant (發電廠)。

example.en: Quality assurance technicians test each electronic component thoroughly before shipping.
example.zh: 品保技術人員在出貨前均會對每個電子組件進行徹底測試。

words.mnemonic: 產品品管必備動作：test products (測試產品)、field test (現場測試)。

example.en: Customers are warmly invited to visit our official company website for more promotional details.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎顧客造訪我們的官方公司網站以獲取更多促銷優惠詳情。

words.mnemonic: 宣傳與差旅常用動詞：visit our website (造訪我們的網站)。

example.en: The annual international software exhibition will take place at the city convention center.
example.zh: 年度國際軟體展覽會將在市立會展中心舉行。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻複合名詞：convention center (會展中心)、call center (電話客服中心)。

example.en: Our digital marketing initiative helped the company grow its international customer base significantly.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷計畫幫助公司顯著擴大了其國際客戶群。

words.mnemonic: 業績成長動詞：grow sales (提升銷售額)、grow rapidly (快速成長)。

example.en: The technician confirmed that there was nothing mechanically wrong with the office photocopier.
example.zh: 技術員確認辦公室影印機在機械結構上並無任何故障。

words.mnemonic: 排除故障時常用：nothing wrong (沒有問題/運作正常)。

example.en: Customers may return unworn apparel items within thirty days for a full credit refund.
example.zh: 顧客可在三十天內退還未穿戴的服飾商品以獲全額退款。

words.mnemonic: 退換貨政策核心詞：return policy (退貨政策)、return on investment (投資報酬率/ROI)。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits package includes paid leave for any working mother after childbirth.
example.zh: 該企業的員工福利套裝方案為產後職場職業婦女提供帶薪產假。

words.mnemonic: 員工育嬰福利：maternity leave (產假)、working mother (職業母親)。

example.en: The boutique downtown hotel is just a five-minute walk from the central subway station.
example.zh: 這家市中心精品飯店距離中央捷運站僅需步行五分鐘。

words.mnemonic: 飯店地理位置極高頻句型：a five-minute walk from (距...步行五分鐘)。

example.en: The executive director called an urgent meeting to resolve a confidential legal matter.
example.zh: 執行董事召開了一次緊急會議以解決一項機密的法律事項。

words.mnemonic: 商務公文常用片語：as a matter of fact (事實上)、legal matter (法律事項)。

example.en: Please keep in mind that office supply expense reports must be submitted before Friday.
example.zh: 請牢記在心，辦公文具費用報銷單必須在週五前繳交。

words.mnemonic: 多益必背片語：keep in mind (銘記在心)、Would you mind doing (您介意...嗎)。

example.en: We are proud to offer our commercial clients exceptional value and professional support.
example.zh: 我們非常自豪能為我們的企業客戶提供卓越的價值與專業的支援服務。

words.mnemonic: 商業評價核心詞：good value for money (物超所值)、market value (市場價值)。

example.en: Employees must scan their security identification badges before entering the corporate office.
example.zh: 員工在進入企業辦公室前必須先感應其安全識別證。

words.mnemonic: 多益最高頻場景：office supplies (辦公用品)、head office (總公司)。

example.en: The accounting division keeps an accurate electronic record of all commercial transactions.
example.zh: 會計部門對所有商務交易皆保存有精確無誤的電子紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 動詞 /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 記錄；名詞 /ˈrɛkərd/ 檔案紀錄：track record (過往績效紀錄)。

example.en: Hotel guests who extend their stay by two days will receive complimentary spa vouchers.
example.zh: 延長住宿兩天的飯店房客將可獲得免費水療抵用券。

words.mnemonic: 旅館住宿與狀態維持：stay at a hotel (住飯店)、stay informed (保持知悉)。

example.en: The enterprise is expanding its engineering workforce to meet growing demand for cloud services.
example.zh: 該企業正在擴大其工程人力團隊，以滿足對雲端服務日益增長的需求。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場最常考複合字：workforce (勞動力/全體員工)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: The express airport shuttle makes a brief passenger pickup stop outside terminal two.
example.zh: 機場快捷接駁車會在第二航廈外做短暫的旅客上車停靠。

words.mnemonic: 交通工具停靠：bus stop (公車站)；non-stop (直達的/不間斷的)。

example.en: The hiring committee interviewed several qualified candidates for the senior accounting position.
example.zh: 招募委員會面試了數名具備資歷的應徵者以填補資深會計職缺。

words.mnemonic: 修飾複數可數名詞：several times (好幾次)、several options (好幾個選項)。

example.en: Please ensure that all overhead office lights are switched off before locking up the building.
example.zh: 在鎖門離開大樓前，請確保所有辦公室頭頂照明皆已關閉。

words.mnemonic: 商務轉折短語：in light of (有鑑於...)；lightweight (輕量級的)。

example.en: Our software engineers worked diligently to develop a user-friendly mobile banking application.
example.zh: 我們的軟體工程師勤奮工作，以開發出一款操作簡便的手機網銀應用程式。

words.mnemonic: 研發核心動詞：develop a product (開發產品)、develop a plan (擬定計畫)。

example.en: Please remember to attach your itemized expense receipts when requesting travel reimbursement.
example.zh: 申請差旅費報銷時，請務必記得檢附逐項列記的支出收據。

words.mnemonic: 叮嚀句型必備：remember to do (記得去做某事)。

example.en: The final contract negotiations took a bit longer than originally anticipated by management.
example.zh: 最終的合約談判比管理層原先預期的時間稍微久了一點。

words.mnemonic: 副詞修飾片語：a bit (稍微/一點點)、bit by bit (循序漸進)。

example.en: Our new smartphone product line helped the enterprise expand its global market share.
example.zh: 我們的新智慧型手機產品線幫助企業擴大了其全球市場份額。

words.mnemonic: 商業金融大考點：market share (市占率)、shareholders (股東)。

example.en: The corporate expansion committee consulted an experienced real estate agency to locate new offices.
example.zh: 企業擴張委員會諮詢了一家經驗豐富的房地產經紀公司以尋找新辦公室。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業核心考點：real estate (不動產/房地產)。

example.en: Our customer service representatives strive to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 我們的客戶服務代表力求在響鈴三聲內接聽進線電話。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室電話與客服關鍵動詞：answer the phone (接聽電話)。

example.en: Meeting participants are invited to sit around the central conference table.
example.zh: 邀請與會者圍繞中央會議桌就座。

words.mnemonic: 會議就座用語：sit at a desk (坐在辦公桌前)、be seated (就座)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the latest sales figures during the executive briefing.
example.zh: 財務長在主管簡報會議上報告了最新的銷售數據。

words.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：sales figures (銷售數字)、figure out (想出/弄明白)。

example.en: Candidates must submit a cover letter and an updated resume to be considered for the position.
example.zh: 應徵者必須提交求職信與更新的履歷表方能列入該職位的考量。

words.mnemonic: 求職與推薦必備：cover letter (求職信)、letter of recommendation (推薦信)。

example.en: The board of directors will decide whether to approve the international merger proposal tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天決定是否核准該項跨國合併提案。

words.mnemonic: 決策核心動詞：decide to do (決定做某事)、decide on (決定選擇)。
roots: cide 切 → 切斷猶豫、決定

example.en: Fluency in a second foreign language is a definite advantage for our global marketing applicants.
example.zh: 精通第二外語對於應徵我們全球行銷職缺的求職者而言是一項顯著優勢。

words.mnemonic: 履歷專長必填欄位：foreign language (外語)、body language (肢體語言)。

example.en: Please write a concise and clear subject line when emailing client project updates.
example.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄送客戶專案進度時，請填寫簡潔明瞭的主旨欄。

words.mnemonic: 書信主旨與合約條件：subject line (郵件主旨)、subject to change (可能隨時變更)。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟在下面、受支配者

example.en: Corporate business executives traveling on flights over eight hours are eligible for business class.
example.zh: 搭乘飛行時間超過八小時航班的企業高階主管有資格搭乘商務艙。

words.mnemonic: 機票艙等考點：business class (商務艙)、first class (頭等艙)。

example.en: The enterprise invests heavily in professional employee development and technical training.
example.zh: 該企業大力投資於員工的專業發展與技術培訓。

words.mnemonic: 科技與人事專有名詞：research and development (研發/R&D)。

example.en: Our newly renovated flagship hotel is centrally situated in the historic section of town.
example.zh: 我們新裝修的旗艦飯店位於該城鎮歷史區的中心地帶。

words.mnemonic: 市中心核心字：downtown (市中心)、out of town (出城/不在本地)。

example.en: The airport shuttle departs from terminal two every half hour throughout the day.
example.zh: 機場接駁車全天每半小時自第二航廈發車一班。

words.mnemonic: 時間與財報考點：half an hour (半小時)、first half of the year (上半年)。

example.en: The executive secretary distributed the official meeting minutes to all committee members.
example.zh: 執行秘書向所有委員會成員分發了正式的會議紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：單數是「分鐘」，複數 meeting minutes 則是「會議紀錄」！

example.en: The corporate catering service provided exquisite food and beverages for the banquet.
example.zh: 企業外燴服務為晚宴提供了精緻的餐飲美食與飲料。

words.mnemonic: 活動餐飲詞彙：food and beverage (餐飲服務/F&B)、food court (美食街)。

example.en: Workshop attendees will enjoy a fifteen-minute coffee break before the afternoon session begins.
example.zh: 工作坊與會者將在下午會議開始前享受十五分鐘的咖啡茶歇時間。

words.mnemonic: 會議中場休息：coffee break (茶歇)、take a break (休息一下)。

example.en: The supervisor gave clear and direct instructions on how to file travel reimbursement claims.
example.zh: 主管對於如何申報差旅費報銷提出了清楚而直接的指示。

words.mnemonic: 清晰度與物流通關：make it clear (說明清楚)、clear customs (通關)。

example.en: We look forward to exploring mutually beneficial business opportunities in the near future.
example.zh: 我們期盼在不久的將來共同探討互利共贏的商業商機。

words.mnemonic: 書信客套結尾句：in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Invoices can be settled using either corporate credit cards or direct electronic wire transfers.
example.zh: 發票可以透過企業信用卡或直接電子電匯轉帳任一方式進行結清。

words.mnemonic: 二選一必考配對句型：either A or B (要麼A要麼B)。

example.en: The new regional warehouse facility became fully operational three months ago.
example.zh: 這座新的區域倉儲設施在三個月前已完全投入營運。

words.mnemonic: 過去式標誌時間副詞：three days ago (三天前)。

example.en: The parking garage charges four dollars per hour during standard business daytime hours.
example.zh: 該停車場在一般日間營業時段每小時收費四美元。

words.mnemonic: 計算單位與依據：per hour (每小時)、as per your request (依照您的要求)。

example.en: Despite severe economic market fluctuations, our net operating margins remained strong.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的經濟市場波動，我們的營業淨利率依然維持強勁。

words.mnemonic: 狀態維持動詞：remain competitive (保持競爭力)、remain seated (請保持就坐)。

example.en: Ensuring workplace physical safety remains the top priority of factory plant management.
example.zh: 確保工作場所的人身安全始終是工廠廠房管理層的首要之務。

words.mnemonic: 第一優先與高階管理：top priority (最高優先)、top management (高層管理)。

example.en: Our lightweight laptop was ranked among the top three models in terms of battery efficiency.
example.zh: 我們的輕量筆記型電腦在電池續航力效能方面名列前三名之列。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法三者以上群體比較：among + 複數名詞 (在...之中)。

example.en: The architectural firm worked diligently to win the commercial design bid for the airport.
example.zh: 該建築事務所勤奮耕耘以贏得機場的商業設計招標標案。

words.mnemonic: 得標與獲獎常用：win a contract (贏得合約)、win an award (獲獎)。

example.en: The corporate brochure will be printed in full color on premium recycled glossy paper.
example.zh: 企業簡介手冊將在高級環保回收銅版紙上進行全彩印刷。

words.mnemonic: 印刷與商品規格常用片語：in full color (全彩印刷)。

example.en: The office relocation project will involve close coordination between all department heads.
example.zh: 辦公室搬遷專案將涉及所有部門主管之間的密切協調。

words.mnemonic: 專案範疇與參與度動詞：be involved in (參與其中)。

example.en: You can reach our technical support desk by dialing the toll-free customer hotline.
example.zh: 您可以透過撥打免付費客戶專線聯絡到我們的技術支援台。

words.mnemonic: 通訊聯絡與達成協議：reach someone by phone (以電話聯絡某人)、reach an agreement (達成協議)。

example.en: Our digital marketing team launched an advertising campaign across multiple social media platforms.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷團隊在多個社群媒體平台上推出了一場廣告宣傳活動。

words.mnemonic: 數位行銷極高頻詞：social media (社群媒體)、social event (社交聚會)。

example.en: Newly recruited software developers will undergo a mandatory three-month probationary period.
example.zh: 新進軟體開發人員將接受為期三個月的強制性試用期。

words.mnemonic: 試用期與保固期名詞：probationary period (試用期)、warranty period (保固期)。

example.en: Our courier logistics network operates distribution fulfillment centers across the country.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流網路在全國各地營運多座配送履約中心。

words.mnemonic: 遍及全球與全國常見介系詞：across the country / across the globe。

example.en: Please note that the corporate cafeteria will be temporarily closed for plumbing repairs.
example.zh: 請注意，企業員工餐廳將因水管維修而暫停營業。

words.mnemonic: 公告信函標準開頭提示語：Please note that (請注意...)。

example.en: Customers can view their complete past purchase and payment history via our online portal.
example.zh: 客戶可以透過我們的線上平台查閱其完整的過往採購與付款紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 帳戶紀錄考點：payment history (付款紀錄)、purchase history (購買歷史)。

example.en: Opening the new manufacturing plant will create over two hundred local employment jobs.
example.zh: 開設新製造廠將創造兩百多個在地就業工作機會。

words.mnemonic: 招募與品牌動詞：create jobs (創造就業)、create opportunities (創造機會)。

example.en: The convention center is only a twenty-minute drive from the international airport terminals.
example.zh: 會展中心距離國際機場航廈僅需二十分鐘車程。

words.mnemonic: 距離描寫與商業驅動力：a short drive from (車程極短)、drive sales (帶動銷售)。

example.en: Please submit your completed job application along with two professional letters of recommendation.
example.zh: 請提交您填妥的求職申請表，連同兩封專業推薦信一併繳交。

words.mnemonic: 多益文件檢附必考片語：along with (連同...一起)。

example.en: What type of product warranty is included with the purchase of this commercial laptop?
example.zh: 購買這台商務筆記型電腦隨附何種保固類型？

words.mnemonic: 規格詢問常用：type of equipment (設備類型)。

example.en: The investment committee approved the financial plan, deeming it to be commercially sound.
example.zh: 投資委員會核准了該財務方案，認為其在商業上十分健全可行。

words.mnemonic: 商業決策形容詞：sound judgment (健全判斷)、sound strategy (穩健策略)。

example.en: Factory operators must wear protective eye goggles when inspecting precision welding machinery.
example.zh: 工廠操作人員在檢驗精密焊接機具時必須配戴防護護目鏡。

words.mnemonic: 工安保護與密切留意：eye protection (護目裝備)、keep an eye on (密切留意)。

example.en: The hotel lounge features relaxing live acoustic music every evening for registered guests.
example.zh: 飯店休閒酒廊每天傍晚為住宿房客帶來令人放鬆的原聲現場音樂演奏。

words.mnemonic: 休閒娛樂與背景音樂：background music (背景音樂)、live music (現場音樂)。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness committee organized a friendly weekend softball game.
example.zh: 企業員工身心健康委員會在週末籌辦了一場友誼壘球比賽。

words.mnemonic: 員工聯誼社交活動：team-building game (團隊凝聚團康遊戲)。

example.en: International trade analysts monitored political developments that could affect cross-border tariffs.
example.zh: 國際貿易分析師密切監控可能影響跨境關稅的政治局勢發展。

words.mnemonic: 總體商業環境評估：political climate (政治氛圍)、political stability (政治穩定)。

example.en: Registered seminar attendees will receive a free informational copy of our research handbook.
example.zh: 報名參加研討會的與會者將可免費獲贈一本我們的研究指南參考手冊。

words.mnemonic: 促銷贈送最常用字：free of charge (免費)、toll-free (免付費電話)。

example.en: Customers will receive an automated shipping confirmation email once their parcel is dispatched.
example.zh: 包裹一旦寄出，顧客將收到一封自動出貨確認電子郵件。

words.mnemonic: 商務收件必備動詞：receive an email (收信)、receive payment (收到款項)。

example.en: Please hold for just a moment while I check the inventory availability in our main warehouse.
example.zh: 在我在主倉庫查詢庫存現貨之際，請稍候片刻。

words.mnemonic: 電話客氣等待語：just a moment (請稍候片刻)、at the moment (目前)。

example.en: Our annual clearance sale offers up to forty percent off selected retail clothing items.
example.zh: 我們的年度清倉特賣會針對精選零售服飾商品提供高達六折的優惠。

words.mnemonic: 多益銷售考點：on sale (特價中)、for sale (供出售)、clearance sale (清倉拍賣)。

example.en: The company has a strict privacy policy.
example.zh: 請遵守公司的差旅規定。

words.mnemonic: 公司正式規定。

example.en: If you require any further assistance regarding your account, please do not hesitate to contact us.
example.zh: 若您對您的帳戶需要任何進一步的協助，請隨時與我們聯絡。

words.mnemonic: 商務信件結尾高頻詞：until further notice (直到另行通知)、further information (進一步資訊)。

example.en: The core recommendations of the proposal are explained in the main body of the document.
example.zh: 提案的核心建議已在文件的正文主體中詳細說明。

words.mnemonic: 書信結構與組織機構：body of the letter (信件正文)、governing body (理事機構)。

example.en: The position requires two years of experience.
example.zh: 該職位需要兩年工作經驗。

words.mnemonic: 比 need 正式。
roots: quir 尋求 → 一再要求

example.en: Passengers traveling on delayed flights are invited to wait in the airline executive lounge.
example.zh: 搭乘延誤航班的旅客獲邀至航空公司貴賓候機室等候。

words.mnemonic: 候車室與等待搭配：wait for (等待...)、waiting room (候診室/等候區)。

example.en: The annual general meeting of corporate shareholders will be held in London next month.
example.zh: 企業股東常年大會將於下個月在倫敦舉行。

words.mnemonic: 職稱與大會專有名詞：general manager (總經理)、annual general meeting (AGM, 股東常會)。
words.roots: gener 種類、全體 + -al 形容詞

example.en: The promotional discount will automatically appear on your electronic checkout screen.
example.zh: 促銷折扣將會自動顯示在您的電子結帳畫面上。

words.mnemonic: 顯示與看似動詞：appear to be (似乎是)。

example.en: All employee contributions will go toward funding our corporate charitable sustainability projects.
example.zh: 所有員工捐款將全數用於資助我們的企業慈善永續發展專案。

words.mnemonic: 目標導向介系詞：work toward a goal (朝著目標努力)。

example.en: Our creative marketing team collaborated with outside consultants to design the advertising campaign.
example.zh: 我們的創意行銷團隊與外部顧問通力合作，以規劃設計該廣告宣傳企劃。

words.mnemonic: 職場核心名詞：team member (團隊成員)、team leader (組長)。

example.en: Our newly launched mobile portal makes it easy for clients to track their shipments in real time.
example.zh: 我們新推出的行動平台讓客戶能夠輕鬆即時追蹤其貨物運送狀態。

words.mnemonic: 產品特色描述句型：make it easy to do (使...變得容易/簡便)。

example.en: The training program is customized to meet the unique learning needs of each individual employee.
example.zh: 該培訓計畫量身打造，以滿足每位個別員工獨特的學習需求。

words.mnemonic: 個人化與客製化：individual needs (個別需求)、individual contribution (個人貢獻)。
roots: -ual 形容詞 → 不可再分的

example.en: The corporate client received a full refund after their shipment was accidentally damaged in transit.
example.zh: 在貨件於運輸途中意外受損後，企業客戶獲得了全額退款。

words.mnemonic: 人事與退款高頻詞：full refund (全額退款)、full-time employee (全職員工)。

example.en: Thanks to rigorous budget management, the enterprise operated comfortably in the black this quarter.
example.zh: 歸功於嚴謹的預算管理，該企業本季度穩健處於獲利盈餘狀態。

words.mnemonic: 多益商務隱喻大考點：in the black (獲利/有盈餘)，與 in the red (虧損) 相反！

example.en: From an operational perspective, it makes commercial sense to automate repetitive invoice entries.
example.zh: 從營運角度來看，將重複性的發票登錄作業自動化在商業上十分合理可行。

words.mnemonic: 商務提案合理性片語：make sense (合乎邏輯/有道理)。

example.en: Perhaps we should reschedule the project review meeting to allow more time for data collection.
example.zh: 也許我們應該將專案審核會議改期，以預留更多資料收集的時間。

words.mnemonic: 會議中提出委婉建議時的常用句首副詞。

example.en: The developer added several advanced encryption features to the cloud software platform.
example.zh: 開發者在雲端軟體平台中增添了數項高階加密功能。

words.mnemonic: 附加功能與補充片語：add value (增添價值)、in addition to (除了...之外)。

example.en: All factory operators must strictly abide by workplace safety rules while on the assembly line.
example.zh: 所有工廠作業員在組裝線上作業時均必須嚴格遵守職場安全規則。

words.mnemonic: 守規矩常考搭配：follow the rules / obey the rules (遵守規則)。

example.en: All conference delegates must display their official security pass to enter the main auditorium.
example.zh: 所有研討會代表必須出示其正式安全通行證以進入主禮堂。

words.mnemonic: 證件與測驗名詞/動詞：boarding pass (登機證)、pass an inspection (通過檢驗)。

example.en: The newly upgraded manufacturing facility can produce over ten thousand units per day.
example.zh: 新升級的製造廠每天可生產超過一萬件產品。

words.mnemonic: 動詞 /prəˈduːs/ (製造)；名詞 /ˈprɑːduːs/ (農產品，如 fresh produce)。
roots: duc 引導 → 引出、生產

example.en: Retail stores sell surplus seasonal inventory at discounted clearance rates during January.
example.zh: 零售店在元月份期間以優惠的清倉折價販售剩餘的當季庫存。

words.mnemonic: 熱賣常用詞：sell out (售罄/賣光)、bestseller (暢銷商品)。

example.en: The supervisor held a short orientation meeting to introduce newly recruited staff to the team.
example.zh: 主管舉行了一次簡短的培訓會議，將新進員工介紹給團隊。

words.mnemonic: 多益常見時間與人力短缺片語：short-term (短期)、short on staff (人手短缺)。

example.en: Both contracting parties agreed to the amended delivery timetable proposed by the manufacturer.
example.zh: 雙方締約方皆同意製造商所提出的修訂出貨時程表。

words.mnemonic: 商務協議核心動詞：agree on terms (同意條款)、agree to a proposal (同意提案)。

example.en: The corporate legal counsel ensures that all regional business contracts comply with labor laws.
example.zh: 企業法律顧問確保所有區域商務合約皆符合勞動法規。

words.mnemonic: 商務法務名詞：comply with the law (遵守法律)、law firm (法律事務所)。

example.en: The executive administrative assistant ensured that everything was prepared for the board meeting.
example.zh: 執行行政助理確保董事會會議的一切準備工作皆已就緒。

words.mnemonic: 全體事項準備就緒用語：everything is ready (一切就緒)。

example.en: Extensive consumer market research was conducted prior to unveiling our new electric vehicle.
example.zh: 在發表我們的新型電動車之前，進行了廣泛的消費者市場研究。

words.mnemonic: 研發與市調必考詞：market research (市場調查)、conduct research (進行研究)。

example.en: The company's comprehensive travel policy will cover all standard lodging and meal expenses.
example.zh: 公司的差旅管理辦法將涵蓋支付所有標準住宿與膳食費用。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考法：cover expenses (支付費用)、cover letter (求職信)。

example.en: The office administrator ordered ten boxes of recycled printer paper for the copy room.
example.zh: 辦公室管理員為影印室訂購了十箱環保再生印表機紙張。

words.mnemonic: 辦公用紙與無紙化辦公：paperless office (無紙化辦公室)、paper trail (書面追蹤紀錄)。

example.en: Over fifty qualified applicants submitted resumes for the managerial position in accounting.
example.zh: 五十多名具備資歷的求職者為會計部主管職位投遞了履歷。

words.mnemonic: 求職招募核心字：apply for a position (應徵職位)、fill a position (補齊職缺)。

example.en: The flagship corporate hotel is located near the city center and convenient transportation links.
example.zh: 這間企業旗艦飯店坐落於市中心與便利的交通轉運節點附近。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與辦公室選址片語：near the airport (靠近機場)、in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Candidates should forward their updated credentials directly to the human resources department.
example.zh: 應徵者應將其更新的資歷直接發送至人力資源部。

words.mnemonic: 多益最高頻部門名稱：Human Resources (HR 人資部)。

example.en: The information technology division installed new security antivirus software on every office computer.
example.zh: 資訊科技部門在每台辦公室電腦上安裝了全新的防毒安全軟體。

words.mnemonic: 辦公科技詞彙：computer software (電腦軟體)、computer system (電腦系統)。

example.en: Customer service management took prompt action to resolve the difficult billing dispute situation.
example.zh: 客戶服務主管採取了迅速行動，以妥善化解棘手的帳單爭議處境。

words.mnemonic: 應對狀況詞彙：win-win situation (雙贏局面)、handle a situation (處理狀況)。

example.en: All administrative staff members are required to attend the mandatory corporate compliance seminar.
example.zh: 所有行政員工皆必須參加強制性企業法規遵從研討會。

words.mnemonic: 多益最核心集合名詞：staff meeting (員工會議)、staff member (職員)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department organized a series of team-building activities this weekend.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部在本週末籌辦了一系列團隊凝聚活動。

words.mnemonic: 促銷與團隊凝聚用語：promotional activity (宣傳活動)、team-building activity (團隊凝聚活動)。

example.en: The creative advertising agency produced a promotional documentary film to introduce the brand.
example.zh: 這家創意廣告公司製作了一部宣傳紀錄短片以向大眾介紹該品牌。

words.mnemonic: 影音宣傳常見詞：training film (培訓影片)、promotional film (宣傳短片)。

example.en: The annual corporate executive strategy briefing will begin at nine in the morning.
example.zh: 年度企業高階主管策略簡報將於上午九點開始。

words.mnemonic: 會議時程高頻詞：morning meeting (早會)、in the morning (在上午)。

example.en: A fierce price war between competing budget airlines reduced regional ticket fares considerably.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司之間激烈的價格戰大幅降低了區域機票票價。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業比喻經典詞彙：price war (價格戰)。

example.en: Clients can log into their online corporate banking account to review pending invoices.
example.zh: 客戶可以登入其線上企業網銀帳戶以審查待處理發票。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重必考點：bank account (銀行帳戶)、account for (占...比例/說明原因)。

example.en: Consumers can shop for discounted office furniture online or visit our downtown showroom.
example.zh: 消費者可以在線上選購打折辦公家具，亦可親臨我們的市中心展示門市。

words.mnemonic: 購物與展示中心：gift shop (禮品店)、online shopping (線上購物)。

example.en: Securing the government infrastructure contract was a major achievement for our construction firm.
example.zh: 拿下政府公共工程合約是我們營造公司的一項重大成就。

words.mnemonic: 重大突破常用詞：major client (主要客戶)、major factor (主要因素)。

example.en: If you require emergency technical assistance after business hours, someone will answer your call.
example.zh: 若您在下班時間後需要緊急技術協助，將會有專人接聽您的電話。

words.mnemonic: 客服待命服務描寫詞：someone will assist you (會有專人協助您)。

example.en: All employees should comply with the health and safety regulations stated in the manual above.
example.zh: 所有員工皆應遵守上述手冊中所陳述的健康與安全規章。
