words.mnemonic: 文件引用最常考短語：as mentioned above (如上所述)、all of the above (以上皆是)。

example.en: Our creative team finalized the modern visual design for the corporate annual report.
example.zh: 我們的創意團隊為企業年度報告定稿了現代化的視覺設計。

words.mnemonic: 研發與行銷高頻詞：graphic design (平面設計)、design team (設計團隊)。
roots: sign 記號 → 畫下記號

example.en: The international trade gala is expected to be the premier networking event of the year.
example.zh: 國際商貿晚會預計將成為今年最首屈一指的商務交流盛會。

words.mnemonic: 公關活動與突發狀況：in the event of (萬一發生/在...情況下)。

example.en: Subscribers who renew their annual software licenses today receive a special promotional discount.
example.zh: 今日續訂年度軟體授權的訂閱用戶可獲享一項專案促銷折扣。

words.mnemonic: 廣告文宣高頻搭配：special offer (特別優惠)、special occasion (特殊場合)。

example.en: Severe crosswinds sometimes cause temporary passenger boarding delays at the coastal airport.
example.zh: 強烈的側風有時會導致該沿海機場暫時發生旅客登機延誤。

words.mnemonic: 頻率副詞常客，描寫偶發性維修或延遲。

example.en: Customers must review the warranty terms and conditions carefully before completing the transaction.
example.zh: 顧客在完成交易前必須仔細審閱保固條款與各項條件。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約與二手品必備：terms and conditions (條款與條件)、in good condition (狀況良好)。

example.en: Our downtown department store does not currently carry that particular brand of laptop.
example.zh: 我們的市中心百貨公司門市目前並未販售那一款特定品牌的筆記型電腦。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 3/4 超愛考：carry 除了攜帶，商場情境常指「販售/備有商品」！

example.en: Online shoppers can choose from three secure payment options at the checkout portal.
example.zh: 線上購物顧客可以在結帳入口網站中從三種安全的付款選項中進行選擇。

words.mnemonic: 選購動詞：choose between A and B (在A與B之間做選擇)。

example.en: The corporate parental leave policy grants paid leave to any new father following childbirth.
example.zh: 該企業的育嬰假政策為孩子出生後的每位新手父親提供帶薪陪產假。

words.mnemonic: 員工育兒與福利政策：paternity leave (陪產假)。

example.en: The corporate executive board reached a unanimous decision to expand into Latin American markets.
example.zh: 企業執行董事會一致做出擴張進軍拉丁美洲市場的決定。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業決策超核心片語：make a decision (做決策)、reach a decision (達成決定)。

example.en: Please reserve a private dining table for six clients at the hotel restaurant tonight.
example.zh: 今晚請在飯店餐廳為六位客戶預訂一張獨立私人用餐餐桌。

words.mnemonic: 餐廳訂位與會議圖表：reserve a table (預約餐桌)、table of contents (目錄)。

example.en: Promotional discounts are applicable only to certain designated electronic merchandise items.
example.zh: 促銷折扣僅適用於某些指定的電子商品項目。

words.mnemonic: 限制條款常見用法：under certain conditions (在特定條件下)。

example.en: We sincerely look forward to establishing a productive business partnership with your firm.
example.zh: 我們由衷期盼能與貴公司建立富有成效的商業合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: 多益信件最經典結尾句型：look forward to + V-ing (期盼...)；forward an email (轉寄郵件)。

example.en: The main entrance to the corporate headquarters is equipped with electronic badge scanners.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓的主入口處配備有電子感應掃描機。

words.mnemonic: 設施與要點必備形容詞：main entrance (大門/主入口)、main office (總辦公室)。

example.en: If the laptop battery happens to die during the presentation, connect the emergency AC power cord.
example.zh: 簡報時筆記型電腦電池若碰巧沒電耗盡，請立即接上緊急交流電源線。

words.mnemonic: 電子設備電力耗盡商務情境：battery died (電池沒電了)。

example.en: According to the export contract, the vendor will bear all shipping and customs insurance costs.
example.zh: 依據出口合約約定，賣方將承擔所有的運費與海關保險費用。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約高頻商務搭配：bear the cost (負擔費用)、bear responsibility (承擔責任)。

example.en: Management decided to cut operating expenses by fifteen percent this fiscal quarter.
example.zh: 管理層決定在這一會計季度中將營運費用削減百分之十五。

words.mnemonic: 多益財報常見搭配：cut costs (削減成本)、budget cut (預算刪減)。

example.en: The brochure clearly describes the unique features and specifications of our new software.
example.zh: 這份宣傳手冊清楚地描述了我們新軟體的獨特功能與規格。

words.mnemonic: 字根 scrib/script 表「寫/描述」，如 description (說明)。
roots: scrib 寫 → 寫下來、描述

example.en: The chief executive officer himself attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new facility.
example.zh: 執行長本人親自出席了新廠房的剪綵典禮。

words.mnemonic: 強調主詞親自出席或執行：by himself (獨自/親自)。

example.en: The manager is available after lunch.
example.zh: 會議室目前空著可使用。

words.mnemonic: available = ready to be used。

example.en: Our new mobile application is especially popular among younger business professionals.
example.zh: 我們的新行動應用程式在年輕商務專業人士之間特別受歡迎。

words.mnemonic: 加強焦點副詞，突出特定受眾或特定情境。

example.en: The company reported strong financial growth across all international retail divisions.
example.zh: 該公司各國際零售部門均呈現出強勁的財務增長。

words.mnemonic: 財報與人才能力常用：strong growth (強勁成長)、strong candidate (優秀人選)。

example.en: Online sales revenue is expected to rise sharply during the upcoming holiday shopping season.
example.zh: 預計線上銷售額將在即將到來的假日購物季中大幅上升。

words.mnemonic: 多益不規則動詞 (rise, rose, risen)，為不及物動詞，主詞自發上升。

example.en: The corporate foundation sponsored educational science workshops for young girls in local schools.
example.zh: 企業基金會為當地學校的年輕女童資助了教育科學工作坊。

words.mnemonic: 企業社會責任 (CSR) 與公益贊助活動常考字彙。

example.en: Maybe we should schedule a follow-up consultation before finalizing the vendor contract.
example.zh: 也許我們應該在敲定供應商合約之前安排一次後續諮詢會議。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 3/4 會議討論中提出委婉建議時常用句首詞。

example.en: The enterprise actively supports the local community through volunteer mentorship initiatives.
example.zh: 該企業透過志工導師培訓倡議，積極支持在地社區發展。

words.mnemonic: 企業永續與社區公關：community outreach (社區關懷推廣)。

example.en: Please contact technical support if anyone else in your department experiences network issues.
example.zh: 若您部門內有其他任何人遇到網路問題，請與技術支援聯絡。

words.mnemonic: 代名詞搭配：anyone else (任何人)、anything else (其他任何事)。

example.en: The client inquired about the shipping availability of that particular model of laser printer.
example.zh: 客戶洽詢了那一款特定型號雷射印表機的出貨供應情況。

words.mnemonic: 片語大考點：in particular (特別是/尤其)。

example.en: Effective communication plays a vital role in successful cross-functional project management.
example.zh: 有效的溝通在成功的跨部門專案管理中扮演著至關重要的角色。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場閱讀極高頻片語：play an important role in (扮演要角)。

example.en: We are thrilled to announce that Mr. Davis will join our executive leadership team next Monday.
example.zh: 我們非常榮幸地宣布，戴維斯先生將於下週一加入我們的高階主管團隊。

words.mnemonic: 新進員工公告必備動詞：join the company / join the team。

example.en: Navigating currency exchange fluctuations made international financial planning difficult.
example.zh: 因應匯率波動使得國際財務規劃變得相當棘手困難。

words.mnemonic: 問題描述形容詞：difficult situation (困難局面)、difficult task (艱鉅任務)。

example.en: Please remember to sign the visitor log before proceeding to the executive conference room.
example.zh: 在前往高階主管會議室之前，請務必記得在訪客登記簿上簽名。

words.mnemonic: 多益公文指示最標準句首：Please note that... (請注意...)。

example.en: The project coordinator will explain the specific implementation details during tomorrow's session.
example.zh: 專案協調員將在明天的會議中詳細說明具體的實施細節。

words.mnemonic: 多益必背片語：in detail (詳細地)、contact details (聯絡資訊)。

example.en: The sales representative explained the key functional differences between the two smartphone models.
example.zh: 業務代表解釋了這兩款智慧型手機機型之間的主要功能差異。

words.mnemonic: 片語大考點：make a difference (產生重大影響)、difference between (兩者之差)。

example.en: Management must take prompt corrective action to address the supply chain disruption.
example.zh: 管理層必須立即採取矯正行動以解決供應鏈中斷問題。

words.mnemonic: 高頻職場搭配：take action (採取行動)、action plan (行動方案)。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness program includes comprehensive dental and health insurance coverage.
example.zh: 企業員工健康福利計畫涵蓋了全面的牙科與健康醫療保險保障。

words.mnemonic: 員工福利核心詞：health insurance (健保)、health and safety (工安衛生)。

example.en: Seminar participants may eat lunch in the hotel dining hall or visit nearby local restaurants.
example.zh: 研討會與會者可在飯店宴會餐廳享用午餐，亦可造訪附近的在地餐館。

words.mnemonic: 生活與差旅餐飲動詞；片語 eat out (外出用餐)。

example.en: The human resources department outlined three simple steps for submitting online vacation requests.
example.zh: 人力資源部列出了線上提交休假申請的三個簡易步驟。

words.mnemonic: 標準作業流程 (SOP) 關鍵詞：step-by-step (逐步地)、take steps (採取措施)。

example.en: The independent auditing firm confirmed that the financial statements represent a true reflection of assets.
example.zh: 獨立審計事務所確認該財務報表如實反映了資產真實狀況。

words.mnemonic: 如實反映常用詞：come true (成真/實現)、true copy (與正本相符的副本)。

example.en: Please feel free to reach our customer care hotline by phone during regular business hours.
example.zh: 歡迎在一般營業時間內透過電話撥打我們的客戶關懷專線。

words.mnemonic: 通訊工具：phone call (通話)、by phone (透過電話)。

example.en: Department managers must familiarize themselves with the updated workplace safety regulations.
example.zh: 部門主管必須親自熟悉最新修訂的職場安全法規。

words.mnemonic: 反身代名詞片語：by themselves (獨自)、familiarize themselves with (使自己熟悉)。

example.en: The international technology trade fair is expected to draw over ten thousand business delegates.
example.zh: 這場國際科技博覽會預計將吸引上萬名商務代表參與。

words.mnemonic: 多益常考「吸引注意/人潮」：draw attention to (吸引注意)、draw a conclusion (得出結論)。

example.en: The recruitment agency specializes in placing qualified white-collar administrative professionals.
example.zh: 這家人力顧問公司專門為合資格的白領行政專業人員媒合職缺。

words.mnemonic: 職場職場族群：white-collar worker (白領族/上班族)。

example.en: Passengers who need to modify their departure date may do so online without penalty fees.
example.zh: 需要修改出發日期的旅客可於線上辦理，無需繳納罰金。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻時效片語：up to date (最新的)、out of date (過時的)、due date (到期日)。

example.en: Adopting sustainable environmental practices helps our factory decrease energy consumption.
example.zh: 採取永續環境常規做法有助於我們的工廠降低能源消耗。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業常考「常規/最佳實踐」：best practices (最佳實務)。

example.en: The newly released laser printer model prints twenty percent faster than previous versions.
example.zh: 新發布的雷射印表機型號列印速度比先前的版本快了百分之二十。

words.mnemonic: 產品與商業模式：business model (商業模式)、latest model (最新型號)。

example.en: The startup company launched an equity offering to raise capital for overseas factory expansion.
example.zh: 這家新創公司發行股權以籌措海外擴廠所需的資本資金。

words.mnemonic: 及物動詞 (raise something)；搭配 raise funds (募資)、raise prices (提高售價)。

example.en: Delivering exceptional customer service is the cornerstone of our corporate retail philosophy.
example.zh: 提供卓越的客戶服務是我們企業零售經營哲學的基石。

words.mnemonic: 多益最核心單字：customer service (客服)、customer satisfaction (客戶滿意度)。
roots: -er 做…的人 → 慣常來買的人

example.en: Hotel guests may collect their complimentary airport shuttle passes directly at the front desk.
example.zh: 飯店房客可直接在接待櫃檯領取免費機場接駁車乘車證。

words.mnemonic: 接待必備片語：front desk (櫃檯/接待處)、in front of (在...前面)。

example.en: The project supervisor will explain the upgraded software installation procedure step by step.
example.zh: 專案主管將逐步說明升級後的軟體安裝程序。

words.mnemonic: 溝通動詞：explain something to someone (向某人解釋某事)。
roots: plain 平坦 → 攤平說明

example.en: Emergency exit doors must remain completely unobstructed by boxes or pallets at all times.
example.zh: 緊急逃生安全門在任何時候皆絕不得被紙箱或棧板阻擋妨礙。

words.mnemonic: 工安設施標誌：emergency exit door (緊急出口門)、next door (隔壁)。

example.en: Taxis and private car pickups are available directly outside terminal arrival gate four.
example.zh: 計程車與自用小客車接送處就設在航廈第四抵達登機門的正外面。

words.mnemonic: 指示方位介系詞：outside the building (在大樓外)。

example.en: Because of component shipment delays, the assembly schedule is currently two days behind schedule.
example.zh: 由於零組件出貨延遲，組裝進度目前落後排程兩天。

words.mnemonic: 專案時程必考片語：behind schedule (落後進度)，反義詞為 ahead of schedule。

example.en: Industry analysts shared their projections regarding global economic growth during the seminar.
example.zh: 產業分析師在研討會中分享了他們對全球經濟成長的預測。

words.mnemonic: 多益常見經濟名詞搭配：economic growth (經濟成長)、economic crisis (經濟危機)。
words.roots: eco 家 + nom 管理 → 家計之學

example.en: The corporate executive committee conducted an on-site inspection of the new manufacturing facility.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會對新製造廠進行了現場實地檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：on-site (在現場的)、construction site (施工工地)、web site (網站)。

example.en: The marketing team adopted a customer-centric approach to increase long-term brand loyalty.
example.zh: 行銷團隊採取了一種以客戶為中心的方法，以提升長期的品牌忠誠度。

words.mnemonic: 商業策略常客：innovative approach (創新方法)、approach a problem (著手處理問題)。

example.en: The corporation hired a certified language teacher to conduct business English classes for staff.
example.zh: 該企業聘請了一位專業認證的語言教師為員工開設商務英文課程。

words.mnemonic: 企業在職進修講師：language teacher (語言教師)、training instructor (培訓講師)。

example.en: The commercial charter flight is scheduled to land at Frankfurt International Airport at two.
example.zh: 這架商業包機預定於下午兩點降落在法蘭克福國際機場。

words.mnemonic: 班機降落：the plane landed on time (飛機準時降落)；口語 land a job (贏得好工作)。

example.en: Ms. Liu is the senior executive in charge of international procurement and logistics operations.
example.zh: 劉女士是負責國際採購與物流運營的高階主管。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻片語：in charge of (負責主管)、free of charge (免費)。

example.en: After weeks of intense negotiations, both parties finally signed the commercial partnership agreement.
example.zh: 在歷經數週的密集談判後，雙方終於簽署了商業夥伴協議。

words.mnemonic: 轉折與歷程副詞，表示久等後的最終成果。

example.en: Both corporate directors met in the executive boardroom to sign the five-year supply contract.
example.zh: 兩位企業董事在高階主管董事會會議室會面，正式簽署了為期五年的供應合約。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業必背搭配：sign a contract (簽約)、sign in/up (簽到/報名)。

example.en: Passengers whose luggage was delayed may file an official baggage claim at the airline counter.
example.zh: 行李延誤的旅客可在航空公司服務櫃檯提出正式行李索賠。

words.mnemonic: 機場與保險大考點：baggage claim (行李提領處)、file an insurance claim (申請保險理賠)。

example.en: Our sales team is committed to maintaining a strong and transparent relationship with all suppliers.
example.zh: 我們的銷售團隊致力於與所有供應商保持穩固而透明的合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: 公關與商務拓展：business relationship (業務合作關係)。

example.en: Corporate employees who travel on official business are reimbursed according to company policy.
example.zh: 因公出差的企業員工依據公司政策享有費用報銷待遇。

words.mnemonic: 多益出差考點：travel agency (旅行社)、travel expense (差旅費)。

example.en: Registered rewards members enjoy complimentary access to the hotel fitness center and sauna.
example.zh: 註冊會員可免費享用飯店健身休閒中心與三溫暖設施。

words.mnemonic: 會員權益文宣標準動詞：enjoy discounts (享有折扣)。

example.en: The corporate comprehensive life insurance policy provides financial support in the event of death.
example.zh: 企業綜合人壽保險保單在員工不幸身故時提供財務撫恤保障。

words.mnemonic: 員工撫卹與團保名詞：accidental death (意外身故保險)。

example.en: The boutique waterfront hotel provided a very nice atmosphere for the annual networking gala.
example.zh: 這間濱水精品飯店為年度人脈交流晚會提供了非常舒適美好的氛圍。

words.mnemonic: 評價環境或待人親切常用詞：have a nice stay (祝您住宿愉快)。

example.en: The invoice clearly states the total amount due including applicable shipping and handling fees.
example.zh: 發票上明確載明了應付總金額，包含適用的運費與處理費。

words.mnemonic: 修飾不可數名詞或款項：amount of money (金額)、total amount (總額)。

example.en: The company plans to improve service quality.
example.zh: 我們希望提升客戶滿意度。

words.mnemonic: 常接能力或品質。

example.en: High-resolution pictures of our latest product line are available in the online press kit.
example.zh: 我們最新產品線的高解析度照片已備置於線上媒體新聞發布資料包中。

words.mnemonic: 行銷圖片與總體情勢：take a picture (拍照)、the big picture (整體大局)。

example.en: The sporting goods company launched an apparel marketing campaign targeting active teenage boys.
example.zh: 這家體育用品公司推出了一場鎖定活躍青少年族群的運動服飾行銷宣傳。

words.mnemonic: 服飾銷售與公眾慈善常見客群名詞。

example.en: I am writing to inquire about your company's latest policy with regard to remote work arrangements.
example.zh: 我特此致函，就貴公司有關遠距工作安排的最新政策進行洽詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益公文兩大王牌：with regard to (關於/就...而言)、Best regards (祝好/信末敬上)。

example.en: Our international charitable organization relies on corporate sponsorships to fund disaster relief.
example.zh: 我們的國際慈善組織仰賴企業贊助來籌措災難救助資金。

words.mnemonic: 非營利機構常客：non-profit organization (NPO, 非營利組織)。

example.en: We would be very happy to arrange a private demonstration of the software at your convenience.
example.zh: 在您方便之際，我們將非常樂意為您安排該軟體的專屬示範操作。

words.mnemonic: 客氣商業書信常用：be happy to do something (樂意做某事)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested a couple of extra days to finalize the environmental report.
example.zh: 專案主管請求多給幾天額外時間以定稿環境評估報告。

words.mnemonic: 極高頻口語時間片語：a couple of days (幾天時間)。

example.en: Corporate management must act promptly to investigate employee reports of software piracy.
example.zh: 企業管理層必須迅速採取行動以調查員工回報的軟體盜版情事。

words.mnemonic: 行動與代理職責：act as (擔任/充當)、act promptly (迅速行動)。

example.en: Our downtown showroom features a wide range of ergonomic office furniture and accessories.
example.zh: 我們的市中心展示門市陳列了各色各樣符合人體工學的辦公家具與配件。

words.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：a wide range of (種類繁多的/廣泛的)。

example.en: Our manufacturing plant is renowned for producing exceptionally high quality electronic components.
example.zh: 我們的製造廠以生產極高品質的電子零組件而享譽業界。

words.mnemonic: 品質保證核心字：quality control (品管/QC)、high quality (高品質)。

example.en: The senior project manager scheduled a weekly review meeting to monitor construction milestones.
example.zh: 資深專案經理安排了一次每週檢討會以監督工程里程碑。

words.mnemonic: 專案管理必備：project manager (專案經理)、manage a project (管理專案)。
roots: ject 丟 → 向前拋出的計畫

example.en: Business travelers booked round-trip airline tickets between New York and London.
example.zh: 商務旅客預訂了往返紐約與倫敦之間的來回機票。

words.mnemonic: 機票與面試大考點：round-trip ticket (來回機票)、first round of interviews (第一輪面試)。

example.en: This international internship offers a valuable opportunity to gain professional experience.
example.zh: 這次國際實習提供了一個獲取專業實務經驗的寶貴機會。

words.mnemonic: 求職與商務必背：job opportunity (工作機會)、equal opportunity (平等機會)。
roots: -unity 名詞 → 順風抵港的時機

example.en: The city transportation department announced scheduled road maintenance near the conference hall.
example.zh: 市交通局宣布了會展中心附近定時進行的道路維護施工。

words.mnemonic: 商旅出差常用：on the road (出差奔波在途)。

example.en: According to the corporate travel policy, all lodging expenses must be approved in advance.
example.zh: 依據企業差旅管理辦法，所有住宿費用皆必須事先獲得核准。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀出題頻率最高片語：according to (根據/依據)。

example.en: Please check the attached price list for discounted corporate software license rates.
example.zh: 請查閱附件價目表以了解優惠的企業軟體授權費率。

words.mnemonic: 商業文具清單：price list (價目表)、waiting list (候補名單)。

example.en: If you wish to cancel or modify your conference registration, please notify us before Friday.
example.zh: 若您希望取消或更改研討會報名，請於週五前通知我們。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信客氣表達：if you wish to do something (如果您希望做某事)。

example.en: Severe storms delayed incoming component shipments; therefore, factory assembly was postponed.
example.zh: 強烈暴風雨延誤了零組件的進口運輸；因此，工廠組裝作業被迫延後。

words.mnemonic: 因果推論副詞，引出必然的結論或相應處置措施。

example.en: All factory visitors must wear hard hats and protective goggles inside the production facility.
example.zh: 所有工廠訪客在生產廠房內皆必須配戴安全帽與防護護目鏡。

words.mnemonic: 多益工安服儀規定：wear a badge (配戴識別證)、wear and tear (正常磨損)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee approved additional funds to expand our research laboratory.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會核准了額外資金以擴充我們的研發實驗室。

words.mnemonic: 金融資助核心詞：raise funds (籌募資金)、mutual fund (共同基金)。

example.en: The team finished the initial design phase and will complete the rest of the project next month.
example.zh: 團隊完成了初期設計階段，將於下個月完成該專案的其餘部分。

words.mnemonic: 剩餘事務常用片語：the rest of (其餘的/剩下的)。

example.en: The family resort hotel provides dedicated recreational play areas for guests traveling with kids.
example.zh: 該家庭度假飯店為帶兒童出遊的旅客提供專門的休閒娛樂遊憩區。

words.mnemonic: 休閒飯店與親子方案常客：kids club (兒童俱樂部)。

example.en: Our corporation has established itself as an innovative leader in the renewable energy industry.
example.zh: 我們企業已建立起自身在再生能源產業中創新領航者的地位。

words.mnemonic: 產業地位描述：industry leader (產業龍頭)、industry standard (業界標準)。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits policy includes tuition reimbursement for continuing education.
example.zh: 企業員工福利政策包含了在職進修教育的學費補助報銷。

words.mnemonic: 在職進修考點：continuing education (進修教育)、higher education (高等教育)。

example.en: Factory management implemented strict security measures to prevent unauthorized data access.
example.zh: 工廠管理層落實了嚴格的安全措施以防範未經授權的資料存取。

words.mnemonic: 落實措施搭配：take measures (採取措施)、preventive measure (預防措施)。

example.en: The executive committee decided to kill the unprofitable project due to rising supply expenses.
example.zh: 執行委員會因供應成本攀升而決定終止這項不賺錢的專案。

words.mnemonic: 多益商務口語常考：kill a project / kill a deal (終止專案/取消交易)。

example.en: The hotel restaurant will serve a complimentary continental breakfast between six and nine.
example.zh: 飯店餐廳將在六點至九點之間供應免費的歐陸式早餐。

words.mnemonic: 餐廳供餐與任職：serve breakfast (供應早餐)、serve as manager (擔任經理)。

example.en: The proposed corporate tax reform is likely to impact second quarter capital investments.
example.zh: 擬議的企業稅改法案很有可能會對第二季度的資本投資產生影響。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻句型：be likely to + 原形動詞 (很有可能做某事)。

example.en: Our support department will certainly investigate your billing inquiry without any delay.
example.zh: 我們的支援部門必定會毫不延誤地深入調查您的帳單問題。

words.mnemonic: 肯定承諾回應詞：Certainly, I can help you with that。

example.en: Our logistics network provides fast and reliable national delivery across the contiguous states.
example.zh: 我們的物流網絡在全美相鄰各州提供迅速且可靠的全國貨物配送服務。

words.mnemonic: 全國性範圍：national holiday (國定假日)、national conference (全國年會)。

example.en: The automated software updates itself every Sunday evening during off-peak network hours.
example.zh: 該自動化軟體每週日傍晚離峰時段會自我進行自動更新。

words.mnemonic: 事物本身反身代名詞：in itself (本身而言)。

example.en: Experienced systems engineers will teach newly recruited developers how to utilize the internal framework.
example.zh: 資深系統工程師將指導新進開發者如何使用內部開發架構。

words.mnemonic: 內部培訓動作動詞：teach someone how to do something。

example.en: The applicant possesses over fifteen years of distinguished professional experience in the field of telecommunications.
example.zh: 該應徵者在電信領域擁有超過十五年傑出的專業資歷。

words.mnemonic: 專業範疇與外勤：in the field of (在...領域)、field service (外勤維修服務)。

example.en: All passengers must pass through airport security checkpoints prior to boarding flights.
example.zh: 所有旅客在登機之前皆必須通過機場安全檢查關卡。

words.mnemonic: 安全設施大考點：security badge (識別證)、security checkpoint (安檢處)。

example.en: Corporate business packages include discounted air travel fares with our commercial airline partners.
example.zh: 企業商務套裝方案包含我們商業合作航空公司提供的折扣航空機票價格。

words.mnemonic: 航空與空調常用字：air freight (空運)、air conditioning (空調冷氣)。

example.en: Employees receive health benefits.
example.zh: 新政策為全體員工帶來好處。

words.mnemonic: 想成工作帶來的好處。

example.en: Our marketing delegation will host a promotional booth at the upcoming international trade expo.
example.zh: 我們的行銷代表團將在即將舉行的國際貿易博覽會上設置宣傳攤位。

words.mnemonic: 商貿展覽必備：trade show / trade fair (商展)、free trade (自由貿易)。

example.en: Companies should implement robust cybersecurity protocols to reduce the risk of sensitive data breaches.
example.zh: 企業應實施穩健的網路安全協定以降低敏感資料外洩的風險。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業風險管理搭配：risk management (風險管理)、at risk (面臨風險)。

example.en: The corporate communications team issued a news release regarding the company merger today.
example.zh: 企業公關傳播團隊今日針對公司合併事宜發布了一份新聞稿。

words.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：news release / press release (新聞稿)。

example.en: All electronic components manufactured in our plant meet international environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 我們工廠製造的所有電子組件皆符合國際環境安全標準。

words.mnemonic: 符合標準搭配動詞：meet standards (符合標準)、safety standard (安全標準)。

example.en: Shareholders will vote on the proposed corporate merger during the extraordinary general meeting.
example.zh: 股東將在特別股東大會上對擬議的企業合併案進行投票表決。

words.mnemonic: 股東大會動詞：vote on (就...進行表決)、vote in favor of (投票贊成)。

example.en: Corporate fourth-quarter online sales increased by twenty percent compared to last year.
example.zh: 企業第四季度線上銷售額與去年同期相比增長了百分之二十。

words.mnemonic: 財報與業績描寫標準詞：twenty percent (20%)、percent off (折扣)。

example.en: Our upcoming marketing presentation will focus on expanding brand reach in international markets.
example.zh: 我們即將進行的行銷簡報將聚焦於拓展品牌在國際市場上的知名度。

words.mnemonic: 簡報主旨必備片語：focus on (專注於/聚焦於)。

example.en: The prototype device is currently undergoing thorough field testing in the developmental stage.
example.zh: 該原型設備目前正在開發階段進行徹底的現場實測。

words.mnemonic: 專案週期用語：developmental stage (開發階段)、early stage (初期階段)。

example.en: The new headquarters building features ample desk space and modern collaborative meeting areas.
example.zh: 新總部大樓設有充裕的辦公桌空間與現代化的協同會議區。

words.mnemonic: 辦公與停車空間：office space (辦公空間)、parking space (停車位)。

example.en: Employees are encouraged to utilize digital invoices instead of printing paper copies.
example.zh: 鼓勵員工採用電子發票，而非列印紙本收據。

words.mnemonic: 替代方案極高頻介系詞片語：instead of (而不是/代替)。

example.en: The firm was able to realize substantial cost savings after migrating data to the cloud.
example.zh: 在將資料遷移至雲端後，該公司實現了可觀的成本節約。

words.mnemonic: 多益商務常考「實現節省/獲利」：realize cost savings / realize a profit。

example.en: Standard retail orders placed before noon are usually processed and dispatched on the same day.
example.zh: 在中午前下達的一般零售訂單通常會在同一天處理並發貨。

words.mnemonic: 日常業務運作頻率副詞：as usually done (如通常所做)。

example.en: Our IT department conducts regular nightly backups to ensure company data remains completely secure.
example.zh: 我們的資訊科技部每晚定期進行備份，以確保公司資料絕對安全。

words.mnemonic: 資訊科技核心字：data security (資料安全)、data entry (資料登錄)。

example.en: The boutique downtown hotel offers modern single rooms tailored for solo business travelers.
example.zh: 這間市中心精品飯店提供專為單人商務旅客量身打造的現代化單人房。

words.mnemonic: 飯店房型與單一事項：single room (單人房)、single day (單一天)。

example.en: The customer relations director convened an emergency briefing to address client service complaints.
example.zh: 客戶關係主管召開了緊急簡報會議以處理客戶的服務投訴。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：名詞 /ˈædrɛs/ (地址)；動詞 /əˈdrɛs/ (著手處理/演說)。

example.en: Annual employee salary bonuses are determined based on overall quarterly performance reviews.
example.zh: 年度員工薪資獎金係根據每季的整體績效考核結果核定。

words.mnemonic: 職場考核核心詞：performance review (績效考核)、high performance (高效能)。

example.en: Attending the trade exhibition provides an excellent chance to network with regional suppliers.
example.zh: 出席這場商貿展覽會提供了一個與區域供應商建立人脈的絕佳機會。

words.mnemonic: 機會表達常用：have a chance to (有機會做某事)、by chance (偶然地)。

example.en: The boutique hotel accepts all major corporate credit cards and direct mobile electronic payments.
example.zh: 這間精品飯店接受所有主要企業信用卡以及直接手機電子支付。

words.mnemonic: 付款與錄取核心詞：accept payment (接受付款)、accept a job offer (接受錄取)。

example.en: Our engineering staff attended the annual technical convention organized by the Chemical Society.
example.zh: 我們的工程人員出席了由化學學會主辦的年度技術年會。

words.mnemonic: 專業組織名稱：professional society (專業學會/公會)。

example.en: Investing in modern cloud computing technology allows the enterprise to scale operations smoothly.
example.zh: 投資現代雲端運算科技使該企業能夠平穩地擴大營運規模。

words.mnemonic: 高科技與資通訊核心詞：information technology (IT, 資訊科技)。

example.en: During this morning's briefing, the director mentioned that quarterly earnings surpassed expectations.
example.zh: 在今天上午的簡報中，總監提及季度盈餘已超出原先預期。

words.mnemonic: 書信與會議客套：as mentioned above (如上所述)、not to mention (更不用說)。

example.en: The corporate cafeteria provides healthy vegetarian choices alongside traditional meal options.
example.zh: 企業員工餐廳在傳統餐點選項之外，亦提供健康的素食選擇。

words.mnemonic: 選購常用片語：make a choice (做選擇)、have no choice (別無選擇)。

example.en: Switching to automated electronic billing will save the corporate office thousands of dollars annually.
example.zh: 改採自動化電子帳單每年將為企業辦公室節省數千美元。

words.mnemonic: 節約與存檔動詞：save money (省錢)、save time (省時)、save a file (存檔)。

example.en: Please consult the user guide to troubleshoot common technical problems with the laser printer.
example.zh: 請參閱使用指南以排除雷射印表機常見的技術問題。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻片語：have in common (具有共同點)、common practice (慣例)。

example.en: Our corporation actively cultivates a collaborative workplace culture that values diversity and inclusion.
example.zh: 我們企業積極培養重視多元與包容的團隊協同企業文化。

words.mnemonic: 人資面試核心詞：corporate culture / company culture (企業文化)。

example.en: The invoice clearly displays the total price including state tax and standard ground freight.
example.zh: 發票上清楚標示了包含州稅與標準陸運運費在內的總價格。

words.mnemonic: 結帳與發票必備詞：total amount (總金額)、in total (總共)。

example.en: The manufacturing plant boosted production capacity to meet growing global demand for solar panels.
example.zh: 製造廠提高了產能以因應全球對太陽能板日益增長的需求。

words.mnemonic: 供需法則核心考點：supply and demand (供需)、in high demand (需求量大)。

example.en: All raw materials purchased for production must meet our stringent environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 所有為生產所採購的原料均必須符合我們嚴格的環境安全標準。

words.mnemonic: 製造原料與會議資料：raw material (原料)、promotional material (宣傳資料)。
words.roots: mater 母親、物質 + -ial 形容詞

example.en: The corporate finance policy imposes a strict expenditure limit on employee entertainment expenses.
example.zh: 企業財務政策對員工交際應酬費用設定了嚴格的報銷支出上限。

words.mnemonic: 上限名詞搭配：credit limit (信用額度上限)、time limit (時間限制)。

example.en: Customer service representatives are trained to listen attentively to client feedback and grievances.
example.zh: 客戶服務代表受過專業培訓，能專注傾聽客戶的反饋與申訴。

words.mnemonic: 傾聽動詞搭配：listen to (聆聽/聽取)。

example.en: The vendor invoice is due within thirty days from the official billing date shown on top.
example.zh: 供應商發票自上方所載正式出帳日起算三十天內到期應付。

words.mnemonic: 多益出題率超高單字：due date (截止日/到期日)、due to (由於/因為)。

example.en: If you discover something wrong with your invoice calculation, contact billing support immediately.
example.zh: 若您發現發票計算有任何錯誤，請立即與帳務支援部門聯繫。

words.mnemonic: 故障與錯誤反饋：go wrong (出差錯)、wrong number (打錯電話)。

example.en: The waterfront conference center is easily accessible on foot from all downtown hotels.
example.zh: 從市中心所有飯店出發，皆可輕鬆步行前往濱水會議中心。

words.mnemonic: 交通距離考點：on foot (步行)、square feet (平方英尺，房產面積)。

example.en: The successful rollout of the software platform was the result of a dedicated team effort.
example.zh: 該軟體平台的成功推出是團隊全心全力努力的成果。

words.mnemonic: 團隊合作核心片語：team effort (團隊努力)、make an effort (做出努力)。

example.en: Please pay close attention to the safety briefing before entering the automated manufacturing plant.
example.zh: 在進入自動化製造廠房之前，請密切注意安全簡報內容。

words.mnemonic: 多益公文兩大用法：pay attention to (注意)、信封上的 Attn: (收件人親啟)。

example.en: Detailed travel brochures and city transit maps will be provided upon arrival at the hotel.
example.zh: 抵達飯店後，即會提供詳細的旅遊簡介手冊與市區交通地圖。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業正式介系詞片語：upon arrival (一抵達就)、upon request (應客戶要求)。

example.en: Hotel guests may check in at the front reception desk starting at three in the afternoon.
example.zh: 飯店房客可於下午三點開始在接待櫃檯辦理入住登記手續。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與機場大考點：check in (報到/入住)、check out (結帳退房)、pay by check (開支票付款)。

example.en: All job applicants must complete the online questionnaire before scheduling an interview.
example.zh: 所有應徵者在安排面試之前均必須填妥線上問卷調查。

words.mnemonic: 行政填表常用詞：complete a form (填妥表格)；形容詞 complete set (整套)。

example.en: The key to our commercial success lies in our relentless commitment to product quality.
example.zh: 我們商業成功的關鍵在於我們對產品品質堅持不懈的承諾。

words.mnemonic: 說明核心要素動詞：lie in (在於...)。

example.en: The corporate shuttle bus will pick up conference attendees outside the central train station.
example.zh: 企業接駁巴士將在中央火車站外接送研討會與會人員。

words.mnemonic: 交通與取件極高頻片語：pick up (接送/提貨)、pick and choose (挑選)。

example.en: Installing modern energy-saving lighting helped the enterprise reduce electricity expenses significantly.
example.zh: 安裝現代節能照明設備幫助該企業顯著降低了電費支出。

words.mnemonic: 成本控制核心動詞：reduce costs (降低成本)、reduce waste (減少浪費)。
roots: duc 引導 → 引回、減少

example.en: Employees may utilize their personal laptops for remote work provided they install security software.
example.zh: 員工若安裝了安全防護軟體，即可使用個人筆記型電腦進行遠距辦公。

words.mnemonic: 隱私與人事：personal belongings (個人隨身物品)、personal computer (PC 個人電腦)。

example.en: Orders qualifying for standard ground transportation are typically delivered within three business days.
example.zh: 符合標準陸路運輸條件的訂單通常會在三個工作天內送達。

words.mnemonic: 物流與樓層必考：ground shipping / ground freight (陸運)、ground floor (一樓/地面層)。

example.en: The resort hotel enforces a strict policy prohibiting domestic animals inside guest rooms.
example.zh: 該度假飯店嚴格落實客房內全面禁止攜帶寵物家畜的規定。

words.mnemonic: 飯店禁令公告常考詞彙：service animal (導盲犬/服務性動物)。

example.en: The international flight from Tokyo is scheduled to arrive at terminal two on time.
example.zh: 來自東京的國際班機預定準時抵達第二航廈。

words.mnemonic: 交通準點高頻搭配：arrive on time (準時抵達)、arrive at the airport (抵達機場)。

example.en: Customer care representatives should remain patient and polite when addressing billing complaints.
example.zh: 客戶關懷專員在處理帳單申訴時應始終保持耐心與禮貌。

words.mnemonic: 客服品質形容詞：be patient with (對...有耐心)。

example.en: Under current company financial guidelines, travel entertainment expenditures require prior approval.
example.zh: 依據目前的企業財務規範，差旅應酬支出皆需事先報准。

words.mnemonic: 當前狀態指標詞：current position (現職)、current market conditions (當前市場行情)。

example.en: The manufacturing enterprise celebrated over a century of precision engineering innovation.
example.zh: 該製造企業慶祝了其在精密工程創新領域走過一個多世紀的輝煌歷程。

words.mnemonic: 百年老店品牌宣傳常用：over a century of excellence (百年卓越)。

example.en: The audit committee found clear documentary evidence of accounting compliance across all subsidiaries.
example.zh: 審計委員會在所有子公司中皆發現了符合會計合規規範的明確文件證據。

words.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：clear evidence (明確證據)、evidence to support (支持...的證據)。
roots: vid 看 → 看得出來的證據

example.en: Strict regulatory safeguards exist to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive client databases.
example.zh: 現行制度中存在著嚴格的監管防護機制，以防止敏感客戶資料庫遭到未授權存取。

words.mnemonic: 存在動詞，衍生名詞 existence (存在)、形容詞 existing (現有的)。
roots: sist 站 → 站出來存在

example.en: Our new smartphone model delivers performance features similar to those of competitor devices.
example.zh: 我們的新款智慧型手機機型提供與競爭對手機型相仿的性能特點。

words.mnemonic: 比較規格必考片語：similar to (與...相似)。

example.en: Retail businesses must fight aggressively to maintain their market presence against online competitors.
example.zh: 實體零售商家必須積極奮戰，以對抗線上競爭對手並保住市場份額。

words.mnemonic: 市場抗衡比喻用語：fight for market share (爭奪市占率)。

example.en: Our enterprise is recognized as a global industry leader in renewable clean energy technology.
example.zh: 我們企業獲公認為全球再生乾淨能源科技領域的產業龍頭。

words.mnemonic: 商業地位經典搭配：industry leader (產業龍頭)、market leader (市場領導者)。

example.en: Drivers who fail to display a valid parking permit will be subject to a fifty-dollar fine.
example.zh: 未出示有效停車許可證的駕駛將會被處以五十美元的罰款。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：名詞「罰款」pay a fine；形容詞「精細的」fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: Our flagship retail store is centrally located across the street from the subway station.
example.zh: 我們的旗艦零售門市位於捷運站正對面的街角黃金地段。

words.mnemonic: 地址方位必備：across the street (在街對面)、on the street (在街上)。

example.en: The keynote address was delivered by the former president of the national trade association.
example.zh: 開幕主題演講由前任全國商貿協會會長親自發表。

words.mnemonic: 人事異動與履歷常見：former employee (前任員工)、the former (前者)。

example.en: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team if you require additional information.
example.zh: 若您需要進一步資訊，請隨時與我們的客戶支援團隊聯繫。

words.mnemonic: 多益書信結尾最標準動詞：contact us (與我們聯絡)、contact person (聯絡窗口)。

example.en: The new ergonomic office chairs are particularly comfortable during long working hours.
example.zh: 這款全新人體工學辦公椅在長時間工作期間格外舒適耐坐。

words.mnemonic: 程度副詞，強調特定優點：particularly useful (格外有用)。

example.en: Corporate employees may extend healthcare insurance coverage to their husband or wife.
example.zh: 企業員工得將其醫療健康保險保障範圍擴大涵蓋其配偶夫或妻。

words.mnemonic: 員工家庭福利條款常見詞彙：spouse (配偶) 或 husband and wife。

example.en: The corporate employee recreation club sponsors annual amateur sport leagues for staff members.
example.zh: 企業員工育樂社團每年為同仁資助籌辦業餘體育聯賽。

words.mnemonic: 休閒福利與零售：sporting goods (體育用品)、sports club (體育俱樂部)。

example.en: Please prepare the materials before the meeting.
example.zh: 她為會議準備了簡報資料。

words.mnemonic: prepare for + 事件。

example.en: Department heads will meet tomorrow morning to discuss the quarterly expenditure budget.
example.zh: 部門主管將於明天上午會面以商討季度支出預算。

words.mnemonic: 及物動詞，後面直接接受詞！千萬不要加 about (discuss the plan)。
roots: cuss 搖、敲 → 拆開討論

example.en: Our support center guarantees an email response within twenty-four hours of receiving an inquiry.
example.zh: 我們的客服支援中心保證在收到洽詢後的二十四小時內給予電子郵件答覆。

words.mnemonic: 公文必考搭配：in response to (為了回應...)、quick response (快速回覆)。

example.en: Please leave a detailed message on my corporate voicemail if I am away from my desk.
example.zh: 若我不在辦公座位前，請在我的企業語音信箱中留下詳細留言。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室通訊必考字：voicemail (語音信箱)、voice mail message (語音留言)。

example.en: The facility manager ordered several new pieces of ergonomic office equipment for staff.
example.zh: 廠房主管為員工訂購了數件全新的人體工學辦公設備器材。

words.mnemonic: 量詞大考點：a piece of advice (一則建議)、a piece of equipment (一件設備)。

example.en: The engineering team worked overtime to finish the software upgrade ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 工程團隊加班趕工以提前完成軟體系統升級作業。

words.mnemonic: 工作完工動詞，後接名詞或 V-ing：finish doing something。

example.en: All employees are supposed to wear their photo identification badges inside the building.
example.zh: 所有員工在大樓內部均應當配戴其照片身分識別證。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場規章必考句型：be supposed to + 原形動詞 (理應/應該要)。
roots: pos 放置 → 放在下面假設

example.en: Interested candidates should apply online before the official submission deadline on Friday.
example.zh: 有興趣的應徵者應在週五官方截止日期前完成線上求職申請。

words.mnemonic: 多益兩大王牌搭配：apply for a job (應徵工作)、apply to (適用於)。
roots: ply 折、貼 → 貼向、申請

example.en: The company president delivered an inspiring opening address at the annual trade summit.
example.zh: 公司總裁在年度商貿高峰會上發表了鼓舞人心的開幕致詞。

words.mnemonic: 高階管理層職稱：vice president (副總裁/副總)、company president (公司總裁)。

example.en: All factory workers must participate in the mandatory building fire safety evacuation drill.
example.zh: 所有工廠員工皆必須參與大樓強制性的消防安全疏散演習。

words.mnemonic: 工安演習名詞：fire drill (消防演習)、fire alarm (火災警報器)。

example.en: Corporate sales increased by eighteen percent compared to the same period last year.
example.zh: 企業銷售額與去年同期相比增長了百分之十八。

words.mnemonic: 財報最常考分詞片語：compared to / compared with (與...相比)。
roots: par 相等 → 放一起比

example.en: Shopping mall visitors can enjoy a wide variety of meals in the third-floor food court.
example.zh: 購物中心訪客可在三樓美食街享用各式各樣的餐飲美食。

words.mnemonic: 商場與商務情境常客：food court (美食街)、take to court (提告)。

example.en: Airport police officers patrol passenger terminal concourses around the clock for safety.
example.zh: 機場警官全天候在客運航廈大廳巡邏以確保旅客安全。

words.mnemonic: 維安保全用語：police officer (警官)、police department (警察局)。

example.en: Our new flagship department store will open its doors to retail shoppers next Friday.
example.zh: 我們全新的旗艦百貨門市將於下週五正式開門迎接零售購物顧客。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重用法：名詞「零售店」retail store；動詞「存放資料」store data。

example.en: The manufacturing plant replaced the aging conveyor belt due to poor operational efficiency.
example.zh: 由於運作效率低落不佳，製造廠更換了老化的輸送帶。

words.mnemonic: 品質評估反面詞：poor quality (劣質)、poor condition (狀況不佳)。

example.en: The technical support position requires sound practical knowledge of cloud networking systems.
example.zh: 該技術支援職位需要具備紮實的雲端網路系統實務知識。

words.mnemonic: 履歷要求詞彙：working knowledge of (對...具備實務知識)。

example.en: The motivational speaker shared humorous industry anecdotes that made the audience laugh.
example.zh: 激勵演講大師分享了幽默的產業趣聞，引得現場觀眾開懷大笑。

words.mnemonic: 社交會場氣氛描寫詞：make people laugh (引人發笑)。

example.en: Factory operators upgraded the robotic welding arm to improve manufacturing precision.
example.zh: 工廠作業員升級了自動化機械焊接手臂以提高製造精度。

words.mnemonic: 工廠自動化與家具配件：robotic arm (機械手臂)、armchair (單人扶手椅)。

example.en: Our boutique corporate hotel is conveniently situated in the very heart of the financial district.
example.zh: 我們的精品商務飯店坐落於金融商業區最繁華的正中心核心地帶。

words.mnemonic: 地理位置黃金片語：in the heart of (在...的正中心)。

example.en: Our restaurant chain partners with certified organic farms to source fresh culinary ingredients.
example.zh: 我們的連鎖餐廳與合格有機農場合作，以採購新鮮的烹飪食材原料。

words.mnemonic: 採購與能源來源：source of revenue (營收來源)、renewable energy source (再生能源)。

example.en: Every employee receives an identification card.
example.zh: 每位員工都有一張識別證。

words.mnemonic: employ 的人。

example.en: The senior project director will manage cross-departmental coordination for the new rollout.
example.zh: 資深專案總監將主導管理新產品推展的跨部門協調工作。

words.mnemonic: 管理核心動詞：manage a project (管理專案)、manage to do (設法辦成)。

example.en: To subscribe to our monthly newsletter, simply enter your email address into our web portal.
example.zh: 欲訂閱我們的每月電子通訊刊物，只需在我們的網站入口輸入您的電子郵件地址即可。

words.mnemonic: 促銷操作指示句首詞：Simply call / Simply visit (只需致電/只需造訪)。

example.en: Clients can settle corporate consulting invoices via electronic commercial bank transfers.
example.zh: 客戶可透過電子商業銀行轉帳方式結清企業顧問諮詢費發票。

words.mnemonic: 金融機構必考：bank account (銀行帳戶)、bank statement (對帳單)。

example.en: Our international consulting firm specializes in cross-border corporate mergers and acquisitions.
example.zh: 我們的國際顧問事務所專門提供跨國企業併購與重組顧問服務。

words.mnemonic: 專業機構常用名詞：law firm (律師事務所)、accounting firm (會計師事務所)。

example.en: Employees may reach their regional sales coordinators directly via work cell phone numbers.
example.zh: 員工可透過公務手機號碼直接聯絡其區域業務協調員。

words.mnemonic: 通訊工具核心字：cell phone (手機)。

example.en: A prominent trade publication recently featured an insightful article about our green technology.
example.zh: 一家知名行業出版物最近刊登了一篇深入報導我們綠色環保科技的專文。

words.mnemonic: 媒體報導與公文物品：magazine article (雜誌專文)、articles of agreement (合約條款)。

example.en: Our express courier guarantees fast and reliable nationwide parcel delivery within two business days.
example.zh: 我們的快捷快遞保證在兩個工作天內提供快速可靠的全國包裹送達服務。

words.mnemonic: 物流效率標籤：fast delivery (快速送達)、fast track (快速通道)。

example.en: The corporate cybersecurity division successfully blocked a malicious cyber attack on our server.
example.zh: 企業網路安全部門成功攔截阻擋了一起針對我們伺服器的惡意網路攻擊。

words.mnemonic: 現代資訊科技多益大考點：cyber attack (網路資安攻擊)。

example.en: International business analysts monitored sudden fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates.
example.zh: 國際商務分析師密切關注外國貨幣匯率的突然波動。

words.mnemonic: 跨國貿易考點：foreign currency (外幣)、foreign investment (外國投資)。

example.en: The management team arranged a surprise retirement celebration banquet for the chief engineer.
example.zh: 管理團隊為主任總工程師籌辦了一場驚喜退休慶祝晚宴。

words.mnemonic: 職場社交動態：surprise party (驚喜派對)、come as a surprise (令人感到意外)。

example.en: The updated smartphone application features an intuitive and streamlined user interface design.
example.zh: 這款更新後的智慧型手機應用程式以直覺且簡約的用戶介面設計為主要特色。

words.mnemonic: 產品規格文宣核心字：safety features (安全配備)、key feature (主要特點)。

example.en: Reliable customer technical service was cited as a major decisive factor in renewing the software contract.
example.zh: 可靠的客戶技術支援服務被列為續訂軟體合約的主要決定性因素。

words.mnemonic: 商業分析常用詞：deciding factor (決定性因素)、key factor (關鍵因素)。
words.roots: fact 做 → 促成結果的因素

example.en: Initial sales figures for our recently launched consumer electronics line were pretty impressive.
example.zh: 我們最近上市的消費性電子產品線初期銷售數據相當令人印象深刻。

words.mnemonic: 口語聽力程度修飾副詞：pretty good (相當不錯)。

example.en: The corporate executive committee recently appointed an experienced logistics consultant.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會最近聘任了一位經驗豐富的物流管理顧問。

words.mnemonic: 時態關鍵時間副詞：通常搭配現在完成式或過去式。

example.en: Severe winter weather disruptions could adversely affect international cargo delivery schedules.
example.zh: 嚴冬惡劣天候的中斷可能會對國際貨運航班的遞送時程產生不利影響。

words.mnemonic: 及物動詞 affect = have an effect on (影響)。

example.en: Wholesale raw material prices are projected to drop by five percent over the next quarter.
example.zh: 預計批發原料價格將在下一季度下跌百分之五。

words.mnemonic: 數值下降與快遞投遞：drop in price (價格下跌)、drop off (順道放下/投遞)。

example.en: According to a recent market survey, consumers increasingly prioritize sustainable product packaging.
example.zh: 根據最近的一份市場調查報告，消費者日益重視環保永續的產品包裝。

words.mnemonic: 調查與新聞標誌詞：recent survey (近期的調查)、recent years (近年來)。

example.en: The seminar agenda covers several critical topics related to international environmental compliance.
example.zh: 研討會議程涵蓋了數個與國際環保法規遵從密切相關的關鍵主題。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考分詞片語：related to (與...相關)。
roots: lat 攜帶 → 帶回關聯

example.en: All employees will receive an official written statement outlining the revised holiday schedule.
example.zh: 所有員工都將收到一份概述修訂後連假休假行事曆的正式書面公告。

words.mnemonic: 正式文件核心形容詞：official announcement (官方公告)、official website (官方網站)。

example.en: The corporate treasurer presented the annual audited financial report to international investors.
example.zh: 企業財務主管向國際投資人呈報了經審計的年度財務報告。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要主題詞：financial statement (財務報表)、financial analyst (財務分析師)。

example.en: Passengers who miss their connecting flight will be automatically rebooked on the next departure.
example.zh: 錯過轉機航班的旅客將會被自動重新改訂安排在下一班起飛班機上。

words.mnemonic: 錯過班機或截止日：miss a flight (錯過班機)、miss a deadline (錯過截止日)。

meaning: 先進工藝(state of the art)

example.en: Our newly constructed manufacturing plant is equipped with state of the art robotic assembly tools.
example.zh: 我們新建的製造廠房配備了最先進的機器人自動組裝工具。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業超級高頻考點：state of the art (最先進的/頂尖的)。

example.en: The marketing department launched an aggressive advertising campaign across national digital channels.
example.zh: 行銷部在全國各大數位傳播通路上發動了一場強勁的廣告促銷活動。

words.mnemonic: 商業行銷必背名詞：advertising campaign (廣告宣傳活動)、marketing campaign (行銷專案)。

example.en: Executive directors conducted their confidential contract negotiations in a private conference suite.
example.zh: 執行董事們在獨立私密的高階主管會議套房中進行了機密合約談判。

words.mnemonic: 公私部門對比：private sector (民營部門/私營企業)、private office (獨立私人辦公室)。
words.roots: priv 分開、個人 + -ate 形容詞

example.en: Factory technicians decided to pause the assembly line briefly to replace a worn drive belt.
example.zh: 工廠技術人員決定短暫暫停組裝流水線，以更換磨損的傳動皮帶。

words.mnemonic: 暫停中斷動詞：pause the video (暫停影片)、pause production (暫停生產)。

example.en: Everyone in the office is cordially invited to attend the annual employee recognition reception.
example.zh: 誠摯邀請辦公室的全體同仁出席年度優秀員工表揚茶會。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：everyone 作主詞時，動詞一律接「單數動詞」！

example.en: Please do not forget to submit your signed timesheet to the payroll department by Friday noon.
example.zh: 請不要忘記在週五中午前將您簽名確認的出勤工時表繳交至薪資核算部。

words.mnemonic: 備忘提醒句型：Don't forget to do (別忘了做某事)。

example.en: Clients can browse our full product catalog and request price quotes on our home page.
example.zh: 客戶可在我們的官方網站首頁上瀏覽完整產品目錄並索取報價。

words.mnemonic: 網路行銷與機場廣播：home page (首頁)、page a passenger (在機場廣播呼叫旅客)。

example.en: Do not worry if your original receipt is misplaced; our customer care team can look up the order.
example.zh: 若您的原始收據遺失請無需擔心，我們的客服關懷團隊可直接替您查詢該筆訂單。

words.mnemonic: 安撫客戶情緒常用句型：Don't worry about (不用擔心...)。

example.en: The corporate marketing department welcomes ten university interns during our annual summer program.
example.zh: 企業行銷部在我們的年度暑期實習計畫中熱烈歡迎十名大學生實習生。

words.mnemonic: 季節性招募與促銷：summer internship (暑期實習)、summer sale (夏季特賣)。

example.en: Complimentary cold drinks and light snacks will be served during the afternoon seminar break.
example.zh: 下午研討會茶歇期間將供應免費冰飲與精緻點心。

words.mnemonic: 招待餐飲詞彙：complimentary drink (免費招待飲料)、soft drink (無酒精汽水)。

example.en: We highly value your opinion and invite you to complete our brief customer feedback survey.
example.zh: 我們非常重視您的寶貴意見，並竭誠邀請您填寫我們簡短的客戶回饋問卷。

words.mnemonic: 問卷與會議表達：in my opinion (依我之見)、ask for an opinion (徵詢意見)。

example.en: Our new corporate technology headquarters is situated inside a modern green business park.
example.zh: 我們全新的企業科技總部座落於一座現代化的綠色商業園區內。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：business park / office park (商辦園區)；動詞 park a car (停車)。

example.en: Ms. Tanaka was selected to represent our regional marketing division at the Tokyo software summit.
example.zh: 田中女士獲選代表我們的區域行銷部門出席東京軟體高峰會。

words.mnemonic: 商業代表與發言：represent the company (代表公司)；衍生 sales representative (業務代表)。

example.en: Fostering client trust is the key factor that drives our corporate commercial expansion.
example.zh: 培養客戶信任是推動我們企業商務擴張的關鍵核心要素。

words.mnemonic: 簡報重點形容詞：key factor (關鍵因素)、keynote speaker (主講嘉賓)。

example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all corporate office complexes and manufacturing facilities.
example.zh: 所有企業辦公園區與生產廠房設施內部一律嚴格禁止吸菸。

words.mnemonic: 場所指示介系詞：inside the building (大樓內部)。

example.en: Ask the manager for assistance.
example.zh: 專案經理審核了時程表。

words.mnemonic: 管理 team 或 department。

example.en: Our marketing delegation will attend the upcoming international software trade conference in Berlin.
example.zh: 我們的行銷代表團將參加即將在柏林舉行的國際軟體貿易大會。

words.mnemonic: 字首 inter- 表「在...之間」，搭配 national 即國際間的。

example.en: The attached electronic spreadsheet contains detailed expenditure records for the second quarter.
example.zh: 隨附的電子試算表內含有第二季度的詳細支出紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 檔案與貨品內容描述動詞；名詞 container (貨櫃/容器)。

example.en: Did you notice the change in schedule?
example.zh: 請注意這項即將發生的變更。

words.mnemonic: 可表示注意到或公告。

example.en: I was wondering if the corporate accounting department has approved our travel reimbursement claim.
example.zh: 我想了解一下企業會計部門是否已經核准了我們的差旅報銷申請。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信客氣詢問開頭：I was wondering if... (不知是否能...)。

example.en: Due to the sensitive confidential nature of the project, all team members must sign non-disclosure agreements.
example.zh: 鑑於該專案敏感的保密性質，所有團隊成員皆必須簽署保密協定。

words.mnemonic: 多益正式商務公文搭配：by its nature (本質上)、confidential nature (機密性質)。

example.en: The executive board introduced a new organizational management structure to accelerate decision-making.
example.zh: 執行董事會推出了一項新的組織管理架構，以加速決策進行。

words.mnemonic: 公司組織與費率名詞：organizational structure (組織架構)、fee structure (收費結構)。

example.en: Please refer to the technical specifications section on page twelve of the user manual.
example.zh: 請參閱使用手冊第十二頁的技術規格區塊。

words.mnemonic: 文件與區域劃分詞彙：non-smoking section (禁菸區)、cross-section (橫切面)。

example.en: I will inspect the newly renovated corporate conference facility myself before the annual meeting.
example.zh: 在年度大會之前，我將親自視察全新裝修的企業會議設施。

words.mnemonic: 主詞強調用法：by myself (獨自)、see for myself (親自去看看)。

example.en: The invoice amount must match the approved purchase order estimate exactly before payment processing.
example.zh: 發票金額在撥款前必須與核准的採購訂單估算完全精準吻合。

words.mnemonic: 精確性副詞：not exactly (不完全是)、exactly what we need (正是我們需要的)。

example.en: Our manufacturing plant operates modern robotic assembly machinery twenty-four hours a day.
example.zh: 我們的製造廠房全天候二十四小時運作現代化的機器人組裝機具。

words.mnemonic: 多益工廠大考點：manufacturing plant (製造工廠)、power plant (發電廠)。

example.en: Contractors will paint the executive conference suites over the upcoming holiday weekend.
example.zh: 承包商將在即將到來的連假週末為高階主管會議套房進行粉刷。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室翻修告示常用：fresh paint (油漆未乾)、coat of paint (一層油漆)。

example.en: All factory workers must complete the mandatory occupational safety workshop before operating machinery.
example.zh: 所有工廠員工在操作機具前均必須完成強制性職業安全工作坊培訓。

words.mnemonic: 生產線人員：factory worker (工廠作業員)、office worker (辦公室職員)。

example.en: The corporate communications department issued a press release announcing the international merger.
example.zh: 企業公關傳播部門發布了一份新聞稿，正式宣布該跨國合併案。

words.mnemonic: 多益公關必考：press release (新聞稿)、press conference (記者會)。

example.en: Our customer support team will do whatever is necessary to resolve your technical billing issue.
example.zh: 我們的客戶支援團隊將竭盡所能採取一切必要措施以解決您的技術帳務問題。

words.mnemonic: 全力以赴常見句型：do whatever it takes / whatever is necessary。

example.en: Submitting valid purchase receipts is necessary for claiming corporate travel expense reimbursements.
example.zh: 檢附有效的購買收據對於申請企業差旅費報銷而言是必要的。

words.mnemonic: 政策與指令必備詞：if necessary (如果有必要的話)、necessary steps (必要步驟)。

example.en: Our logistics network expanded its rapid fulfillment delivery operations throughout the coastal region.
example.zh: 我們的物流網絡在整個沿海區域擴展了其快捷履約配送營運。

words.mnemonic: 地理營運劃分：in the region (在該地區)、regional office (區域辦公室)。

example.en: The enterprise experienced unprecedented annual revenue growth following our expansion into Asia.
example.zh: 在進軍亞洲市場後，該企業創下了前所未見的年度營收增長。

words.mnemonic: 財報最常考核心名詞：revenue growth (營收成長)、economic growth (經濟增長)。

example.en: The annual corporate networking gala banquet will commence at seven o'clock this evening.
example.zh: 年度企業人脈交流盛宴晚會將於今天傍晚七點整正式開始。

words.mnemonic: 社交宴會常用詞：this evening (今晚)、evening reception (晚間招待茶會)。

example.en: Emerging social media trends have a profound influence on modern consumer purchasing habits.
example.zh: 新興社群媒體趨勢對現代消費者的購買習慣產生了深遠的影響。

words.mnemonic: 影響力片語大考點：have an influence on (對...產生影響)。

example.en: In this respect, the newly proposed corporate travel policy offers greater financial flexibility.
example.zh: 在這一方面，新擬議的企業差旅管理辦法提供了更大的財務彈性。

words.mnemonic: 多益正式公文高頻短語：in this respect (在這一方面)、with respect to (關於)。
roots: spect 看 → 回頭看、尊敬

example.en: Our downtown commercial showroom displays various ergonomic desk models and office accessories.
example.zh: 我們的市中心商務展示門市陳列了各式各樣的人體工學桌型與辦公配件。

words.mnemonic: 修飾複數名詞：various options (多元選項)、for various reasons (基於各種原因)。

example.en: The sales director had to leave the presentation early to catch her scheduled flight to London.
example.zh: 業務總監不得不提早離開簡報會場，以便趕上她飛往倫敦的預定班機。

words.mnemonic: 交通轉乘大考點：catch a flight (趕班機)、catch a train (趕火車)。

example.en: Digital automated invoicing eliminates human data entry errors, thus reducing operational costs.
example.zh: 數位自動化開立發票消除了人工作業登錄錯誤，從而降低了營運成本。

words.mnemonic: 正式邏輯因果推論副詞：thus + V-ing (從而造成...)。

example.en: The technical management position requires strong leadership and interpersonal communication skills.
example.zh: 該技術管理職位要求具備卓越的領導力與人際溝通技能。

words.mnemonic: 履歷要求核心字：communication skills (溝通技能)、interpersonal skills (人際技巧)。

example.en: In an attempt to boost market share, the enterprise lowered retail prices on all electronics.
example.zh: 為了設法提升市場佔有率，該企業調降了所有電子產品的零售價格。

words.mnemonic: 商務目的片語：in an attempt to (為了設法/企圖做...)。

example.en: The founder transferred corporate executive leadership to his eldest son during the annual meeting.
example.zh: 創辦人在年度大會上將企業執行領導權移交給了他的長子。

words.mnemonic: 家族企業傳承名詞：family-owned business (家族企業)。

example.en: Our mobile application features a simple and user-friendly interface for tracking package deliveries.
example.zh: 我們的行動應用程式具有簡便且人性化的操作介面，方便追蹤包裹配送。

words.mnemonic: 易用性形容詞：simple to use (使用簡便)、keep it simple (保持簡單)。

example.en: The newly established grant program provides low-interest capital loans to small and medium enterprises.
example.zh: 新設立的輔導補助方案為中小型企業提供低利資本貸款。

words.mnemonic: 商業規模常用簡稱：SME (Small and Medium Enterprises, 中小企業)。

example.en: The average room rate at downtown commercial hotels increased by eight percent this season.
example.zh: 本季市中心商務飯店的平均客房費率上漲了百分之八。

words.mnemonic: 統計平均片語大考點：on average (平均而言)、above average (高於平均水準)。

example.en: The popular ergonomic office chair is temporarily out of stock due to unprecedented demand.
example.zh: 由於空前龐大的需求，這款熱門人體工學辦公椅目前暫時缺貨。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重超高頻字：in stock (有現貨)、out of stock (缺貨)、stock market (股市)。

example.en: Corporate management scheduled a quarterly strategic planning briefing with regional team leaders.
example.zh: 企業管理層與各區域團隊主管排定了一次季度策略規劃簡報會議。

words.mnemonic: 管理階層常用詞：top management (高階管理層)、project management (專案管理)。

example.en: The human resources interview panel commended the candidate's strong moral character and work ethic.
example.zh: 人資面試小組讚揚了該求職者優秀的道德操守與工作敬業態度。

words.mnemonic: 推薦信必備詞：character reference (人品推薦函/品德證明)。

example.en: All executive suites in the hotel are furnished with a comfortable king-size bed and desk.
example.zh: 飯店內所有行政套房均配備舒適的特大號雙人床與辦公書桌。

words.mnemonic: 飯店房型床位規格：king-size bed (特大床)、bed and breakfast (B&B 民宿)。

example.en: Corporate sales revenue hit a record high of twenty million dollars in the fourth quarter.
example.zh: 企業銷售收入在第四季度達到了創紀錄的兩千萬美元新高。

words.mnemonic: 達標與衝擊：hit a record high (創歷史新高)、hit the target (達成目標)。

example.en: The corporation plans to establish a new regional distribution center to streamline supply fulfillment.
example.zh: 該企業計劃設立一座新的區域物流經銷中心，以優化供應鏈履約流程。

words.mnemonic: 創立與建立關係：establish a branch (設立分公司)、establish a relationship (建立關係)。

example.en: The final fourth-quarter financial results were indeed much better than initial executive forecasts.
example.zh: 最終第四季度的財務成果確實遠優於最初的高階主管預測。

words.mnemonic: 肯定加強語氣常用副詞：yes indeed (確實如此)。

example.en: Both corporate legal counsels met this morning to finalize the wording of the final agreement.
example.zh: 雙方企業法務顧問於今天上午會面，以敲定最終協議的用字遣詞。

words.mnemonic: 合約定稿與付款：final approval (最終核准)、final payment (尾款/最終付款)。

example.en: Corporate employees booking domestic commercial travel are required to fly in economy class.
example.zh: 預訂國內商務差旅的企業員工依規定必須搭乘經濟艙。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：economy class (經濟艙)、global economy (全球經濟)。

example.en: The hiring committee agreed that the candidate's background is an ideal fit for the position.
example.zh: 招募委員會一致認為該應徵者的專業背景極為契合該職位。

words.mnemonic: 職場適任性常客：good fit for (極適合...職位)。

example.en: The technical support guy resolved our network router connection issue within fifteen minutes.
example.zh: 那位技術支援人員在十五分鐘之內解決了我們的網路路由器連線問題。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 1/2 日常口語指工作人員：tech guy (資訊工程人員)。

example.en: The corporate ballroom is frequently reserved for business receptions and executive social functions.
example.zh: 企業宴會大廳經常被預訂作為商務招待茶會與高階主管社交盛會的舉辦場地。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：名詞功能，以及社交宴會 (social function)。

example.en: The human resources manager reviewed all candidate resumes that were submitted yesterday.
example.zh: 人力資源經理審核了昨天提交的所有求職者履歷。

words.mnemonic: 過去式標誌時間詞：as of yesterday (截至昨日)。

example.en: Launching an eco-friendly product packaging initiative helped improve our corporate brand image.
example.zh: 推出環保產品包裝倡議有助於提升我們的企業品牌形象。

words.mnemonic: 企業形象塑造：brand image (品牌形象)、corporate image (企業形象)。

example.en: The commercial printer accommodates various paper sizes ranging from standard letter to legal format.
example.zh: 這台商用印表機能容納從標準信紙尺寸到法律公文格式的各類紙張尺寸。

words.mnemonic: 規模與尺寸：medium-sized (中型規模的)、file size (檔案大小)。

example.en: Analyzing online consumer purchasing behavior helps marketing teams refine digital ad placement.
example.zh: 分析線上消費者的購物行為有助於行銷團隊優化數位廣告投放策略。

words.mnemonic: 市場調查大考點：consumer behavior (消費者行為)。

example.en: Ms. Gomez is a welcome addition to our senior software development engineering team.
example.zh: 戈梅茲女士是我們資深軟體研發工程團隊備受歡迎的新進生力軍。

words.mnemonic: 多益連接詞王牌：in addition to (除...之外還有...)、welcome addition (新添的得力助手)。

example.en: The audit committee will review all financial records to determine the exact cause of the deficit.
example.zh: 審計委員會將審查所有財務紀錄以查明造成虧損的確切原因。

words.mnemonic: 查明與判定動詞：determine the cause (查明原因)。
roots: termin 界限 → 劃定界線、決定

example.en: The downtown commercial hotel is located within short walking distance of the central subway station.
example.zh: 這間市中心商務飯店位於距離中央捷運站極短步行路程的便利位置。

words.mnemonic: 交通轉運與辦公座位：train station (火車站)、workstation (個人工作站)。

example.en: The market research survey focuses on the growing aging population in suburban communities.
example.zh: 這項市場研究調查鎖定郊區社區中不斷增長的高齡化人口族群。

words.mnemonic: 市場客群調查：target population (目標族群人口)。

example.en: If vendors fail to deliver supplies by the contractual deadline, financial penalties will apply.
example.zh: 若供應商未能在合約截止期限前交付物資，將會被處以罰款罰則。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約規章必考：fail to do something (未能做某事)。

example.en: Management is dedicated to maintaining a safe, inclusive, and productive work environment.
example.zh: 管理層致力於維繫一個安全、具包容性且富有成效的工作環境。

words.mnemonic: 辦公環境與綠色環保：work environment (工作環境)、protect the environment (保護環境)。

example.en: Production will begin next month.
example.zh: 下週將開始進行生產。

words.mnemonic: 製造商品的過程。

example.en: Both sides signed the contract.
example.zh: 兩家公司今天簽署了合約。

words.mnemonic: 正式法律文件。
roots: tract 拉 → 拉在一起、契約

example.en: Our telecommunications company has emerged as a major player in the global cloud computing market.
example.zh: 我們的電信公司已躍升成為全球雲端運算市場上的主要關鍵要角。

words.mnemonic: 商場巨頭必背比喻詞：key player / major player (關鍵要角/市場主力)。

example.en: Meeting participants are invited to leave their feedback and constructive comments on the seminar form.
example.zh: 邀請與會者在研討會表單上留下他們的寶貴回饋與建設性評論意見。

words.mnemonic: 多益調查常用詞：no comment (不予置評)、welcome your comments (歡迎提供意見)。

example.en: Employees must enter their unique employee credential codes to log into the corporate database.
example.zh: 員工必須輸入其專屬員工憑證代碼以登入企業資料庫。

words.mnemonic: 資料登錄與市場擴張：enter data (輸入資料)、enter a market (打入市場)。

example.en: Should a delivery delay occur, customer service will notify the purchasing client immediately.
example.zh: 萬一發生出貨配送延遲，客戶服務部將立即通知採購客戶。

words.mnemonic: 正式場合的「發生」：occur = happen；片語 occur to someone (浮現心頭)。

example.en: In the fourth quarter alone, corporate online retail sales surged by over twenty percent.
example.zh: 單單在第四季度，企業線上零售額就激增了百分之二十以上。

words.mnemonic: 財報強調用語：in this year alone (單單今年)。

example.en: The merger resulted in a significant increase in international manufacturing output.
example.zh: 該次合併帶動了國際製造產量的顯著大幅提升。

words.mnemonic: 多益財報高頻修飾詞：significant increase (顯著增長)、significant difference (重大差異)。

example.en: The pharmaceutical enterprise invested millions of dollars to develop innovative prescription drugs.
example.zh: 該製藥企業投資了數百萬美元以研發創新的處方藥品。

words.mnemonic: 醫藥零售：drugstore (藥妝店)、prescription drug (處方藥)。

example.en: Emergency exit route maps are posted clearly on the wall adjacent to all conference room doors.
example.zh: 緊急疏散路線圖清楚地張貼在所有會議室門口旁的牆壁上。

words.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 1 常見方位：hang on the wall (掛在牆上)。

example.en: The corporate human resources division organized a series of professional leadership workshops.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部籌辦了一系列專業領導力培訓工作坊。

words.mnemonic: 多益量詞片語大考點：a series of (一系列的，單複數同形)。

example.en: Our partner airline operates a convenient daily direct flight connecting New York and London.
example.zh: 我們的合作航空公司營運往返紐約與倫敦之間便捷的每日直達航班。

words.mnemonic: 班機與交通大考點：direct flight (直飛航班)、direct deposit (直接轉帳入帳)。

example.en: The promotional product launch campaign was an outstanding commercial success.
example.zh: 這場新產品上市宣傳推廣活動取得了極為亮眼的商業成功。

words.mnemonic: 商業成功指標：huge success (巨大成功)；形容詞 successful (成功的)。

example.en: The executive committee will convene tomorrow morning to review final candidate interview results.
example.zh: 執行委員會將於明天上午召開會議以審查最後候選人面試結果。

words.mnemonic: 行程安排關鍵時間詞：tomorrow morning (明天上午)。

example.en: The managing director praised the marketing team for surpassing their annual revenue goals.
example.zh: 常務董事讚揚了行銷團隊超額達成年度營收目標。

words.mnemonic: 企業高層職稱必背：board of directors (董事會)、managing director (常務董事)。

example.en: The commercial purchase contract clearly states all warranty terms and cancellation deadlines.
example.zh: 這份商務採購合約明確載明了所有保固條款與取消截止期限。

words.mnemonic: 合約公文常見副詞搭配：clearly state (明確載明)。

example.en: The construction project suffered unexpected delays due to a temporary lack of skilled labor.
example.zh: 工程專案由於技術工人暫時短缺而遭受了意外的延誤。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻片語：lack of + 名詞 (缺乏...)，注意作名詞時加 of，動詞直接接名詞。

example.en: The steering committee will review the proposed corporate expansion budget before Thursday.
example.zh: 指導委員會將在週四前審查擬議的企業擴張預算案。

words.mnemonic: 審核與考核核心詞：review a contract (審核合約)、performance review (績效考核)。

example.en: Freight shipping costs depend on the total parcel weight and the chosen speed of delivery.
example.zh: 貨運運輸費用取決於包裹總重量以及所選取的配送時效速度。

words.mnemonic: 條件依賴大考點：depend on / rely on (取決於/仰賴)。
roots: pend 懸掛 → 吊在下面依賴

example.en: Technology firms are locked in an intense race to develop commercial generative software tools.
example.zh: 各大科技公司正陷入一場開發商業生成式軟體工具的激烈競賽中。

words.mnemonic: 市場競爭比喻名詞：race to market (搶先上市的競賽)。

example.en: The annual corporate awards ceremony was held to recognize employees for outstanding service.
example.zh: 一年一度的企業頒獎典禮旨在表揚同仁在工作上的傑出服務貢獻。

words.mnemonic: 員工表揚專用字：recognize employee achievements (表彰員工成就)。

example.en: Passengers checking in online may choose between an aisle seat and a window seat for free.
example.zh: 線上報到的旅客可免費在走道座位與靠窗座位之間做選擇。

words.mnemonic: 機票劃位與時機：window seat (靠窗座位)、window of opportunity (時機視窗)。

example.en: The primary purpose of today's executive seminar is to align departmental performance objectives.
example.zh: 今天高階主管研討會的主要目的在於整合各部門的績效目標。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力 Part 4 第一題常客：What is the purpose of the talk? (演說目的為何)。

example.en: Contact the sales department for details.
example.zh: 行銷部門位在三樓。

words.mnemonic: 公司裡分工的部門。

example.en: Our new digital marketing strategy helped the corporation gain substantial market share overseas.
example.zh: 我們全新的數位行銷策略幫助企業在海外市場贏得了可觀的市場份額。

words.mnemonic: 商務獲益搭配：gain market share (擴大市占率)、gain experience (累積經驗)。

example.en: As part of its environmental initiative, the enterprise pledged to plant five thousand trees annually.
example.zh: 作為其環保倡議的一環，該企業承諾每年種植五千棵樹木。

words.mnemonic: ESG 綠色環保與商業決策：plant trees (植樹)、decision tree (決策樹)。

example.en: Corporate recruiters visited several local engineering colleges to conduct campus job interviews.
example.zh: 企業招募主管走訪了數所當地工程學院以進行校園徵才面試。

words.mnemonic: 校園招募常見詞：college graduate (大學畢業生)、community college (社區學院)。

example.en: The corporate financial analyst argued that investing in automated software would yield higher returns.
example.zh: 企業財務分析師主張，投資自動化軟體將會產生更高的投資回報率。

words.mnemonic: 會議中提出有理主張：argue that (主張...)。

example.en: Passengers must present a valid passport and boarding pass before they board the aircraft.
example.zh: 旅客在登機前必須出示有效護照與登機證。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：名詞 board of directors (董事會)；動詞 board a flight (登機)。

example.en: Our downtown corporate office will be closed on Monday in observance of the national holiday.
example.zh: 適逢國定假日，我們的市中心企業辦公室週一將暫停辦公。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室放假公告必備句型：in observance of the holiday (為紀念節日放假)。

example.en: This gala banquet marks the twenty-fifth anniversary of our corporate partnership in Asia.
example.zh: 這場盛宴晚會象徵標誌著我們在亞洲商業夥伴關係成立二十五週年。

words.mnemonic: 里程碑標誌動詞：mark an anniversary (慶祝週年)、mark down (減價打折)。

example.en: The historical corporate hotel is located directly across the street from the landmark cathedral church.
example.zh: 這間歷史悠久的企業特約飯店座落於地標大教堂的正對面。

words.mnemonic: 觀光景點與飯店選址地標常考名詞。

example.en: All factory production machines must undergo routine preventative maintenance every six months.
example.zh: 所有工廠生產機具每六個月均必須接受例行預防性維護保養。

words.mnemonic: 設備名詞：answering machine (電話答錄機)、vending machine (自動販賣機)。

example.en: Through disciplined budget management, the marketing team was able to achieve all quarterly sales targets.
example.zh: 透過嚴謹的預算管理，行銷團隊成功達成了所有季度銷售目標。

words.mnemonic: 業績達標必備動詞：achieve a goal / achieve a target (達成目標)。

example.en: The second item on today's executive board agenda concerns next year's capital investment budget.
example.zh: 今天執行董事會議程上的第二個項目涉及明年度的資本投資預算。

words.mnemonic: 議程與出庫明細必考：agenda item (議程事項)、itemized invoice (逐項列明發票)。

example.en: Upgrading to energy-efficient manufacturing machinery proved to be a very profitable long-term decision.
example.zh: 升級為節能製造機具被證實是一項長期非常有利可圖的明智決策。

words.mnemonic: 連綴動詞句型：prove to be (被證明是/結果是)。

example.en: The wholesale price of petroleum raw materials rose by five cents per gallon this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午石油批發原料價格每加侖上漲了五美分。

words.mnemonic: 貨幣單位：dollars and cents (美元與美分)。

example.en: Hotels in the coastal resort area increase their nightly room rates during the peak summer season.
example.zh: 沿海度假區的飯店在夏季旅遊旺季期間會調高每晚客房費率。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與銷售旺季：peak season / high season (旺季)、off season (淡季)。

example.en: The corporate accounting and human resources departments are located on the third floor.
example.zh: 企業會計與人力資源部門均設在大樓三樓。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室指引與工廠基層：second floor (二樓)、on the factory floor (在生產第一線)。

example.en: Please pack all your personal desk stuff into the labeled cardboard boxes before the office move.
example.zh: 在辦公室搬遷之前，請將您桌上的所有個人私人物品裝入貼有標籤的紙箱內。

words.mnemonic: 口語指隨身物品，為不可數名詞：personal stuff (個人物品)。

example.en: Our downtown department showroom offers a wide selection of executive ergonomic office desks.
example.zh: 我們的市中心百貨展示門市提供廣泛多樣的高階人體工學辦公桌選擇。

words.mnemonic: 產品多元性必考搭配：a wide range / a wide selection of (廣泛多樣的)。

example.en: Anyone interested in attending the optional leadership development workshop should sign up by noon.
example.zh: 凡有興趣參加自由報名之領導力發展工作坊者，均應在中午前完成登記。

words.mnemonic: 多益公文句型：Anyone interested in... should (凡對...有興趣者應當...)。

example.en: This method saves time and money.
example.zh: 這是一種更有效率的付款方式。

words.mnemonic: method = way of doing something。

example.en: The market research team provided an in-depth competitive analysis of competing cloud platforms.
example.zh: 市場研究團隊針對相互競爭的雲端平台提供了一份深入的競爭態勢分析報告。

words.mnemonic: 多益分析名詞：market analysis (市場分析)、data analysis (數據分析)。
roots: lysis 鬆開 → 拆解分析

example.en: Shareholders participated in the annual board election to select three new executive directors.
example.zh: 股東們參加了年度董事會推選，選出三名新的執行董事。

words.mnemonic: 董事會推舉名詞：board election (董事會推選)。

example.en: The aerospace manufacturing corporation secured a lucrative government military aviation contract.
example.zh: 該航空航太製造公司贏得了一筆利潤豐厚的政府國防軍事航空合約。

words.mnemonic: 國防工程合約：military contract (國防合約)。

example.en: The business conference will be hosted in the grand ballroom of the downtown luxury hotel.
example.zh: 商務大會將在市中心豪華飯店的富麗宴會大廳舉行。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要住宿單字：hotel reservation (飯店訂房)、hotel lobby (飯店大廳)。

example.en: Corporate airline club lounge members enjoy complimentary snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi, and workstations.
example.zh: 航空公司企業貴賓聯誼會會員享有免費點心、高速無線網路與獨立辦公工位。

words.mnemonic: 會員專屬貴賓室：airline club (航空貴賓室)、health club (健身俱樂部)。

example.en: Please review the itemized price breakdown in the summary table provided below.
example.zh: 請查閱下方所附摘要表格中的分項費用明細。

words.mnemonic: 文件下方引用常見詞：listed below (如下所列)、below average (低於平均水準)。

example.en: Hotel guests can access on-demand streaming movies directly on their room smart television.
example.zh: 飯店房客可直接在客房智慧型電視上觀賞隨選串流電影。

words.mnemonic: 機上與客房娛樂：in-flight movie (機上娛樂電影)。

example.en: Employees requesting extended sick leave are required to present a signed note from a licensed doctor.
example.zh: 申請長假病假的同仁必須檢附由合格執業醫師親簽的證明文件。

words.mnemonic: 請假病假必背搭配：doctor's note (醫師診斷證明)。

example.en: The project planning meeting concluded after a productive open discussion on budget allocation.
example.zh: 專案企劃會議在就預算配置進行了富有成效的公開討論後圓滿結束。

words.mnemonic: 會議研討名詞：panel discussion (座談會)、under discussion (討論中)。

example.en: We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused by the temporary computer server outage.
example.zh: 對於電腦伺服器暫時中斷所造成的不便，我們深感抱歉。

words.mnemonic: 客服道歉信標準片語：We are sorry for the inconvenience (很抱歉造成不便)。

example.en: Supply chain congestion presents a major logistical challenge for international exporters this season.
example.zh: 供應鏈壅塞為本季國際出口商帶來了一項嚴峻的物流挑戰。

words.mnemonic: 商業難題必背片語：face a challenge (面臨挑戰)、meet a challenge (迎接挑戰)。

example.en: Our courier logistics firm provides express freight delivery services across the entire nation.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流公司在全國各地提供快捷貨運配送服務。

words.mnemonic: 全國範圍常用片語：across the nation (全國各地)。

example.en: Nearly five hundred business delegates registered for the annual international trade symposium.
example.zh: 將近五百位商務代表報名參加了年度國際商貿研討會。

words.mnemonic: 數值約計副詞：nearly = almost，常用於修飾數字 (nearly 500)。

example.en: Clients can log into their online banking portal to download monthly electronic account statements.
example.zh: 客戶可登入其網路銀行平台下載每月的電子帳戶對帳單。

words.mnemonic: 財務必背名詞：bank statement (銀行對帳單)、financial statement (財務報表)。

example.en: Click the secure hyperlink provided in the email to confirm your webinar registration details.
example.zh: 請點擊電子郵件中提供的安全超連結以確認您的線上研討會報名資訊。

words.mnemonic: 網路與交通節點：direct link (直達連結/直達線路)。

example.en: Despite severe supply chain challenges, our manufacturing output increased by eight percent this year.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的供應鏈挑戰，我們的製造產量今年依然增長了百分之八。

words.mnemonic: 多益介系詞超級考點：despite 後接「名詞」或 V-ing，等於 in spite of！

example.en: The technology corporation plans to introduce a revolutionary smart sensor at the Berlin trade fair.
example.zh: 這家科技公司計劃在柏林貿易博覽會上推出一款革命性的智慧感測器。

words.mnemonic: 產品上市核心動詞：introduce a new product (推出新產品)。

example.en: Prospective clients should take advantage of our complimentary thirty-day enterprise software trial.
example.zh: 潛在客戶應當充分善用我們提供的三十天免費企業軟體試用方案。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻片語：take advantage of (善加利用)、competitive advantage (競爭優勢)。

example.en: The final architectural blueprints will be ready for executive review by Thursday afternoon.
example.zh: 最終建築工程藍圖將在週四下午準備就緒以供主管審查。

words.mnemonic: 準備妥當句型：be ready for (為...做好準備)、be ready to do (準備好做某事)。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits policy grants paid personal leave to employees when they marry.
example.zh: 企業員工福利政策為同仁於結婚時提供帶薪婚假。

words.mnemonic: 人事福利假別：marital status (婚姻狀況)、marriage leave (婚假)。

example.en: Commuter train services were severely disrupted due to a sudden regional transit workers strike.
example.zh: 由於區域大眾運輸工人突然舉行罷工，通勤列車服務遭受嚴重干擾延誤。

words.mnemonic: 罷工新聞常客：go on strike (進行罷工)、transit strike (交通罷工)。

example.en: Frequent flyer club members can redeem accumulated reward miles for complimentary airline tickets.
example.zh: 飛行常客俱樂部會員可兌換累積的紅利哩程以獲取免費機票。

words.mnemonic: 航空貴賓方案核心詞：frequent flyer miles (常客飛行哩程)。

example.en: Our corporate legal division is seeking an experienced attorney specializing in intellectual property.
example.zh: 我們的企業法務部正在徵求一名專精於智慧財產權的資深律師。

words.mnemonic: 招募公告常用動詞：seek candidate (徵求人選)、seek approval (尋求核准)。

example.en: The managerial position requires a proven ability to lead multicultural technical teams effectively.
example.zh: 該主管職位要求具備能有效領導多元文化技術團隊的經證實能力。

words.mnemonic: 求職條件標準用詞：ability to do something (做某事的能力)。
collocations: to the best of one's ability

example.en: The automated manufacturing plant produces more than ten thousand electronic units per day.
example.zh: 該自動化製造廠每天生產超過一萬件電子產品單元。

words.mnemonic: 生產與定價核心詞：unit price (單價)、business unit (事業部)。

example.en: At the start of the conference session, delegates customarily exchanged formal business cards.
example.zh: 在會議議程開始之際，代表們依慣例互相交換正式名片。

words.mnemonic: 商務社交與結帳：business card (名片)、credit card (信用卡)。

example.en: The corporate comprehensive health policy provides full coverage for emergency hospital treatments.
example.zh: 企業綜合健保政策為緊急住院醫療提供全額保險保障。

words.mnemonic: 員工醫療與保險理賠：hospital stay (住院)、local hospital (當地醫院)。

example.en: Our support technicians acted quickly to resolve the network connectivity disruption this morning.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援人員今天上午迅速採取行動，解決了網路連線中斷問題。

words.mnemonic: 工作效率描寫副詞：respond quickly (迅速回覆)。

example.en: Qualified job applicants will be contacted by email to schedule an in-person second interview.
example.zh: 具備資格的求職者將會收到電子郵件通知，以安排第二輪實體親自面試。

words.mnemonic: 人資面試核心詞：job interview (求職面試)、conduct an interview (進行面試)。

example.en: Both corporate directors signed a five-year mutual non-disclosure and partnership agreement.
example.zh: 兩位企業董事簽署了一份為期五年的雙向保密與合作夥伴協議。

words.mnemonic: 簽約必背搭配：reach an agreement (達成協議)、sign an agreement (簽署協議)。

example.en: The corporate communications department will release quarterly earnings results to the press today.
example.zh: 企業公關傳播部門將於今日向新聞媒體發布季度盈餘業績。

words.mnemonic: 公關與產品發行：press release (新聞稿)、release a product (發布產品)。

example.en: The total purchase invoice includes applicable state sales tax and standard delivery fees.
example.zh: 採購發票總金額包含適用的州營業稅與標準運送費用。

words.mnemonic: 發票出帳核心名詞：sales tax (營業稅)、tax included (含稅)。

example.en: Our technical consulting enterprise provides cost-effective cloud data management solutions.
example.zh: 我們的技術顧問企業提供具成本效益的雲端資料管理解決方案。

words.mnemonic: 企業宣傳標竿名詞：cost-effective solution (具成本效益的解方)、find a solution (尋求解方)。

example.en: The venture fund provided substantial startup capital to support overseas facility expansion.
example.zh: 創投基金提供了充裕的創業資本以支援海外廠房設施的擴展。

words.mnemonic: 企業金融必考：capital investment (資本投資)、venture capital (創投資本)。
words.roots: cap 頭 → 首要的、首都、資本

example.en: The coastal boutique resort is exceptionally popular among corporate weekend business retreats.
example.zh: 這間沿海精品度假飯店在企業週末商務研習活動中格外受到歡迎。

words.mnemonic: 人氣推薦形容詞：popular choice (熱門之選)、popular with (受...歡迎)。

example.en: The project proposal outlines specific performance milestones and budgetary allocations for each phase.
example.zh: 專案企劃書概述了各個階段具體的績效里程碑與預算配置。

words.mnemonic: 要求具體明確：specific requirements (具體要求)、specific instructions (明確指示)。

example.en: Guests staying in the executive suites enjoy a beautiful panoramic view of the harbor.
example.zh: 入住行政套房的賓客可飽覽海港優美絕倫的全景風光。

words.mnemonic: 飯店宣傳常見形容詞：beautiful view (美麗景致)。

example.en: Financial market analysts expressed fear that inflation could dampen consumer holiday spending.
example.zh: 金融市場分析師表達了擔憂，認為通貨膨脹可能會抑制消費者的節慶開銷。

words.mnemonic: 市場憂慮用語：for fear of (唯恐/以免)。

example.en: Our new digital marketing campaign aims to increase brand recognition among young entrepreneurs.
example.zh: 我們的新數位行銷推廣活動旨在提升年輕創業家對品牌的認知度。

words.mnemonic: 目標宗旨動詞句型：aim to do something (旨在做某事)。

example.en: The corporation allocated twenty percent of its promotional budget to national television advertisements.
example.zh: 該企業將其百分之二十的宣傳推廣預算提撥用於全國電視廣告。

words.mnemonic: 廣告媒體與飯店設施：television commercial (電視廣告)、flat-screen television (平面電視)。

example.en: Factory supervisors initiated a thorough safety audit following a serious machinery malfunction.
example.zh: 工廠主管在發生一起嚴重的機械故障後發起了一次徹底的安全審計。

words.mnemonic: 問題嚴重性形容詞：serious problem (嚴重問題)、take seriously (認真看待)。

example.en: The corporate sales division achieved its annual revenue target three weeks ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 企業銷售部門提前三週順利達成了其年度營收指標目標。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：meet a target (達成目標)、target market (目標市場)。

example.en: The senior consulting vacancy requires a master's degree in business administration or economics.
example.zh: 這項資深顧問職缺要求具備企管或經濟學碩士學位。

words.mnemonic: 履歷學歷與程度：bachelor's degree (學士學位)、to some degree (在某種程度上)。

example.en: The retailer decided to pull defective batches of electrical cords from store shelves immediately.
example.zh: 該零售商決定立即將有瑕疵批次的電源線從門市貨架上下架。

words.mnemonic: 商品下架與合作：pull from the market (從市場下架回收)、pull together (齊心協力)。

example.en: Due to unexpected manufacturing equipment repairs, the regional branch operated in the red this quarter.
example.zh: 由於無預警的製造設備維修支出，該區域分公司本季度陷入了赤字虧損狀態。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會超級成語考點：in the red (赤字/虧損)，反義詞為 in the black (獲利盈餘)！

example.en: The employee travel package allows staff members to bring their husband or wife at a discounted rate.
example.zh: 這套員工差旅套裝方案允許員工以折扣價攜同其丈夫或妻子同行。

words.mnemonic: 家庭福利政策：husband and wife (夫妻配偶)。

example.en: Authorized administrative personnel are granted full digital access to confidential client files.
example.zh: 獲得授權的行政人員獲准擁有查閱機密客戶檔案的完整數位存取權限。

words.mnemonic: 多益不可數名詞大考點：have access to (有權使用/進入)。

example.en: International market analysts tracked currency exchange movements over the preceding three quarters.
example.zh: 國際市場分析師追蹤記錄了前三個季度的貨幣匯率波動走勢。

words.mnemonic: 貨物流轉與價格走勢：cargo movement (貨物轉運)、price movement (價格變動)。

example.en: Our corporate customer service philosophy dictates that we treat every client with utmost respect.
example.zh: 我們的企業客戶服務哲學要求我們必須以最大的尊重來對待每一位客戶。

words.mnemonic: 待客之道動詞：treat someone with respect (以尊重對待某人)。

example.en: Quality assurance technicians performed comprehensive tests to identify the cause of the system error.
example.zh: 品保技術人員實施了全面檢測以查明系統錯誤的起因。

words.mnemonic: 問題分析核心字：identify problems (找出問題)、identify opportunities (辨認商機)。

example.en: The financial quarterly report showed a net operating loss due to unexpected legal expenditures.
example.zh: 財務季度報告顯示，由於意外的法務訴訟支出而出現了營業淨虧損。

words.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：profit and loss (損益)、at a loss (賠錢/不知所措)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters complex is outfitted with modern ergonomic workstations and meeting pods.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓園區配備了現代化的人體工學工作站與會議小間。

words.mnemonic: 先進設施描寫詞：modern equipment (現代化設備)、modern facilities (現代化設施)。

example.en: The engineering team worked well under pressure to meet the tight product launch deadline.
example.zh: 工程團隊在沉重壓力下表現優異，如期達成了緊湊的新產品發布截止時限。

words.mnemonic: 抗壓能力履歷用語：work well under pressure (抗壓性高/能在壓力下良好工作)。

example.en: A complimentary hotel shuttle bus provides convenient passenger transportation to the airport terminals.
example.zh: 飯店免費接駁巴士提供前往機場航廈的便利旅客接送交通服務。

words.mnemonic: 多益接駁專車核心詞：shuttle bus (接駁巴士)、bus stop (公車站)。

example.en: The enterprise travel lounge ensures that VIP corporate guests receive first-class treatment.
example.zh: 企業貴賓休息室確保每位企業貴賓旅客都能享受到第一流的尊爵待遇。

words.mnemonic: 待遇與廢棄物處理：equal treatment (平等待遇)、water treatment (水處理)。

example.en: The annual international commercial conference will be hosted in the hotel grand auditorium.
example.zh: 年度國際商務研討會大會將在飯店宏偉大禮堂隆重舉辦。

words.mnemonic: 多益最高頻場景：conference call (電話會議)、conference room (會議室)。
roots: -ence 名詞 → 把意見帶到一起

example.en: Please help yourself to complimentary coffee and bottled refreshments in the seminar lounge.
example.zh: 請在研討會休閒茶歇室隨意自取免費的咖啡與瓶裝茶點。

words.mnemonic: 社交招待常用客氣用語：help yourself to (請隨意自用)。

example.en: The office administrator placed a bulk order for recycled stationery and printer paper supplies.
example.zh: 辦公室管理員大宗訂購了一批環保再生文具與印表機用紙用品物資。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的採購詞：office supplies (辦公用品)、supply chain (供應鏈)。
roots: ply 填滿 → 從下補滿

example.en: The coastal resort village features private beach bungalows and championship golf facilities.
example.zh: 這座濱海休閒度假村設有專屬海灘獨棟小屋與錦標賽級高爾夫球場設施。

words.mnemonic: 度假勝地名詞：resort village (度假休閒村)。

example.en: Attending the industry networking summit is well worth the travel and registration investment.
example.zh: 出席這場產業人脈交流高峰會非常值得投入差旅與報名費的投資。
