words.mnemonic: 值得做某事句型：well worth + V-ing (非常值得做...)。

example.en: Our personal care product line is formulated exclusively with certified organic natural ingredients.
example.zh: 我們的個人保養品系列完全採用經認證的有機天然原料配方調製而成。

words.mnemonic: 環保天然特色：natural ingredients (天然成分)、natural resources (天然資源)。

example.en: Orders placed before noon qualify for guaranteed overnight express courier delivery service.
example.zh: 中午前完成的訂單可享有保證隔夜抵達的快捷快遞遞送服務。

words.mnemonic: 多益物流大考點：express delivery (快遞配送)；動詞 express concern (表達關切)。
roots: press 壓 → 擠出來、表達

example.en: Preliminary market survey results clearly indicate growing consumer demand for electric cars.
example.zh: 初步市場調查結果清楚地顯示出消費者對電動車的需求持續增長。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀題幹最愛問：What does the notice indicate? (通知中指出了什麼)。

example.en: All employees must attend the meeting.
example.zh: 超過五十人參加了研討會。

words.mnemonic: attend a meeting。
roots: tend 伸展 → 向…伸出注意

example.en: The corporate family business was founded by two entrepreneurial brothers over fifty years ago.
example.zh: 這家企業家族企業是由兩位具創業家精神的兄弟在五十多年前聯手創立。

words.mnemonic: 家族企業背景名詞：family-owned business。

example.en: The executive committee approved a major capital investment in green energy technology.
example.zh: 執行委員會核准了一項針對綠色能源科技的重大資本投資案。

words.mnemonic: 金融投資名詞：return on investment (投資報酬率/ROI)、capital investment (資本投資)。
roots: vest 衣服 → 給資金穿上衣服

example.en: Our support center achieved the highest overall customer satisfaction score in company history.
example.zh: 我們的客服支援中心取得了公司創立以來整體客戶滿意度的最高評分。

words.mnemonic: 考核分數：satisfaction score (滿意度評分)、test score (測驗分數)。

example.en: The administrative committee worked tirelessly to organize the annual shareholder meeting.
example.zh: 行政籌備委員會不辭辛勞地工作，以籌辦年度股東大會。

words.mnemonic: 籌辦活動核心動詞：organize an event / organize a conference (籌辦活動/研討會)。

example.en: The regional sales manager will be away on an official business trip to Chicago next week.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理下週將前往芝加哥進行公務出差行程。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場最重要出差名詞：business trip (出差)、round-trip (來回)。

example.en: Our customer care representatives consistently go above and beyond to satisfy client needs.
example.zh: 我們的客戶關懷專員始終竭盡所能、全力以赴以超越預期地滿足客戶需求。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻客服片語：go above and beyond (全力以赴/超越期待)。

example.en: All luxury guest rooms are outfitted with premium soundproof windows to ensure a quiet sleep.
example.zh: 所有頂級豪華客房皆安裝有頂級隔音窗戶，以確保房客能享有寧靜安穩的睡眠。

words.mnemonic: 飯店住宿環境描寫字彙：get a good night's sleep (睡個好覺)。

example.en: The hotel seafood restaurant sources fresh fish daily from certified sustainable local fisheries.
example.zh: 該飯店海鮮餐廳每天向經認證的永續在地漁場採購新鮮魚貨。

words.mnemonic: 飯店宴飲海鮮菜單：fresh fish (鮮魚)、fish market (魚市場)。

example.en: Our corporate logistics team promises timely delivery of all express shipments nationwide.
example.zh: 我們的企業物流團隊承諾全國所有快捷包裹均能按時準點送達。

words.mnemonic: 企業承諾服務：promise to do (承諾做某事)、keep a promise (信守承諾)。
roots: mis 送 → 送出的承諾

example.en: Sales representatives distributed product sample kits to potential commercial clients at the expo.
example.zh: 業務代表在商展上向潛在企業客戶分發了產品樣品組。

words.mnemonic: 商機與人才評估：potential client / potential customer (潛在客戶)。

example.en: The factory installed rooftop solar panels to decrease commercial energy consumption expenses.
example.zh: 工廠安裝了屋頂太陽能板，以降低商業能源消耗開銷。

words.mnemonic: 環保永續大考點：energy consumption (能源消耗)、renewable energy (再生能源)。

example.en: Please contact our technical support hotline if you experience any trouble logging into the portal.
example.zh: 若您在登入系統入口網站時遇到任何麻煩困難，請撥打我們的技術支援專線。

words.mnemonic: 遇到困難高頻片語：have trouble doing (做...有困難)、troubleshoot (故障排除)。

example.en: Maintaining harmonious public relations is vital for sustaining long-term investor confidence.
example.zh: 維護融洽的公共關係對於維繫投資人的長期信心至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 公關部專有名詞：public relations (PR, 公關)、customer relations (客戶關係)。

example.en: A designated client services manager will get in touch with you before the end of the day.
example.zh: 專屬客戶服務經理將在今天結束前回覆聯絡您。

words.mnemonic: 多益通訊超級核心片語：get in touch with / keep in touch (保持聯繫)。

example.en: Passengers whose luggage was misplaced should file an official lost baggage report immediately.
example.zh: 行李遺失的旅客應立即向櫃檯提出正式遺失行李申報單。

words.mnemonic: 辦公歸檔與提報申請：file a claim (提出索賠)、file a report (提交報告)。

example.en: Business travelers booking flights online generally prefer aisle seats over middle seats.
example.zh: 線上訂票的商務旅客通常比起中間座位更偏好走道座位。

words.mnemonic: 座位與組織階層：middle seat (中間座位)、middle management (中階管理層)。

example.en: Executive hotel guests enjoy access to the rooftop cocktail bar and panoramic observation deck.
example.zh: 行政客房貴賓可享用頂樓調酒酒吧與全景觀景台設施。

words.mnemonic: 飯店休閒設施與條碼：snack bar (點心吧)、bar code (條碼)。

example.en: The regional airline suffered substantial operating losses due to prolonged airport runway closures.
example.zh: 由於機場跑道長時間關閉，這家區域航空公司遭受了嚴重的營業虧損。

words.mnemonic: 蒙受虧損搭配：suffer losses (遭受虧損)、suffer damage (受損)。

example.en: The corporate executive committee formulated an ambitious marketing strategy to expand into Europe.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會制定了一項進軍歐洲市場的雄心勃勃的行銷策略。

words.mnemonic: 商管必備高頻詞：marketing strategy (行銷策略)、business strategy (商業策略)。

example.en: Our consulting firm provides deep analytical insights into global supply chain logistics.
example.zh: 我們的管理顧問公司針對全球供應鏈物流提供深入的分析洞察。

words.mnemonic: 深度分析與巨額折扣：deep discount (大幅折扣)、deep understanding (深入理解)。

example.en: The downtown customer service branch is open daily except on official public holidays.
example.zh: 市中心客戶服務門市每日照常營業，唯國定假日除外。

words.mnemonic: 例外排除介系詞：except for (除了...之外)。
roots: cept 拿 → 拿出去、除外

example.en: Hotel housekeeping staff clean and restock all guest accommodations between ten and two.
example.zh: 飯店房務人員於上午十點至下午兩點之間清掃並補充所有客房用品。

words.mnemonic: 房務與環保科技：clean energy (潔淨能源)、housekeeping cleans rooms (房務人員清潔客房)。

example.en: Consumers tend to purchase more electronic goods during promotional holiday sale events.
example.zh: 消費者在節慶促銷特賣活動期間往往會採購更多的電子商品。

words.mnemonic: 趨勢與習慣動詞：tend to do something (往往/傾向於做某事)。

example.en: Business travelers are strongly advised to reserve hotel accommodations at least two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 強烈建議商務旅客至少提前兩週預訂飯店住宿。

words.mnemonic: 多益最愛考片語：in advance (事先/提前)、advance notice (事先通知)。

example.en: All job applicants must fill out the online background information form before the interview.
example.zh: 所有應徵者在面試前皆必須填妥線上背景資料表。

words.mnemonic: 行政填表與徵才兩大王牌片語：fill out a form (填表)、fill a vacancy (填補職缺)。

example.en: The convention delegation stayed at an internationally recognized five-star waterfront hotel.
example.zh: 會議代表團入住了一家享譽國際的五星級濱水大飯店。

words.mnemonic: 飯店評等專有名詞：five-star hotel (五星級飯店)。

example.en: Attending the annual trade banquet offers an invaluable opportunity to network with industry peers.
example.zh: 出席年度商貿晚宴為與業界同儕建立專業人脈提供了難能可貴的機會。

words.mnemonic: 人脈建立與資訊科技：networking event (人脈交流活動)、computer network (電腦網路)。

example.en: Corporate board meetings are generally conducted on the third Wednesday of each calendar month.
example.zh: 企業董事會會議一般在每個月的第三個星期三定期召開。

words.mnemonic: 日常慣例副詞：generally speaking (一般而言)。

example.en: The corporation streamlined its European manufacturing operations to reduce logistics overhead.
example.zh: 該企業精簡了其歐洲製造營運體系以降低物流經常性開支。

words.mnemonic: 運營與開銷名詞：hours of operation (營業時間)、operating costs (營運成本)。

example.en: Our downtown department store promises to match any lower advertised price from local competitors.
example.zh: 我們的市中心百貨門市承諾跟進匹配在地競爭同業所刊登的任何更低價格。

words.mnemonic: 退款保證與核對：price match (跟進買貴退差價)、match the description (與描述相符)。

example.en: Drivers should take alternative bypass routes to avoid heavy construction traffic on the highway.
example.zh: 駕駛人應當走替代外環路線以避開高速公路上的嚴重施工車潮。

words.mnemonic: 文法考點：avoid 後面一律接「V-ing」或名詞！(avoid making mistakes)。
roots: void 空 → 使空出、避開

example.en: Passengers may reserve their preferred aisle or window seat during online flight check-in.
example.zh: 旅客在線上辦理登機報到時可預訂其偏好的走道或靠窗座位。

words.mnemonic: 機票劃位必考：aisle seat (走道座位)、window seat (靠窗座位)。

example.en: Please do not throw away confidential client documents; use the locked disposal bins instead.
example.zh: 請勿隨意丟棄機密客戶文件；請改為投入上鎖的碎紙回收箱內。

words.mnemonic: 廢棄物處理片語：throw away (丟棄)、throw a party (辦派對)。

example.en: The project supervisor assigned specific administrative tasks to each member of the engineering team.
example.zh: 專案主管將具體的行政任務指派給工程團隊的每位成員。

words.mnemonic: 辦公指派搭配：assign a task (指派任務)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: Following the scheduled software maintenance, normal online banking operations will resume at eight.
example.zh: 在定時的軟體維護完畢後，正常的線上網銀營運將於八點整恢復。

words.mnemonic: 正常營運狀態：normal business hours (正常營業時間)、back to normal (恢復正常)。

example.en: The corporate sales team reached its quarterly revenue goal two weeks ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 企業銷售團隊提前兩週順利達成了其季度營收目標。

words.mnemonic: 商業達標動詞搭配：reach a goal / achieve a goal (達成目標)。

example.en: The customer care associate assisted the client with processing an expedited warranty claim.
example.zh: 客戶關懷專員協助該客戶辦理了快捷保固理賠申報手續。

words.mnemonic: 職稱大考點：sales associate (業務專員)、associate manager (副經理)。

example.en: The manufacturing plant is hiring skilled blue-collar workers for the new robotic assembly line.
example.zh: 這家製造廠正為其全新的機器人組裝流水線招募技術熟練的藍領工人。

words.mnemonic: 多益勞力族群考點：blue-collar worker (藍領勞工)、blueprint (工程藍圖)。

example.en: Our newly launched eco-friendly product line received overwhelmingly positive customer reviews.
example.zh: 我們新上市的環保產品系列獲得了廣大顧客壓倒性正面的好評肯定。

words.mnemonic: 評價肯定詞：positive feedback (正面回饋)、positive attitude (積極態度)。
roots: -itive 形容詞 → 明確放定的

example.en: Customers can choose a payment option.
example.zh: 我們目前正在評估三種不同的選項。

words.mnemonic: 可選擇的項目。

example.en: All fragile ceramic items must be packed securely inside reinforced cardboard shipping boxes.
example.zh: 所有易碎陶瓷商品均必須妥善加固包裝在加厚瓦楞運送紙箱內。

words.mnemonic: 物流郵政名詞：cardboard box (瓦楞紙箱)、PO Box (郵政信箱)。

example.en: The promotional flash discount campaign proved to be a huge commercial success for the retailer.
example.zh: 這場快閃促銷折扣活動被證明為該零售商帶來了巨大的商業成功。

words.mnemonic: 巨大的商業成果：huge success (巨大成功)、huge difference (巨大差異)。

example.en: Please leave a detailed message with the receptionist if the account executive is away from his desk.
example.zh: 若客戶主管不在座位前，請在接待員處留下詳細留言訊息。

words.mnemonic: 電話留言核心搭配：leave a message (留言)、take a message (記錄留言)。
words.roots: miss 送 → 被送出的訊息

example.en: The senior consultant cited several successful instances of digital cloud enterprise transformation.
example.zh: 資深顧問列舉了數個成功的企業數位雲端轉型實例。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀舉例最愛考片語：for instance = for example (例如)。
roots: stan 站 → 站在眼前的事例

example.en: The manager's open and collaborative leadership style boosted team morale and overall productivity.
example.zh: 經理開明且強調協同合作的領導風格大幅提升了團隊士氣與整體生產力。

words.mnemonic: 領導風格與時尚款式：leadership style (領導風格)、out of style (過時)。

example.en: Please refer to the attached PDF diagram for complete step-by-step equipment assembly instructions.
example.zh: 請參閱隨附之 PDF 圖解，以獲得完整的設備組裝逐步指南說明。

words.mnemonic: 公文指示必背片語：refer to (參閱/參考)、refer a candidate (推薦求職者)。
roots: fer 攜帶 → 帶回去參照

example.en: Our sales team prefers inbound digital marketing strategies rather than making unsolicited cold calls.
example.zh: 我們的銷售團隊偏好集客式數位行銷策略，而非進行未經預約的陌生電訪推銷。

words.mnemonic: 業務推銷大考點：cold call (陌生開發電訪)、cold weather (寒冷天候)。

example.en: The retail marketing department launched an intensive push to promote seasonal clearance apparel.
example.zh: 零售行銷部門發動了一場強力的促銷推進宣傳，以推廣出清換季特賣服飾。

words.mnemonic: 促銷推進名詞/動詞：make a push for (大力推廣)、push the deadline (推遲截止日)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the third quarter earnings results during the board meeting.
example.zh: 財務長在董事會會議上報告了第三季度的盈餘業績。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會最核心名詞：first quarter / Q1 (第一季)、quarterly report (季度報告)。

example.en: Ms. Carter will officially assume the role of chief executive officer starting next Monday.
example.zh: 卡特女士將於下週一正式承擔就任執行長一職。

words.mnemonic: 多益就職必考搭配：assume the role of / assume responsibility (承擔職責)。

example.en: The luxury resort hotel provides complimentary baby cribs and stroller rentals upon request.
example.zh: 這間豪華度假飯店應房客要求免費提供嬰兒嬰兒床與手推車租賃服務。

words.mnemonic: 飯店服務與育嬰設施：baby crib (嬰兒床)、baby-sitting (代客托嬰照料)。

example.en: The corporate executive committee commended the marketing team for a highly successful product rollout.
example.zh: 企業執行委員會讚揚了行銷團隊新產品推廣上市的圓滿大獲成功。

words.mnemonic: 成功成果形容詞：successful candidate (錄取者/成功的應徵者)。

example.en: A celebrated regional vocal choir was invited to sing at the annual corporate charity gala.
example.zh: 一家知名的區域人聲合唱團獲邀在年度企業慈善晚會上獻唱表演。

words.mnemonic: 宴會娛樂活動描寫：sing at the gala (在晚會上演唱)。

example.en: There is little doubt that digital automation will improve long-term warehouse productivity.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，數位自動化將會顯著提升倉儲物流的長期生產力。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考肯定強烈片語：without a doubt / little doubt (毫無疑問)。

example.en: Local retailers face intense market competition from multinational online e-commerce platforms.
example.zh: 在地實體零售商正面臨來自跨國線上電商平台極為激烈的市場競爭。

words.mnemonic: 市場抗衡詞彙：stiff competition / fierce competition (激烈競爭)。

example.en: The seminar presenter explained how management theory applies to modern distributed remote teams.
example.zh: 研討會主講人深入闡釋了管理學理論如何具體應用於現代分散式遠距團隊。

words.mnemonic: 理論與實務對比：in theory (理論上)、in practice (實務上)。

example.en: The financial director will formally propose a revised capital expenditure plan at tomorrow's meeting.
example.zh: 財務總監將在明天的會議上正式提出一份修訂後的資本支出方案。

words.mnemonic: 商務提案核心動詞：propose a plan (提出方案)；衍生名詞 proposal (提案書)。

example.en: Job applicants are required to furnish at least two professional employment references.
example.zh: 求職應徵者依規定須提供至少兩位專業前雇主推薦人名單。

words.mnemonic: 求職推薦與編號查證：reference letter (推薦信)、reference number (參照編號)。

example.en: The consultant presented a compelling financial argument in favor of upgrading to cloud servers.
example.zh: 顧問提出了一項令人信服的財務論據，力挺全面升級為雲端伺服器。

words.mnemonic: 支持提案論點：compelling argument (令人信服的論據)。

example.en: The trade exhibition entrance fee is twenty dollars for adults and complimentary for children.
example.zh: 該商貿展覽會入場費成人為二十美元，兒童則免費招待。

words.mnemonic: 票價費率分類：adult fare (成人票價)、adult passenger (成年旅客)。

example.en: Corporate business executives frequently fly commercial business class on transatlantic routes.
example.zh: 企業高階主管在跨大西洋航線上經常搭乘商業商務艙飛行出差。

words.mnemonic: 航空出差動詞：frequent flyer (飛行常客)、fly direct (搭直航班機)。

example.en: Please attach the document to your email.
example.zh: 請於簽署前仔細閱讀文件。

words.mnemonic: 文件可以被 attach。
roots: -ument 名詞 → 用來教導／佐證的文件

example.en: Market analysts identified a noticeable shift in consumer purchasing patterns over the holiday period.
example.zh: 市場分析師在節慶期間發現了消費者購物模式型態的顯著轉變。

words.mnemonic: 市場行為分析：spending patterns (消費型態/消費模式)。

example.en: Job candidates must submit their completed employment application online before Friday.
example.zh: 求職候選人必須在週五前於線上提交填寫完畢的應徵求職申請表。

words.mnemonic: 求職與行動軟體必考：job application (求職申請)、mobile application (手機應用程式)。

example.en: Customers seeking immediate technical assistance may dial our twenty-four-hour telephone hotline.
example.zh: 尋求即時技術協助的客戶可隨時撥打我們的二十四小時電話諮詢熱線。

words.mnemonic: 客服電話必考：telephone hotline (諮詢熱線)、hot item (熱銷商品)。

example.en: Upgrading automated equipment obviously helped our factory increase daily manufacturing throughput.
example.zh: 升級自動化設備顯然幫助了我們的工廠提高每日製造產量吞吐。

words.mnemonic: 顯而易見副詞：obviously true (顯而易見屬實)。

example.en: If any instructions on the assembly diagram remain unclear, contact the support supervisor.
example.zh: 若組裝圖解上的任何說明指示依然不明確，請立即聯絡支援主管。

words.mnemonic: 字首 un- 反義詞：clear (清楚) -> unclear (不清楚/不明朗)。

example.en: Hotel guests may review their finalized itemized room bill at the front desk prior to departure.
example.zh: 飯店房客在退房出發前可於接待櫃檯審閱其最終的逐項客房費用帳單。

words.mnemonic: 飯店退房與帳務出帳：itemized bill (明細帳單)、utility bill (水電費帳單)。

example.en: Users can search our online electronic archives by keyword or document identification number.
example.zh: 使用者可以透過關鍵字或文件身分編號檢索我們的線上電子檔案庫。

words.mnemonic: 人資獵才與線上搜尋：executive search (高階主管獵才)、search engine (搜尋引擎)。

example.en: Please submit travel lodging receipts and client meal expenses on separate reimbursement forms.
example.zh: 請將差旅住宿收據與客戶餐費支出分別填寫在各自獨立的報銷申請表上。

words.mnemonic: 分開報帳與個別處理：separate forms (各自獨立的表格)、separate cover (另函寄送)。
roots: par 準備 → 分開安排

example.en: The corporate headquarters is situated in a prominent central location adjacent to the subway.
example.zh: 企業總部位於緊鄰捷運站的地標精華核心地段。

words.mnemonic: 選址核心詞：central location (黃金核心位置)、central office (總辦公室)。

example.en: The enterprise actively supports ongoing professional development and employee career advancement.
example.zh: 該企業積極支持持續專業在職進修與員工職涯升遷發展。

words.mnemonic: 招募網站專區：career opportunities (職涯機會)、career fair (就業博覽會)。

example.en: Although the budget estimate was preliminary, the committee decided to proceed with the bid anyway.
example.zh: 儘管預算估算僅為初步性質，委員會依然決定無論如何都要推進該項投標。

words.mnemonic: 語氣轉折副詞：anyway = regardless (無論如何)。

example.en: The company president delivered an inspiring keynote speech at the annual international trade banquet.
example.zh: 公司總裁在年度國際商貿晚宴上發表了鼓舞人心的主題演講。

words.mnemonic: 演講動詞搭配：give a speech / deliver a speech (發表演說)。

example.en: The luxury hotel allows certified guide dogs to accompany guests inside all dining and lodging areas.
example.zh: 該豪華飯店允許經認證的導盲犬陪同房客進入所有餐飲與住宿區域。

words.mnemonic: 飯店無障礙規定：guide dog (導盲犬)、service dog (服務犬)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the finalized annual auditing report to the board of directors.
example.zh: 財務長向董事會正式呈報了最終年度審計報告。

words.mnemonic: 高階主管頭銜縮寫必背：CEO (執行長)、CFO (財務長)、security officer (保全專員)。

example.en: Complimentary wireless internet connectivity is accessible throughout the entire conference center.
example.zh: 全體會議中心全區內部均可連線使用免費無線網路。

words.mnemonic: 遍及範圍與整段時間：throughout the year (全年)、throughout the building (遍及整座大樓)。

example.en: Factory maintenance mechanics regularly check lubricating oil levels across all production machines.
example.zh: 工廠維護技師定期檢查所有生產機具的潤滑機油液位。

words.mnemonic: 設備潤滑與能源：crude oil (原油)、oil change (換機油)。

example.en: All corporate employees are required to adhere to business professional dress code guidelines.
example.zh: 所有企業員工皆必須遵守商務專業服儀規範準則。

words.mnemonic: 公司人事規範大考點：dress code (服儀規定)、business casual dress (商務休閒服裝)。

example.en: The business reported a higher profit.
example.zh: 公司本季度實現了豐厚的利潤。

words.mnemonic: 收入扣除成本後的錢。
roots: fit 做 → 向前的成果

example.en: I guess we should reconfirm tomorrow's conference room booking with the administrative secretary.
example.zh: 我想我們應該跟行政秘書再次確認明天會議室的預訂登記情況。

words.mnemonic: 口語聽力委婉表達：I guess so (我想也是)、take a guess (猜猜看)。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness committee organized a fun weekend retreat for staff and families.
example.zh: 企業員工健康委員會為同仁及眷屬籌辦了一次充滿樂趣的週末研習營。

words.mnemonic: 員工聯誼活動描寫：have fun (玩得開心)、fun activity (有趣的活動)。

example.en: Factory employees must wear specialized protective helmets and boots to protect against workplace injury.
example.zh: 工廠員工必須穿戴專用防護頭盔與防護鞋靴以防範職場工傷意外。

words.mnemonic: 資安與工安核心動詞：protect against (防範/抵禦)、protect data (保護資料)。
roots: tect 覆蓋 → 擋在前面遮蓋

example.en: The corporate human resources division oversees employee recruitment, benefits, and staff training.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部門負責督導員工招募、福利與同仁培訓進修。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的部門：human resources (HR, 人力資源部)。
roots: source 湧出 (surgere) → 再度湧現的來源

example.en: Our pharmaceutical research laboratory applies cutting-edge medical science to vaccine development.
example.zh: 我們的製藥研發實驗室將尖端醫學科技應用於疫苗開發。

words.mnemonic: 高科技研發名詞：computer science (資訊科學)、science park (科學園區)。

example.en: The corporate health insurance package provides full diagnostic coverage for chronic disease treatments.
example.zh: 企業健康保險套裝福利針對慢性疾病的診療提供全面的給付保障。

words.mnemonic: 健保福利與防疫：prevent disease (預防疾病)、infectious disease (傳染病)。

example.en: Please ensure that the remaining account balance is fully settled before the end of the billing cycle.
example.zh: 請確保帳戶剩餘應付結餘款在該出帳週期結束前全額結清。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會與人事兩大王牌：account balance (帳戶餘額)、work-life balance (工作與生活平衡)。

example.en: Customers should inspect delivered packages immediately and report any transit damage to the courier.
example.zh: 顧客在貨物送達時應立即檢查包裹，並向快遞公司回報任何運送損壞。

words.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：cause damage (造成損壞)、damaged goods (受損商品)。

example.en: Our facility security team conducts preventative equipment maintenance checks on a daily basis.
example.zh: 我們的廠房保全維護團隊每日定期進行預防性設備檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 多益超級頻率片語：on a daily basis (每天)、on a regular basis (定期)。

example.en: The keynote speaker is a distinguished author of several bestselling management strategy handbooks.
example.zh: 特邀主講嘉賓是數本暢銷管理策略實務手冊的知名作家作者。

words.mnemonic: 出版品作者：lead author (主要作者)、book author (圖書作家)。

example.en: All newly hired administrative assistants must demonstrate basic proficiency in spreadsheet applications.
example.zh: 所有新進行政助理皆必須展現操作試算表應用軟體的基本熟練能力。

words.mnemonic: 入門要求：basic skills (基本技能)、basic salary (底薪)。

example.en: Corporate leadership encourages staff members to pursue ongoing professional education and certification.
example.zh: 企業領導層大力鼓勵同仁攻讀持續專業進修課程並考取專業證照。

words.mnemonic: 多益高頻句型：encourage someone to do something (鼓勵某人做某事)。

example.en: Factory operators working on food processing lines must wear protective hairnets at all times.
example.zh: 在食品加工流水線上作業的工廠員工在任何時候皆必須配戴防護髮網。

words.mnemonic: 食品安全工安規章：hair net (髮網)。

example.en: Company employment policies strictly enforce equal opportunities for male and female job applicants.
example.zh: 公司就業政策嚴格落實對男女求職應徵者一律平等的就業機會。

words.mnemonic: 性別平權招募用語：male and female (男性與女性)。

example.en: Only trained staff may operate the machine.
example.zh: 只有受過訓練的技術員才能操作這台機器。

words.mnemonic: operate a machine or company。

example.en: The final financial statement accurately reflects all verified revenues and operating expenditures.
example.zh: 最終財務報表準確無誤地反映了所有已查核的營收與營運支出。

words.mnemonic: 如實反映財報用語：accurately reflect (準確反映)。

example.en: Factory employees participated in an annual fire emergency evacuation exercise this morning.
example.zh: 工廠員工於今天上午參加了一年一度的火災緊急疏散演練演習。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：fire exercise / drill (消防演習)；動詞 exercise caution (保持謹慎)。

example.en: The employee onboarding handbook contains useful contact numbers and procedural checklists.
example.zh: 新進員工培訓指導手冊內含有實用的聯絡電話號碼與作業程序檢核清單。

words.mnemonic: 推薦實用工具：useful tool (實用工具)、useful information (實用資訊)。

example.en: Please reserve a private dining room at the downtown restaurant for the executive client banquet.
example.zh: 請在市中心餐廳預訂一間私人獨立包廂以舉辦高階客戶宴會。

words.mnemonic: 商務宴請高頻字：hotel restaurant (飯店餐廳)、make a restaurant reservation (預約餐廳)。

example.en: Corporate net operating income grew by twelve percent thanks to higher overseas subscription rates.
example.zh: 歸功於海外訂閱率提高，企業營業淨所得增長了百分之十二。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會核心名詞：net income (淨利/淨收入)、income tax (所得稅)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee is evaluating commercial real estate properties for new branch offices.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會正在評估用於設立新分公司的商用房地產物業。

words.mnemonic: 不動產與智財權必考：real property / real estate (不動產)、intellectual property (智慧財產權/IP)。

example.en: Candidates must provide employment verification letters from their previous corporate employers.
example.zh: 求職應徵者必須檢附先前企業前雇主所開立的在職服務證明信。

words.mnemonic: 資歷查核常用詞：previous experience (過往經驗)、previous year (前一年)。
roots: vi 路 → 走在前面的

example.en: The facility maintenance team replaced burnt-out overhead light bulbs in the dark factory corridor.
example.zh: 廠房維修團隊更換了工廠昏暗走廊中燒毀的頂部照明燈泡。

words.mnemonic: 工安環境照明形容詞：well-lit (照明良好的)，反義詞為 dark。

example.en: It is difficult to imagine managing global supply fulfillment without cloud automation software.
example.zh: 很難設想若沒有雲端自動化軟體該如何有效管理全球供應鏈履約作業。

words.mnemonic: 提案設想句型：hard to imagine (很難想像)。

example.en: Please check with the project director to confirm that it is okay to reschedule the review session.
example.zh: 請向專案總監確認將審查會議改期是否可以獲得同意。

words.mnemonic: 確認同意口語表達：give the okay (給予核准/開綠燈)。

example.en: Rewards club members earn points for every dollar spent on corporate business hotel accommodations.
example.zh: 會員俱樂部成員在企業商務飯店住宿上每消費一美元即可賺取紅利積分。

words.mnemonic: 積點與獲利動詞：earn points (累積點數)、earn money (賺錢)。

example.en: The corporate family medical policy allows staff members to enroll their dependent son or daughter.
example.zh: 企業家庭醫療福利政策允許同仁為其受撫養的兒子或女兒投保。

words.mnemonic: 眷屬健保條款名詞：dependent child (受撫養子女)。

example.en: Human resources will post the job opening advertisement on our corporate careers website today.
example.zh: 人力資源部今天將在我們的企業求職網站上刊登張貼職缺徵才廣告。

words.mnemonic: 招募公告與郵政：post an advertisement (張貼廣告)、post office (郵局)。

example.en: The advertising department placed a full-page promotional display ad in the national newspaper.
example.zh: 廣告部門在全國性報紙上刊登了一整頁的促銷展示廣告。

words.mnemonic: 報刊廣告常考：newspaper advertisement (報紙廣告)。

example.en: The contract clearly defines the specific responsibilities of each consulting partner.
example.zh: 合約明確界定了每位顧問合作夥伴的具體責任範疇。

words.mnemonic: 職責劃分動詞：clearly define (明確界定)。

example.en: At the conclusion of the seminar, participants are invited to ask questions during the open Q&A.
example.zh: 在研討會閉幕結束之際，邀請與會者在公開問答環節中踴躍提問。

words.mnemonic: 會議日程大考點：at the conclusion of (在...結束之際)、reach a conclusion (得出結論)。

example.en: Factory employees are required to clock in electronically when reporting for their scheduled shift.
example.zh: 工廠員工在依排班報到上工時必須進行電子打卡。

words.mnemonic: 出勤打卡與全天候服務：clock in / clock out (上下班打卡)、around the clock (全天候24小時)。

example.en: The department director thanked everybody for contributing to the successful software rollout.
example.zh: 部門總監感謝了每位同仁為該軟體成功上線所做出的貢獻。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：everybody 與 everyone 相同，後面接「單數動詞」！

example.en: The resort hotel offers special discounted weekend rates for guests staying two consecutive nights.
example.zh: 該度假飯店為連續入住兩晚的旅客提供專案週末優惠房價。

words.mnemonic: 休閒與差旅考點：weekend rate (週末特價)、over the weekend (在週末期間)。

example.en: Factory maintenance mechanics regularly perform thorough safety inspections on all machines.
example.zh: 工廠維修技師定期對所有機具實施徹底的安全檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 執行檢驗與職責動詞：perform an inspection (進行檢查)、perform duties (履行職責)。
roots: form 形成 → 完整做出來

example.en: She gave a professional presentation.
example.zh: 我們追求為客戶提供專業的服務品質。

words.mnemonic: 專業的表現。

example.en: The heavy manufacturing corporation imports raw iron ore directly from overseas mining facilities.
example.zh: 這家重型製造企業直接向海外採礦廠進口天然鐵礦石原料。

words.mnemonic: 原料採掘與所有格：mining company (採礦公司)、friend of mine (我的一位朋友)。

example.en: After intense board debate, directors unanimously approved the international merger proposal.
example.zh: 在歷經董事會熱烈討論辯論後，董事們一致通過了跨國合併提案。

words.mnemonic: 政策探討名詞：under debate (在研議爭論中)、open to debate (尚待商榷)。

example.en: The updated corporate database server is equipped with sixteen gigabytes of rapid memory capacity.
example.zh: 升級後的企業資料庫伺服器配備有十六吉位元組 (GB) 的高速記憶體容量。

words.mnemonic: 電腦硬體規格必考：memory capacity (記憶體容量)、memory card (記憶卡)。

example.en: Our corporation adopted a green building policy to decrease energy consumption and carbon emissions.
example.zh: 我們企業採取了綠色環保建築政策，以降低能源消耗與碳排放。

words.mnemonic: 環保ESG關鍵詞：green energy (綠色能源)、green building (綠建築)。

example.en: The creative advertising agency composed a catchy promotional song for the retail product rollout.
example.zh: 創意廣告公司為零售產品上市推廣譜寫了一首朗朗上口的宣傳廣告歌曲。

words.mnemonic: 廣告宣傳樂曲：theme song (主題曲)、catchy song (悅耳洗腦歌)。

example.en: Several board members objected to the proposed price increase during the financial briefing.
example.zh: 數名董事會成員在財務簡報會議中對擬議的提價案表達了反對意見。

words.mnemonic: 動詞反對搭配介系詞 to：object to + V-ing/名詞；名詞失物 lost object。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟到面前、反對

example.en: Factory technicians work diligently to maintain all assembly equipment in optimal operating condition.
example.zh: 工廠技術員辛勤工作，以將所有組裝機具設備維持在最佳運轉狀態。

words.mnemonic: 維修保養核心動詞：maintain equipment (保養設備)、maintain standards (維持標準)。
roots: tain 握住 → 握在手中維持

example.en: Retail customers may pay for purchases using all major commercial credit cards or debit cards.
example.zh: 零售顧客可使用所有主要商業信用卡或簽帳金融卡進行購物付款。

words.mnemonic: 金融支付大考點：credit card (信用卡)、store credit (門市購物抵用金)。

example.en: Customer service representatives are trained to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 客戶服務專員受過專業訓練，能在響鈴三聲之內接聽進線電話。

words.mnemonic: 客服接聽與通話片語：give someone a ring (給某人打通電話)。

example.en: Visit our official website today to discover innovative cloud software solutions tailored for your business.
example.zh: 立即造訪我們的官方網站，發掘專為貴公司量身打造的創新雲端軟體解決方案。

words.mnemonic: 產品探索行銷用語：discover new solutions (發掘新解方)。

example.en: If the presentation laptop battery is dead, please plug it into the emergency wall outlet.
example.zh: 若簡報筆記型電腦電池沒電了，請將其插入緊急牆面壁座插座。

words.mnemonic: 電子設備沒電口語：battery is dead (電池沒電了)；名詞 deadline (截止日)。

example.en: The corporate executive strategy briefing is scheduled to begin at two o'clock this afternoon.
example.zh: 企業高階主管策略簡報會議預定於今天下午兩點整開始。

words.mnemonic: 會議時段標誌詞：this afternoon (今天下午)。
words.roots: after 之後 + noon 正午

example.en: Many business travelers prefer electronic boarding passes over traditional printed paper documents.
example.zh: 許多商務旅客比起傳統紙本列印憑證更偏好使用電子登機證。

words.mnemonic: 文法偏好比較考點：prefer A to B (喜歡A甚於B)。
roots: fer 攜帶 → 把某物放前面

example.en: The store extended its opening hours.
example.zh: 他們同意將截止日期延長兩天。

words.mnemonic: extend a deadline or service。

example.en: Management met to explore the possibility of expanding commercial distribution into Asian markets.
example.zh: 管理層會面以探討將商業經銷網絡擴展進軍亞洲市場的可能性。

words.mnemonic: 商機探討片語：explore the possibility of (探討...的可能性)。

example.en: Please follow the step-by-step assembly directions enclosed in the furniture product package.
example.zh: 請遵守家具產品包裝內所附之逐步組裝說明指南。

words.mnemonic: 說明書指南：follow directions (遵守說明)、ask for directions (問路)。

example.en: The sports facility opens at six.
example.zh: 工廠設施配備了最先進的安全系統。

words.mnemonic: 提供服務的場所。

example.en: The corporate cafeteria offers a wide variety of fresh salads, hot entrees, and healthy beverages.
example.zh: 企業員工餐廳提供各式各樣豐富的新鮮沙拉、熱食主菜與健康飲品。

words.mnemonic: 商品多元性必背片語：a wide variety of (各式各樣的)。

example.en: Hotel room rates include complimentary daily breakfast and high-speed wireless internet access.
example.zh: 飯店客房費率包含每日免費早餐與高速無線網路連線。

words.mnemonic: 日常與出勤用語：daily routine (日常作息)、daily rate (每日費率)。

example.en: Employees should wear business casual clothes in accordance with the corporate workplace dress code.
example.zh: 員工應當依據企業職場服儀規範穿著商務休閒服裝。

words.mnemonic: 複數名詞，無單數形：casual clothes (休閒服裝)、work clothes (工作服)。

example.en: Human resources specialists utilize automated software tools to screen job applicant resumes efficiently.
example.zh: 人力資源專員利用自動化軟體工具高效地篩選求職應徵者的履歷。

words.mnemonic: 人資篩選核心動詞：screen applicants (篩選求職者)、computer screen (電腦螢幕)。

example.en: Customers can easily track the real-time delivery status of their courier shipments online.
example.zh: 顧客可以輕鬆在線上即時追蹤其快遞貨件的最新配送進度。

words.mnemonic: 物流與人事大考點：track a shipment (追蹤貨件)、track record (過往績效紀錄)。

example.en: The corporate annual charity gala featured live jazz music and a spacious ballroom dance floor.
example.zh: 企業年度慈善晚會設有現場爵士樂演奏與寬敞的宴會廳舞池。

words.mnemonic: 晚會社交名詞：dance floor (舞池)。

example.en: We offer a money-back guarantee if clients are not completely satisfied with our consulting services.
example.zh: 若客戶對我們的顧問服務未能完全感到滿意，我們提供全額退費保證。

words.mnemonic: 滿意度評價副詞：completely satisfied (完全滿意)。

example.en: The corporation established an executive mentorship initiative to support female leadership development.
example.zh: 該企業設立了高階主管導師制度以支持女性領導力的發展。

words.mnemonic: 平等就業詞彙：female employees (女性同仁)、female leadership (女性領導)。

example.en: Overseeing cross-border supply chain logistics is a primary responsibility of the operations manager.
example.zh: 督導跨國供應鏈物流是營運經理的一項主要職責。

words.mnemonic: 職責描述與社會責任：job responsibilities (工作職責)、social responsibility (社會責任/CSR)。

example.en: Employees requesting reimbursement must submit original printed receipts to the accounting office.
example.zh: 申請報銷的同仁必須將原始列印收據正本呈繳至會計室。

words.mnemonic: 報帳與合約要件：original receipt (原始收據正本)、original copy (正本)。

example.en: Our logistics subsidiary collaborates closely with our European sister company on air freight.
example.zh: 我們的物流子公司在航空貨運方面與我們的歐洲姐妹公司進行密切合作。

words.mnemonic: 企業關係名詞：sister company (姐妹公司/關係企業)。

example.en: The waterfront luxury resort features a heated outdoor swimming pool built directly into natural rock.
example.zh: 這座濱水豪華度假飯店設有直接依天然岩石砌築的戶外溫水游泳池。

words.mnemonic: 飯店天然造景或比喻：solid as a rock (堅若磐石)。

example.en: Joining our innovative international engineering team could be your dream job in software development.
example.zh: 加入我們創新的國際工程團隊，可能會是您在軟體開發領域中的夢幻理想工作。

words.mnemonic: 夢想工作求職詞彙：dream job (夢想中的工作)。

example.en: Neither the project director nor the financial manager was available to attend the regional conference.
example.zh: 專案總監與財務經理兩位均無法抽空出席該區域大會。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重否定文法必考：neither A nor B (既不是A也不是B)。

example.en: Corporate recruiters will conduct on-campus job interviews at the local state university next week.
example.zh: 企業徵才主管將於下週在當地州立大學進行校園徵才面試。

words.mnemonic: 校園招募考點：university graduate (大學畢業生)、attend university (就讀大學)。

example.en: Online customers can easily manage their account preferences through our newly redesigned portal.
example.zh: 線上客戶可透過我們全新重新設計的入口網站輕鬆管理其帳戶偏好設定。

words.mnemonic: 操作便利性副詞：easily accessible (容易取得的/易於前往的)。

example.en: Corporate travelers booked their international flight tickets through our designated travel agency.
example.zh: 企業差旅人員透過我們指定的簽約旅行社預訂了國際機票。

words.mnemonic: 多益代理商核心名詞：travel agency (旅行社)、advertising agency (廣告公司)。

example.en: Orders exceeding one hundred dollars qualify for complimentary express ground freight shipping.
example.zh: 訂單金額超過一百美元者即可享有免費快捷陸運貨運配送。

words.mnemonic: 貨幣單位：dollar amount (美元金額)、US dollar (美金)。

example.en: The hotel features an outdoor landscaped botanical garden ideal for hosting corporate cocktail receptions.
example.zh: 該飯店設有一座造景植物花園，非常適合舉辦企業雞尾酒招待茶會。

words.mnemonic: 飯店庭園設施：roof garden (空中花園)、garden view (庭園景觀)。

example.en: The facility maintenance technician arrived promptly to fix the broken office air conditioner.
example.zh: 廠房維護技師迅速抵達，修復了損壞的辦公室空調冷氣機。

words.mnemonic: 維修動詞：fix a problem (解決問題)、fixed price (固定價格)。

example.en: Thanks to excellent teamwork, the construction project was completed three weeks ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 多虧了出色的團隊協同合作，該工程專案提前三週提前竣工。

words.mnemonic: 多益進度超前王牌片語：ahead of schedule (進度超前)！

example.en: Hotel guests may cross the street using the pedestrian bridge to reach the convention center safely.
example.zh: 飯店房客可經由人行天橋穿越街道，安全抵達會展中心。

words.mnemonic: 跨國合作與行人穿越：cross the street (穿越馬路)、cross-border (跨國的)。

example.en: Yeah, I can confirm that your flight reservation has been successfully updated.
example.zh: 是的，我可以為您確認您的航班預訂已經成功更新。

words.mnemonic: 職場與客服聽力常用口語應答，等同於 yes。

example.en: Each candidate submitted a resume.
example.zh: 這位候選人在面試中表現非常出色。

words.mnemonic: 求職與選舉都會使用。

example.en: The total shipping cost depends largely on the package weight and dimensions.
example.zh: 總運費很大程度取決於包裹的重量與尺寸。

words.mnemonic: 動詞 weigh (稱重) 的名詞形式，物流必備詞彙。

example.en: Our legal department will review the non-disclosure contract before we sign it.
example.zh: 我們的法務部門將在簽署保密合約之前進行審核。

words.mnemonic: leg (法律) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 法律上的、合法的。

example.en: The board approved the proposal.
example.zh: 董事會一致通過了這項商業提案。

words.mnemonic: 正式提案。

example.en: Please install the latest version of the enterprise accounting software.
example.zh: 請安裝這款企業會計軟體的最新版本。

words.mnemonic: vers (轉變、面向) + -ion ＝ 轉化出的版本。

example.en: I had a brief telephone conversation with the regional sales representative.
example.zh: 我與該區的業務代表進行了一段簡短的電話交談。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + vers (轉) + -ation ＝ 雙方相互輪轉交流 ＝ 對話。

example.en: Somebody from the IT help desk will assist you with setting up your laptop.
example.zh: 資訊技術支援小組會有人協助您設定筆記型電腦。

words.mnemonic: some (某個) + body (人) ＝ 某個人。

example.en: Airlines charge extra baggage fees if a suitcase exceeds fifty pounds.
example.zh: 如果行李箱超過五十磅，航空公司會加收行李超重費。

words.mnemonic: 常見符號 lb (磅) 或 £ (英鎊)，機場托運必考。

example.en: The corporate interview was published in a prestigious business magazine.
example.zh: 該企業專訪刊登在一本極負盛名的商業雜誌上。

words.mnemonic: 定期出版刊物，多益廣告文宣 (magazine subscription) 常考。

example.en: Effective market feedback helps shape our long-term product roadmap.
example.zh: 有效的市場回饋有助於塑造我們的長期產品藍圖。

words.mnemonic: 名詞指外形，動詞指「塑造/影響政策或產品」。

example.en: Bulk raw materials are typically transported across the continent by sea freight.
example.zh: 大宗原物料通常透過海運跨洲運送。

words.mnemonic: 海運 (by sea / sea freight) 相對於空運 (by air)。

example.en: Please reply immediately.
example.zh: 收到客訴信函後請立即回覆。

words.mnemonic: immediately = right away。

example.en: The resort staff greeted international guests with a warm welcome reception.
example.zh: 度假村員工以熱情的歡迎茶會接待各國貴賓。

words.mnemonic: well (好) + come (來) ＝ 歡迎光臨。

example.en: The front desk receptionist welcomed every client with a polite and confident smile.
example.zh: 櫃檯接待員以禮貌且充滿自信的微笑迎接每位客戶。

words.mnemonic: 客服核心表情：smile at clients (向客戶微笑)。

example.en: Transparent communication between department heads is vital to project success.
example.zh: 部門主管之間透明的溝通對專案的成功至關重要。

words.mnemonic: commun (公共、交流) + -ation (名詞) ＝ 溝通交流。

example.en: Please contact our designated travel agent to finalize your itinerary arrangements.
example.zh: 請聯繫我們指定的旅行社專員以確認您的行程安排。

words.mnemonic: ag- (做、行動) + -ent (人) ＝ 代理執行業務的人。

example.en: Digital marketing campaigns are proving far more cost-effective than traditional advertising.
example.zh: 數位行銷活動正證明比傳統廣告方式更具成本效益。

words.mnemonic: tradition (傳統) + -al (形容詞尾)。

example.en: We need to replace the broken printer.
example.zh: 損壞的零件必須在本週內更換完畢。

words.mnemonic: replace A with B。

example.en: Panel judges evaluated candidates based on both presentation clarity and business viability.
example.zh: 評審小組根據簡報清晰度與商業可行性來評定候選人。

words.mnemonic: jud- (判斷、公正) ＝ 評定裁決。

example.en: The vice president herself will deliver the keynote opening address this afternoon.
example.zh: 副總裁本人今天下午將親自發表開幕主題演說。

words.mnemonic: her + self ＝ 她自己、本人親自。

example.en: The scheduled conference call was suddenly canceled due to an urgent client meeting.
example.zh: 預定的電話會議因臨時的緊急客戶會談而突然取消。

words.mnemonic: sudden (突然的) + -ly (副詞尾)。

example.en: Our upcoming next-generation smartphones incorporate advanced energy-efficient microchips.
example.zh: 我們即將推出的下一代智慧型手機採用了先進的節能微晶片。

words.mnemonic: gen- (出生、產生) + -ation (名詞) ＝ 世代或產出。

example.en: The repair estimate is two hundred dollars.
example.zh: 承包商提供了一份詳細的翻修費用估價單。

words.mnemonic: 尚未確定的數字。

example.en: The caramel latte remains the favorite beverage among morning commuters.
example.zh: 焦糖拿鐵依然是晨間通勤族最喜愛的飲品首選。

words.mnemonic: favor (喜愛/恩惠) + -ite ＝ 最喜愛的。

example.en: The executive management committee convenes every Monday morning at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 高階主管管理委員會每週一上午九點整召開常會。

words.mnemonic: Moon (月亮) + day ＝ 星期一，商務排程核心詞。

example.en: Quarterly sales figures will be released to public shareholders on Tuesday afternoon.
example.zh: 季度銷售數據將於週二下午向大眾股東公布。

words.mnemonic: 多益日程行程必考星期詞彙。

example.en: All employee expense claims must be submitted to human resources by Wednesday.
example.zh: 所有員工費用報銷單必須在週三之前提交至人力資源部。

words.mnemonic: 注意發音 d 不發音 (/ˈwenzdeɪ/)，週三日程常考。

example.en: The corporate training seminar on cybersecurity protocols is scheduled for Thursday.
example.zh: 關於網路安全規範的企業培訓研討會排定於週四舉行。

words.mnemonic: Thor (雷神) 之日 ＝ 星期四。

example.en: Our office observes casual dress code on Friday throughout the summer months.
example.zh: 在整個夏季期間，我們辦公室在週五實施便服穿著規定。

words.mnemonic: Frigg 之日 ＝ 週末前夕 (Casual Friday 常見情境)。

example.en: The downtown customer service center operates half-day hours every Saturday.
example.zh: 市中心客戶服務中心每週六提供半天的營運服務。

words.mnemonic: Saturn (土星) 之日 ＝ 週六週末營業時間考點。

example.en: Hotel room checkout time on Sunday is extended until one o'clock for loyalty members.
example.zh: 會員貴賓在週日的飯店退房時間可延長至下午一點。

words.mnemonic: Sun (太陽) 之日 ＝ 星期日。

example.en: The corporate fiscal budget takes official effect on the first day of January.
example.zh: 企業新會計年度預算於一月一日正式生效。

words.mnemonic: Janus (雙面守護神) ＝ 開啟新年的月份。

example.en: Annual performance review meetings will conclude before the end of February.
example.zh: 年度績效考核面談將在二月底前全數完成。

words.mnemonic: 一年中最短的月份，財報第一季排程考點。

example.en: The international trade expo will be held in Tokyo starting in late March.
example.zh: 國際商貿博覽會將於三月下旬在東京揭幕舉行。

words.mnemonic: 第一季結束之月份；動詞指堅定前進。

example.en: Corporate tax filing declarations must be finalized before mid-April.
example.zh: 企業報稅申報作業必須在四月中旬前定案完成。

words.mnemonic: 第二季開端，多益稅務與第二季預算考點。

example.en: The annual corporate shareholder assembly is traditionally convened in May.
example.zh: 企業年度股東大會依慣例於五月份召開。

words.mnemonic: 五月；作為助動詞時表示許可 (may I) 或可能性。

example.en: Mid-year financial balance sheets will be prepared and audited by late June.
example.zh: 年中財務資產負債表將在六月下旬前編製並完成審計。

words.mnemonic: 半年結算月，年中促銷 (mid-year sale) 常見期程。

example.en: Resort room occupancy rates peak significantly during the month of July.
example.zh: 度假村客房住房率在七月份期間達到顯著高峰。

words.mnemonic: 暑假旅遊旺季 (peak season) 典型月份。

example.en: Factory operations will be temporarily suspended in mid-August for equipment maintenance.
example.zh: 工廠營運將在八月中旬暫停以進行設備年度檢修。

words.mnemonic: 夏季休假與廠房年度歲修常見月份。

example.en: The university campus recruiting drive commences in early September each year.
example.zh: 校園招募徵才會於每年九月上旬正式展開。

words.mnemonic: 秋季開學與企業校園徵才核心月份。

example.en: The autumn industrial manufacturing summit takes place in late October.
example.zh: 秋季工業製造高峰會排定於十月下旬舉行。

words.mnemonic: 秋季商貿展覽與第四季規劃重要月份。

example.en: Logistics warehouses prepare for substantial shipping surges starting in November.
example.zh: 物流發貨中心自十一月起便為龐大的出貨高峰做好準備。

words.mnemonic: 感恩節與黑五購物出貨旺季月份。

example.en: The corporate headquarters will remain closed for winter recess throughout late December.
example.zh: 企業總部將在十二月下旬期間休假關閉。

words.mnemonic: 年終結算與假期排程必備詞彙。

example.en: If you experience any technical difficulty during online registration, please call support.
example.zh: 如果您在線上註冊期間遇到任何技術困難，請致電支援中心。

words.mnemonic: difficult (困難的) + -y (名詞尾)；片語 have difficulty in (做...有困難)。

example.en: The department purchased new computers.
example.zh: 請保留收據作為這筆購買的證明。

words.mnemonic: 比 buy 正式。

example.en: The marketing crew will shoot promotional video clips at the production plant.
example.zh: 行銷團隊將在生產廠區拍攝宣傳影片短片。

words.mnemonic: 拍攝廣告影片常用動詞 (shoot a video/commercial)。

example.en: The board of directors will announce the newly appointed managing director tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天公布新任常務董事人選。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + nounce (宣告、報告) ＝ 向大眾宣告。

example.en: Visitors may not enter the high-security facility unless escorted by staff.
example.zh: 訪客除非有員工陪同，否則不得進入高度維安設施。

words.mnemonic: 條件連接詞，等同於 if ... not，多益文法題極高頻。

example.en: An independent accounting auditor was hired to inspect our annual ledger records.
example.zh: 公司聘請了一位獨立的會計查核員來審查我們的年度總帳紀錄。

words.mnemonic: in- (不) + de- (下) + pend (懸掛、依靠) + -ent ＝ 不倚靠他人 ＝ 獨立的。

example.en: I recommend this restaurant to visitors.
example.zh: 我強烈推薦這款軟體以提高工作效率。

words.mnemonic: 後面接名詞或動名詞。

example.en: Customers completed a short survey.
example.zh: 請撥冗填寫我們的客戶滿意度調查。

words.mnemonic: 問卷調查。

example.en: A clear majority of voting shareholders approved the proposed corporate merger.
example.zh: 絕大多數具投票權的股東通過了提議的企業合併案。

words.mnemonic: major (較大的) + -ity (名詞尾) ＝ 大多數。

example.en: Project teams must stick strictly to the established budget guidelines and limits.
example.zh: 專案團隊必須嚴格恪遵既定的預算準則與上限限制。

words.mnemonic: 片語 stick to (堅持、遵循規定)；memory stick (記憶卡)。

example.en: We received a request for more information.
example.zh: 我們收到了客戶提出的退款申請。

words.mnemonic: 正式信件常見。

example.en: Our new senior engineering consultant brings a rich background in automated logistics.
example.zh: 我們的新任資深工程顧問具備自動化物流領域的豐富資歷。

words.mnemonic: 職場常考「經驗/資源豐富」(rich in experience/features)。

example.en: The energy corporation invested heavily in offshore wind power turbine technology.
example.zh: 該能源公司在離岸風力渦輪發電機技術上進行了巨額投資。

words.mnemonic: 綠色能源考題常見：wind power (風力發電)、wind turbine (風力發電機)。

example.en: None of the defective inventory items were shipped out to retail stores.
example.zh: 瑕疵庫存品中沒有任何一件被運送至零售門市。

words.mnemonic: not one 的縮合 ＝ 沒有任何一個。

example.en: International business travelers can exchange currencies at the airport arrivals terminal.
example.zh: 跨國商務旅客可在機場入境航廈兌換各國外幣。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出、外) + change (改變) ＝ 雙方相互更換 ＝ 匯兌、換貨。

example.en: The marketing director submitted a revised quarterly advertising budget for review.
example.zh: 行銷總監提交了一份修訂後的季度廣告預算以供審查。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業財報極核心字彙：annual budget (年度預算)、on a budget (節省預算)。

example.en: The resort is world-famous for its luxurious beachfront accommodations and spa.
example.zh: 這座度假勝地因其奢華的濱海住宿與水療設施而舉世聞名。

words.mnemonic: fame (名氣) + -ous (充滿...的形容詞尾) ＝ 著名的。

example.en: The company wellness fair offers complimentary blood pressure screenings to all employees.
example.zh: 公司員工健康展向全體員工提供免費的血壓量測服務。

words.mnemonic: 員工健檢 (health screening) 與福利常考搭配：blood test (驗血)、blood pressure (血壓)。

example.en: All factory technicians must wear appropriate safety gear when entering the cleanroom.
example.zh: 所有廠區技術人員進入無塵室時均必須穿戴適當的安全護具。

words.mnemonic: ad- (朝向) + propri (適當、專屬) + -ate ＝ 適合該場合的。

example.en: The regional corporate branch office is situated just two blocks from the metro station.
example.zh: 該區域企業分部辦公室距離捷運站僅僅兩個街區。

words.mnemonic: 名詞指市區「街區 (two blocks away)」，動詞指「阻擋 (block access)」。

example.en: The hotel receptionist extended a warm greeting to every newly arrived guest.
example.zh: 飯店櫃檯接待員向每位新抵達的房客致上熱誠的問候。

words.mnemonic: 服務業禮貌接待用語：warm welcome (熱情歡迎)。

example.en: Warehouse clerks count physical inventory items at the close of every fiscal quarter.
example.zh: 倉儲庫存人員在每個會計季度末盤點計算實體庫存品。

words.mnemonic: 多益盤點必備：inventory count (盤點庫存)；片語 count on (指望、信賴)。

example.en: Emergency maintenance engineers arrived at the factory accident scene within minutes.
example.zh: 緊急維修工程師在數分鐘內便抵達了工廠事故現場。

words.mnemonic: 事故處理或影視廣告必備：on the scene (在現場)。

example.en: Our advertising agency hired an experienced copywriter to craft website marketing content.
example.zh: 我們的廣告代理商聘請了一位經驗豐富的文案專員來撰寫網站行銷內容。

words.mnemonic: write (寫) + -er (人) ＝ 撰稿人、文案創作者 (copywriter)。

example.en: The corporate communications team regularly updates digital media content on our portal.
example.zh: 企業公關團隊定期在我們的入口網站上更新數位媒體內容。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + ten- (保持、容納) ＝ 容納於其中的東西 ＝ 內容。

example.en: Routine equipment calibration helps prevent costly production assembly line stoppages.
example.zh: 常規的設備校準有助於防止代價高昂的產線停工事故。

words.mnemonic: pre- (預先) + vent (來) ＝ 在問題來之前先擋下 ＝ 預防。

example.en: Guests are strongly advised to keep personal valuables inside their hotel room safe.
example.zh: 強烈建議房客將個人貴重物品妥善存放於飯店客房保險箱內。

words.mnemonic: 形容詞指安全的，名詞指「客房保險箱」(in-room safe)。

example.en: We cordially invite all regional business partners to attend our annual product showcase.
example.zh: 我們誠摯地邀請所有區域商業夥伴出席我們的年度產品發表會。

words.mnemonic: 名詞 invitation (邀請函)，多益商務社交極常見動詞。

example.en: Our strategic marketing mix includes targeted digital advertising and sponsored industry events.
example.zh: 我們的行銷組合策略涵蓋了精準數位廣告投放與贊助行業盛會。

words.mnemonic: 行銷核心名詞搭配：marketing mix (行銷組合)、product mix (產品線組合)。

example.en: Clear accountability is an essential element of modern corporate governance standards.
example.zh: 清晰的權責劃分是現代企業治理標準不可或缺的核心要素。

words.mnemonic: 重要構成要素：key element (關鍵要素)、essential element (不可或缺的要素)。

example.en: The new policy is effective immediately.
example.zh: 新的考勤規範將於下個月初正式生效。

words.mnemonic: effective = works well。

example.en: Please ensure that your billing address details are entirely correct before checkout.
example.zh: 結帳之前請務必確認您的帳單地址資料完全正確無誤。

words.mnemonic: cor- (共同、完全) + rect (正、直) ＝ 完全端正 ＝ 正確的。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits package includes full comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
example.zh: 該企業員工福利方案涵蓋了全面的醫療與牙科保險保障。

words.mnemonic: 福利制度考點：medical insurance (醫療保險)、medical leave (病假)。

example.en: Only pre-registered trade attendees will be admitted to the exhibition hall today.
example.zh: 今天只有事先完成報名的商務人士方能獲准進入展覽大廳。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + mit (送、放行) ＝ 放行進入或承認。

example.en: Our discount airfare policy promises to beat any competitor price by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們的折扣機票保證比任何競爭對手的價格再優惠百分之十。

words.mnemonic: 商業競爭常見：beat the competition (擊敗競爭對手)、beat the deadline (趕在期限前)。

example.en: The client requested a follow-up telephone consultation to review the proposal terms.
example.zh: 客戶要求安排後續電話諮詢，以審視企劃書各項條款。

words.mnemonic: tele- (遠距離) + phone (聲音) ＝ 電話溝通。

example.en: Please print a hard copy of the final audit report for today's executive review.
example.zh: 請為今天的主管審核會議列印一份最終審計報告的紙本副本。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室必備：hard copy (紙本列印)、make a copy (影印)。

example.en: The corporate executive steering committee approved the new overseas expansion strategy.
example.zh: 企業執行指導委員會核准了新的海外擴張戰略規劃。

words.mnemonic: com- (共同) + mit (託付) + -ee (被託付的人群) ＝ 受託處理事務的委員會。

example.en: Employees should be fully aware of company data privacy and cybersecurity regulations.
example.zh: 全體員工應當完全知悉公司的數據隱私保護與網路資安規範。

words.mnemonic: 常見片語：be aware of (知悉、意識到)；名詞 awareness (知名度/警覺性)。

example.en: We consulted a certified financial planner for professional advice on corporate tax restructuring.
example.zh: 我們諮詢了認證理財規劃師，就企業稅務重組獲取專業建議。

words.mnemonic: 注意是不可數名詞！動詞形式為 advise (提供建議)。

example.en: She handles customer complaints professionally.
example.zh: 客服團隊妥善處理了所有客訴案件。

words.mnemonic: handle a problem = 處理問題。

example.en: The modern corporate office design features energy-efficient double-glazed glass partitions.
example.zh: 這間現代化辦公室採用了節能的雙層隔熱玻璃隔間設計。

words.mnemonic: 常指玻璃建材或餐旅飲品容器 (glass of water)。

example.en: New subscribers are entitled to a thirty-day free trial of our project management platform.
example.zh: 新註冊用戶享有我們專案管理平台的三十天免費試用期優惠。

words.mnemonic: 軟體推廣極高頻詞：free trial (免費試用)、trial period (試用期)。

example.en: The keynote speaker stressed the paramount importance of continuous workforce upskilling.
example.zh: 主題演講貴賓特別強調了持續提升員工專業技能的無比重要性。

words.mnemonic: 名詞指工作壓力，動詞常考「強調某論點」(stress the importance of)。

example.en: The automotive dealership ran an aggressive radio advertisement campaign over the holiday weekend.
example.zh: 該汽車經銷商在假期週末推出了密集的廣播廣告宣傳活動。

words.mnemonic: 廣告媒體通路：radio advertisement (廣播廣告)、on the radio。

example.en: The hospital administration introduced streamlined electronic patient record management systems.
example.zh: 醫院行政管理階層引入了簡化流程的電子病歷管理系統。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + minister (服務、管理) + -ation ＝ 行政主管機構。

meaning: 綜合大樓/複合式園區(名詞)

example.en: Our international engineering firm relocated its headquarters to a modern office complex.
example.zh: 我們的國際工程公司已將總部遷入一座現代化的綜合辦公大樓園區。

words.mnemonic: com- (共同) + plex (重疊、編織) ＝ 盤根錯節的 ＝ 複雜的、建築綜合體。

example.en: The automated reservation system sent a confirmation text message to the client's phone.
example.zh: 自動預約系統發送了一則確認簡訊至客戶的手機。

words.mnemonic: text message (簡訊通知)，客服即時通知核心考點。

example.en: The market analyst explained our recent revenue decline within the context of global inflation.
example.zh: 市場分析師在考量全球通膨背景下解釋了我們近期的營收下滑現象。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + text (編織) ＝ 共同織出的時空脈絡 ＝ 背景、上下文。

example.en: Complimentary shuttle bus rides to the airport terminal are provided every thirty minutes.
example.zh: 前往機場航廈的免費接駁巴士每三十分鐘提供一趟乘車服務。

words.mnemonic: 交通工具接送常用：give someone a ride (順道載某人一程)。

example.en: Inquiries regarding commercial loan applications should be submitted directly to our branch.
example.zh: 有關商業貸款申請的諮詢事宜，請直接向本行分行提出。

words.mnemonic: direct (直接的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 直接、逕行。

example.en: Delivery trucks encountered extended transit delays due to unusually heavy highway traffic.
example.zh: 由於高速公路交通異常擁塞繁忙，物流貨車遭遇了嚴重的運送延誤。

words.mnemonic: 交通或降雨極常見修飾詞：heavy traffic (交通擁塞)、heavy rain (暴雨)。

example.en: Facilities staff will remove obsolete electronic computer equipment from the third floor.
example.zh: 總務總理人員將從三樓撤除淘汰的老舊電腦設備。

words.mnemonic: re- (回、離開) + move (移動) ＝ 移走、去除。

example.en: The quality assurance department will conduct an unannounced audit of the production facility.
example.zh: 品保部門將對廠區生產設施進行一場無預警的品質稽核。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + duct (引導) ＝ 引領推進 ＝ 舉辦、執行調研。

example.en: The office purchased new equipment.
example.zh: 工廠安裝了最先進的檢驗設備。

words.mnemonic: equipment 通常不可數。

example.en: All invoices must be settled within thirty days unless explicitly specified otherwise.
example.zh: 所有發票必須在三十天內結清，除非合約中另有特別說明規定。

words.mnemonic: other (其他) + -wise (方式) ＝ 換個角度、否則 (unless otherwise noted)。

example.en: Please write down your official job title and department division on the security badge form.
example.zh: 請在門禁識別證申請表上填寫您的正式職稱與所屬部門。

words.mnemonic: 人資面試與證件常見：job title (職稱頭銜)、property title (不動產所有權狀)。

example.en: Airlines impose extra handling fees for oversized baggage exceeding standard dimensions.
example.zh: 航空公司針對超出標準尺寸的超大行李加收額外的手續處理費。

words.mnemonic: extra- (超出)，商務常見 extra charge / extra cost (額外收費)。

example.en: Senior corporate executives met privately to deliberate potential overseas acquisition bids.
example.zh: 高階企業主管召開不公開閉門會議，以審議潛在的海外併購提案。

words.mnemonic: execute (執行) + -ive ＝ 具備決策執行權力的階層 ＝ 高階管理人員 (CEO)。

example.en: Dr. Ramirez was selected to chair the international environmental policy symposium.
example.zh: 拉米瑞茲博士獲選主持本屆國際環境保護政策研討大會。

words.mnemonic: 會議必考：chair a meeting (主持會議)、committee chair (委員會主席)。

example.en: Upgrading older enterprise computer servers immediately would prove unnecessarily expensive.
example.zh: 若立刻全面升級老舊的企業伺服器將顯得過於昂貴且非必要。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + pens (花費、秤重支付) + -ive ＝ 花費巨大的 ＝ 昂貴的。

example.en: Prospective corporate buyers received complimentary product samples at the trade booth.
example.zh: 潛在的企業採購客戶在展位上領取了免費的產品樣品。

words.mnemonic: 商貿展覽必備：free sample (免費樣品)、sample product (樣品)。

example.en: Corporate hiring regulations prohibit workplace discrimination based on race or sex.
example.zh: 企業聘僱規章嚴格禁止基於種族或性別的任何職場歧視。

words.mnemonic: 人事申請表格或反歧視政策 (equal opportunity) 核心名詞。

example.en: We deliver orders within two days.
example.zh: 包裹將於明天下午親自遞送到府。

words.mnemonic: deliver an order。

example.en: The global project team organized a weekly video conference to coordinate deliverables.
example.zh: 跨國專案小組每週安排一次視訊會議以協調整合各項交付工作。

words.mnemonic: vid- (看) ＝ 影像視訊；video conference (視訊會議) 多益必備。

example.en: Due to weather delays in Chicago, passenger flight connections were automatically rebooked.
example.zh: 由於芝加哥的惡劣天氣延誤，旅客的轉機航班已由系統自動重新改訂。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + nect (綁定) + -ion ＝ 轉機 (connecting flight) 或網路連結。

example.en: Customer satisfaction retention is the primary objective of our new service charter.
example.zh: 提高客戶滿意度與維繫率是我們新服務憲章的首要核心目標。

words.mnemonic: prim- (第一、最初) + -ary ＝ 首屈一指的、首要的。

example.en: Regional flight schedules were temporarily delayed due to severe thunderstorm weather.
example.zh: 由於遭遇嚴重的雷雨天氣，該地區的多架航班行程暫時遭到延誤。

words.mnemonic: 機場廣播與物流延遲常客：severe weather (惡劣氣候)、weather forecast (天氣預報)。

example.en: Customers may collect their online orders directly from the store pickup counter.
example.zh: 顧客可直接於門市取貨櫃檯領取其線上訂購的商品。

words.mnemonic: col- (共同) + lect (挑選、集合) ＝ 聚集到一處 ＝ 收集、取件。

example.en: We will inform you of the decision.
example.zh: 我們遺憾地通知您班機將延誤啟程。

words.mnemonic: inform someone of something。
roots: form 形成 → 使心中成形、告知

example.en: Our corporate business philosophy is founded on strict ethical and transparency principles.
example.zh: 我們的企業經營哲學建立在嚴格的道德與透明度原則之上。

words.mnemonic: prin- (第一) + cip- (拿取) ＝ 最根本的依據 ＝ 原則；注意與 principal (校長/本金) 區分。

example.en: Take a straight path through the concourse toward passenger boarding gate forty-two.
example.zh: 沿著大廳筆直向前走，即可抵達四十二號登機門。

words.mnemonic: 交通指引常用：go straight (直走)；straightforward (直截了當的)。

example.en: The innovative smartphone sleek design appeals strongly to young tech-savvy consumers.
example.zh: 這款智慧型手機的創新流線外型對年輕科技族群具有極大的吸引力。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + pel- (驅使、推) ＝ 把人心推向它 ＝ 吸引 (appeal to)。

example.en: Ms. Jenkins comes highly recommended by several prestigious engineering executive directors.
example.zh: 詹金斯女士獲得數位知名工程主管的一致高度推薦。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻副詞搭配：highly recommended (高度推薦)、highly qualified (條件極佳)。

example.en: Building long-term client trust is essential for sustainable corporate wealth advisory services.
example.zh: 建立長期的客戶信賴對於永續經營企業財富顧問服務至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 商業信用基礎：mutual trust (互信)、earn trust (贏得信賴)。

example.en: Guests expressed that they had a truly wonderful dining experience at the resort restaurant.
example.zh: 賓客們表示在度假村餐廳享受到了一次極為美妙出色的用餐體驗。

words.mnemonic: wonder (驚嘆) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 令人極其滿意讚嘆的。

example.en: Our logistics courier offers a convenient flat rate shipping fee for standard parcel boxes.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流為標準包裹紙箱提供便捷的單一固定運費。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業財經核心搭配：flat rate (單一費率)、sales remained flat (營收持平未增減)。

example.en: Meeting the strict delivery deadline is absolutely critical to retaining this corporate client.
example.zh: 嚴格達成交貨期限對於留住這家企業重要客戶而言是絕對關鍵的。

words.mnemonic: ab- (離) + solut (鬆開、解開) ＝ 完全不受拘束 ＝ 絕對地 (absolutely necessary)。

example.en: Careful working capital management ensures steady cash flow during seasonal sales slowdowns.
example.zh: 審慎的營運資金管理確保了在淡季銷售放緩期間仍維持穩定的現金流。

words.mnemonic: 多益財務極高頻：cash flow (現金流)；workflow (工作流程)。

example.en: Our recruitment team booked an exhibition booth at the metropolitan job fair next month.
example.zh: 我們的招募團隊在下個月的都會就業博覽會上預訂了展覽攤位。

words.mnemonic: 名詞常考商展：job fair (就業博覽會)、trade fair (貿易展)；形容詞指公平 (fair share)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested additional funding resources to hire temporary contract workers.
example.zh: 專案主管申請了額外的預算資源以聘請臨時約聘人員。

words.mnemonic: add (增加) + -tion (名詞) + -al ＝ 附加的 (additional charge / info)。

example.en: She is responsible for the budget.
example.zh: 經理負責主導海外市場擴張企劃。

words.mnemonic: responsible for + 名詞。

example.en: The supermarket chain procures fresh organic vegetables directly from certified local farms.
example.zh: 該連鎖超市直接自在地獲得認證的有機農場採購新鮮生鮮蔬菜。

words.mnemonic: 採購食品原物料常用：organic farm (有機農場)、farm-to-table (產地直送餐桌)。

example.en: The fashion retailer will launch its new autumn clothing collection in flagship stores.
example.zh: 該時尚零售商將在旗艦門市發表其全新的秋季服裝系列產品。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：new collection (新系列商品) 或 debt collection (催討應收帳款)。

example.en: Hotel guests may hang the 'Do Not Disturb' card outside on their room door handle.
example.zh: 飯店房客可將「請勿打擾」標示卡懸掛在房門把手外側。

words.mnemonic: 客房常考：hang a sign (掛上標示牌)；片語 hang up (掛斷電話)。

example.en: Customer service representatives responded quickly to resolve negative online reviews.
example.zh: 客服專員迅速做出回應以處理並解決網路上的負面評價。

words.mnemonic: neg- (否定、拒絕) + -ive ＝ 負面的 (negative feedback / review)。

example.en: The marketing department divided our consumer products into distinct premium pricing bands.
example.zh: 行銷部門將我們的消費性產品劃分入不同的優質價格區間帶。

words.mnemonic: 名詞指樂團或「價格區間帶 (price band) / 頻寬 (broadband)」。

example.en: We evaluated the relative cost advantages of local manufacturing versus offshore outsourcing.
example.zh: 我們評估了在地製造與海外委外代工兩者之間的相對成本優勢。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + lat (帶來) + -ive ＝ 相互帶入比較的 ＝ 相對的。

example.en: Prospective overseas investors were taken on a comprehensive guided tour of the factory plant.
example.zh: 海外潛在投資人獲邀參加了一場全方位的工廠廠區專人導覽參訪。

words.mnemonic: 參訪行程常見：guided tour (專人導覽)、factory tour (廠房巡視參觀)。

example.en: Management explored alternative shipping suppliers to mitigate ongoing maritime freight delays.
example.zh: 管理階層評估了替代的航運供應商以緩解持續發生的海運延誤危機。

words.mnemonic: alter (其他、改變) + -ative ＝ 其他可選的路徑 ＝ 替代方案。

example.en: The corporate technology team deployed enterprise accounting software across all branches.
example.zh: 企業資訊科技團隊在所有分行全面佈署了企業資源會計軟體。

words.mnemonic: soft (軟) + ware (器具製品) ＝ 電腦軟體（注意不可數名詞）。

example.en: Every technician working on the electronic assembly line is issued a pair of anti-static gloves.
example.zh: 每位在電子組裝產線工作的技術員皆獲發一雙防靜電手套。

words.mnemonic: 量詞常用：a pair of (一雙/一副)；pair up with (與...搭配合作)。

example.en: The automated distribution center can ship confirmed online retail orders within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 該自動化物流中心能在二十四小時內將確認的線上零售訂單完成出貨。

words.mnemonic: 物流核心動詞：ship an order (訂單出貨)；名詞 shipment (裝運貨物)。

example.en: A positive customer-first attitude is the most valued quality in our hospitality staff.
example.zh: 積極主動的顧客至上心態是我們飯店款待人員中最受看重的特質。

words.mnemonic: 職場考核重點：positive attitude (正向態度)、attitude towards work。

example.en: Budget airlines offer cheap domestic fares by charging extra for checked baggage.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司透過對托運行李額外收費來提供極為便宜的國內線機票。

words.mnemonic: 價格實惠 (cheap airfare)；在商務文案中常以 affordable 代替以避免廉價感。

example.en: Our digital sales revenue doubled following the nationwide promotional discount campaign.
example.zh: 在全國性促銷折扣活動推行之後，我們的數位銷售營收翻倍成長。

words.mnemonic: 業績翻倍 (revenue doubled)；飯店 double room (雙人客房)。

example.en: The final flight leg of our business journey departs from Frankfurt at eight tonight.
example.zh: 我們出差行程的最後一段航程預定於今晚八點自法蘭克福起飛。

words.mnemonic: 多益旅行航段特殊義：the first/last leg of the journey (旅程的第一/最後一段)。

example.en: All factory production contractors must strictly observe national environmental safety regulations.
example.zh: 所有工廠生產承包商均必須嚴格遵守國家環境保護安全法規。

words.mnemonic: ob- (朝向) + serv (守護、注意) ＝ 留心注意 ＝ 觀察或嚴格遵守規章。

example.en: Please draft a concise summary sentence to introduce the main points of the proposal.
example.zh: 請撰寫一句簡明扼要的摘要句，以引言說明企劃案的核心要點。

words.mnemonic: sent- (感覺、判斷) ＝ 表達完整判斷意義的話 ＝ 句子或司法判決。

example.en: Please print fifty copies of the executive conference agenda for our board members.
example.zh: 請為董事會成員列印五十份主管會議議程。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室硬體：laser printer (雷射印表機)、fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: The project development team will present a quarterly progress report to senior stakeholders.
example.zh: 專案開發團隊將向資深專案利害關係人提交季度進度報告。

words.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + gress (行走) ＝ 向前邁進 ＝ 進度、進展 (progress report)。

example.en: Transparent accounting audits reveal the underlying financial truth of company operations.
example.zh: 透明公開的會計審計能如實揭露公司日常營運背後的真實財務現況。

words.mnemonic: true (真實的) + -th (抽象名詞尾) ＝ 真理、事實真相。

example.en: Nobody was permitted inside the server room without displaying a verified authorization badge.
example.zh: 未出示經核實的授權識別證者，任何人皆不得進入伺服器主機室。

words.mnemonic: no + body (人) ＝ 沒有任何人。

example.en: Quality control inspectors will thoroughly examine every electronic circuit component for manufacturing defects.
example.zh: 品管檢驗人員將澈底檢查每個電子電路元件是否存在製造缺陷。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + ag- (秤量、衡量) ＝ 嚴格檢測 ＝ 檢查、檢視。

example.en: Due to company restructuring, the corporate management had to lay off sixty workers.
example.zh: 由於公司組織重整，企業管理層不得不裁減解僱六十名員工。

words.mnemonic: 多益人資必考片語：lay off (裁員解僱)；lay off workers (裁撤勞工)。

example.en: Upgrading automated processing equipment will greatly improve order fulfillment turnaround speed.
example.zh: 升級自動化處理設備將大幅提升訂單履行完成的周轉處理速度。

words.mnemonic: 商務效率核心詞：high speed (高速)、speed up (加速)。

example.en: Human resources managers strive to cultivate a transparent culture free of toxic office politics.
example.zh: 人力資源經理致力於營造遠離惡性辦公室政治的透明企業文化。

words.mnemonic: polit- (城市、公民) ＝ 政治運作；office politics (辦公室政治人事角力)。

example.en: Our support center guarantees that agents will reply to client inquiries within two hours.
example.zh: 我們的客服中心保證客服專員會在兩小時之內回覆客戶諮詢。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + ply (折疊、回應) ＝ 回覆信函 (reply to an email)。

example.en: New retail tablet models will be prominently displayed on the front showroom floor.
example.zh: 新款零售平板電腦樣機將醒目地展示陳列在前側展廳展示區。

words.mnemonic: dis- (分開、向外) + play (展開、折疊) ＝ 展開供眾人觀看 ＝ 陳列、展示。

example.en: Please transfer the payment today.
example.zh: 他申請調任至芝加哥分公司服務。

words.mnemonic: 轉帳或轉移。

example.en: Her bilingual fluency and international marketing experience make her a perfect candidate for the post.
example.zh: 她的雙語流利程度與跨國行銷歷練使她成為該職位的最佳完美人選。

words.mnemonic: per- (澈底) + fect (做) ＝ 澈底做完做到極致 ＝ 完美的。

example.en: Quarterly operational operating expenditures were slightly lower than preliminary financial projections.
example.zh: 第三季營業營運支出略低於原先初期的財務預算預測。

words.mnemonic: slight (輕微的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 稍微 (slightly higher / lower than)。

example.en: The corporate annual financial audit demonstrated a noticeable improvement in overall enterprise profitability.
example.zh: 企業年度財務查核報告顯示整體企業獲利能力呈現顯著改善。

words.mnemonic: over (涵蓋全部) + all (全部) ＝ 全面的、總體的 (overall performance)。

example.en: The pharmaceutical company intends to open three new medical research labs in Singapore.
example.zh: 這間製藥公司打算在新加坡設立三座新的醫藥研發實驗室。

words.mnemonic: in- (向內) + tend (伸展、傾向) ＝ 心之所向 ＝ 打算做某事 (intend to do)。

example.en: Software engineers conducted usability testing sessions with more than two hundred active users.
example.zh: 軟體工程師與兩百多位活躍用戶共同進行了軟體易用性測試會。

words.mnemonic: use (使用) + -er (人) ＝ 軟體或產品的使用者 (user manual / experience)。

example.en: Customer service agents are required to respond to urgent complaints within one business day.
example.zh: 客服專員被要求必須在一個工作天內回應緊急客訴問題。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + spond (承諾、回答) ＝ 給予承諾回覆 ＝ 回應 (respond to)。

example.en: The annual corporate recognition award dinner will be hosted in the hotel grand ballroom.
example.zh: 年度企業優秀員工表揚晚宴將在飯店的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

words.mnemonic: 商務社交必備：annual dinner (年終晚宴)、business dinner (商務晚宴)。

example.en: Retail commerce historically experiences a slow sales turnaround period during early February.
example.zh: 零售商業在歷史數據上往往於二月上旬經歷一段較為遲緩的銷售淡季。

words.mnemonic: 景氣或淡季常用：slow season (淡季)、slow down (減速)。

example.en: Conducting regular preventative maintenance extends the operating lifespan of factory machinery.
example.zh: 進行定期的預防性維護檢修可有效延長廠區機械設備的使用壽命。

words.mnemonic: regul- (規則) + -ar ＝ 照規則定期的 ＝ 常規的 (regular meeting)。

example.en: The retail book company maintains physical storefronts alongside a booming e-commerce platform.
example.zh: 這家連鎖書商在蓬勃發展電子商務平台的同時，依然維持著實體門市營運。

words.mnemonic: physic (自然、身體) + -al ＝ 實體的 (physical store) 或健檢 (physical exam)。

example.en: Apart from minor cosmetic packaging flaws, all shipments fulfilled strict quality standards.
example.zh: 除了少數包裝上的輕微外觀瑕疵外，全數出貨均符合嚴格的品質標準。

words.mnemonic: a- + part (部分) ＝ 各自成一部分；片語 apart from (除了...之外)。

example.en: Flexible hybrid remote hours suit the productivity needs of our digital design team.
example.zh: 彈性的混合遠距上班工時極為適合我們數位設計團隊的產能需求。

words.mnemonic: 職場服儀：business suit (商務西裝套裝)；動詞指合適 (suit one's needs)。

example.en: All domestic corporate financial statements must strictly comply with federal tax laws.
example.zh: 所有國內企業的財務報表均必須嚴格遵守聯邦稅法規定。

words.mnemonic: 聯邦規範與稅務：federal tax (聯邦稅)、federal regulation (聯邦法規)。

example.en: The internal corporate financial audit revealed several opportunities for cost optimization.
example.zh: 企業內部財務查核結果顯示了數個可供成本優化的絕佳機會。

words.mnemonic: re- (反、回) + veal (面紗) ＝ 掀開面紗 ＝ 揭曉、揭露。

example.en: A significant percentage of quarterly corporate revenue is reinvested in research initiatives.
example.zh: 企業季度營收中有相當高的百分比被重新投入於研發計畫中。

words.mnemonic: percent (百分之...) + -age (名詞總稱) ＝ 百分比率。

example.en: Our comprehensive equipment warranty gives corporate clients complete peace of mind.
example.zh: 我們全面的設備保固服務為企業客戶帶來完全的安心保障。

words.mnemonic: 行銷與保固文案極常見搭配：peace of mind (安心、無後顧之憂)。

example.en: Customers can track the real-time delivery status of their shipments through our portal.
example.zh: 客戶可透過我們的入口網站即時追蹤其貨物的運送處理狀態。

words.mnemonic: stat- (站立、處於) ＝ 事情目前所處的狀況 ＝ 進度狀態 (project status)。

example.en: The bank invested millions into cutting-edge cybersecurity to combat financial cybercrime.
example.zh: 該銀行斥資數百萬美元建置先進網路資安系統，以打擊金融科技犯罪。

words.mnemonic: 資安防護與法規考點：cybercrime (網路犯罪)、fight crime。

example.en: The regional sales manager had to decline the invitation due to a scheduling conflict.
example.zh: 該區域業務經理因行程衝突而不得不婉拒該項邀請。

words.mnemonic: de- (向下) + clin (傾斜) ＝ 向下傾斜 ＝ 下降；禮貌婉拒邀請 (decline an offer)。

example.en: Over the past decade, our automotive manufacturing company has doubled its export volume.
example.zh: 在過去十年間，我們的汽車製造公司的出口貿易量已實現翻倍成長。

words.mnemonic: dec- (十) + -ade (名詞) ＝ 十年期間 (over the past decade)。

example.en: The technology startup plans to launch its flagship smartphone application next month.
example.zh: 這家科技新創公司計劃於下個月正式推出其旗艦智慧型手機應用程式。

words.mnemonic: 產品上市行銷核心詞：launch a product (發表產品)、product launch (產品發表會)。

example.en: Safety signs prominently warn plant technicians to wear protective eyewear at all times.
example.zh: 安全警示標誌醒目地提醒廠區技術人員必須隨時配戴護目鏡。

words.mnemonic: 名詞 warning (警報/警告通知)；warn someone about/of (提醒某人某事)。

example.en: Extensive consumer behavior market surveys helped guide the design of our new packaging.
example.zh: 廣泛的消費者行為市場調查引導了我們新包裝的設計方向。

words.mnemonic: consume (消費、消耗) + -er (人) ＝ 消費者 (consumer confidence / goods)。

example.en: A clear majority of board members voted in favor of the international joint venture.
example.zh: 大多數董事會成員投票贊成這項跨國合資合作案。

words.mnemonic: 商務表決極高頻片語：in favor of (贊成、支持)；ask a favor (請求協助)。

example.en: Hotel guests may drop off executive business garments for same-day dry cleaning service.
example.zh: 飯店房客可送交商務西裝衣物以享受當日送交取件的乾洗服務。

words.mnemonic: 飯店服務常用：dry cleaning (乾洗服務)；dry storage (乾貨常溫存放)。

example.en: We established a long-term strategic partnership with a reliable regional logistics provider.
example.zh: 我們與一家可靠的區域物流供應商建立了長期戰略合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: part (部分、股份) + -ner (人) ＝ 共同持股共事的人 ＝ 夥伴 (business partner)。

example.en: Leading financial institutions tightened corporate loan qualification standards this year.
example.zh: 各大主要金融機構於今年收緊了企業貸款審核資格標準。

words.mnemonic: in- (向內) + statut- (設立) + -ion ＝ 設立的公法人組織 ＝ 金融/學術機構。

example.en: Reserved parking spots are designated specifically for carpool employees and corporate clients.
example.zh: 預留的專屬停車格位專門規劃給共乘員工與企業客戶使用。

words.mnemonic: 停車位與現場：parking spot (停車位)、on the spot (當場)。

example.en: The industrial plant installed a high-efficiency motor with superior horsepower capability.
example.zh: 該工業廠區安裝了一台具備卓越馬力效能的高效率馬達。

words.mnemonic: 工業機械規格常用複合詞：horsepower (馬力，簡寫 HP)。

example.en: Protracted contract negotiations eventually led to a mutually beneficial long-term agreement.
example.zh: 長期的合約磋商談判最終促成了一項互利共贏的長期協議。

words.mnemonic: event (事件、結果) + -ual + -ly ＝ 事件發展到最後 ＝ 最終。

example.en: Hotel room heating and air conditioning controls can be regulated using the bedside thermostat.
example.zh: 客房的暖氣與空調系統可透過床頭溫控器自行調節。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與工廠設施：heat wave (熱浪)、central heating (中央暖氣)。

example.en: The innovative technological breakthrough excited technology investors across the globe.
example.zh: 該項創新的技術突破激發了全球科技投資人的極大熱情與興趣。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cite (召喚、驅動) ＝ 召喚出熱情 ＝ 激勵 (exciting news)。

example.en: Employees must scan their electronic identification badges across the door badge reader.
example.zh: 員工進出時必須在門禁感應讀卡機前刷其電子識別證。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：雜誌讀者 (readers) 或感應讀卡機 (card reader)。

example.en: The executive director underscored the crucial importance of maintaining workplace safety standards.
example.zh: 執行主管強調了嚴格貫徹職場安全維護標準的關鍵重要性。

words.mnemonic: important 的名詞形式；搭配 attach importance to (重視某事)。

example.en: The convention hotel is situated within easy walking distance of the central metro station.
example.zh: 會議飯店地理位置極佳，距離中央捷運站僅需步行即可輕鬆抵達。

words.mnemonic: 多益飯店/位置常見搭配：within walking distance (步行可達距離)。

example.en: The human resources handbook serves as a comprehensive guide for all newly onboarded staff.
example.zh: 這本人力資源員工手冊為所有新到職員工提供了全面的指引方針。

words.mnemonic: 使用者手冊或指引：user guide (使用手冊)、tour guide (導遊專員)。

example.en: Our biotechnology startup was awarded a substantial government research innovation grant.
example.zh: 我們的生技新創公司獲頒了一筆可觀的政府研發創新專款補助金。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重核心義：名詞指政府研究補助款 (research grant)；動詞指准許 (grant permission)。

example.en: The hotel concierge can arrange a direct taxi transfer to the airport terminal.
example.zh: 飯店禮賓服務台可為貴賓安排直達機場航廈的計程車接駁服務。

words.mnemonic: 出差差旅必考：taxi stand (計程車招呼站)、taxi receipt (搭車報銷收據)。

meaning: 資訊摘要串/即時饋送(名詞)

example.en: Automated conveyor belts continuously feed raw plastic materials into the molding machine.
example.zh: 自動輸送帶持續不斷地將塑膠原物料送入模具成型機中。

words.mnemonic: 動詞指原料/資料輸入 (feed data into)；名詞 news feed (動態消息摘要串)。

example.en: Our digital software solution directly addresses the primary operational pain points of retail clients.
example.zh: 我們的數位軟體解決方案直接針對零售客戶的主要營運痛點對症下藥。

words.mnemonic: 行銷業務分析必備詞彙：customer pain points (客戶痛點需求)。

example.en: Employment hiring demand remains exceptionally resilient across the renewable clean energy sector.
example.zh: 在可再生潔淨能源產業部門中，人才招聘需求依然展現出極強的韌性。

words.mnemonic: sect- (切開、劃分) + -or ＝ 劃分出的產業區塊 ＝ 產業部門 (public/private sector)。

example.en: The billing clerk apologized promptly for the invoice calculation mistake and issued a credit.
example.zh: 會計出納人員對發票計算上的錯誤迅速致歉，並開立了折讓單。

words.mnemonic: mis- (錯誤) + take (拿、處理) ＝ 弄錯、做錯 (make a mistake)。

example.en: Rigorous quality inspections ensure that every outbound shipment meets strict international standards.
example.zh: 嚴密的品質檢驗確保每一批出境貨物均完全符合嚴格的國際標準規範。

words.mnemonic: en- (使...) + sure (確定) ＝ 使之萬無一失 ＝ 確保 (ensure compliance)。

example.en: Our expanded product range is tailored specifically to satisfy evolving client demands.
example.zh: 我們擴大推出的產品系列專門量身打造，以滿足客戶不斷變化的需求。

words.mnemonic: satis (足夠) + -fy (使...) ＝ 使之感到足夠 ＝ 滿足要求 (satisfy requirements)。

example.en: The chief executive officer delivered the keynote strategy presentation at the annual meeting.
example.zh: 執行長在年度股東會議上發表了核心戰略主題報告。

words.mnemonic: 高階主管頭銜必備：chief executive officer (CEO)、chief financial officer (CFO)。
roots: cap- / capit- 頭 (法語源 chief)

example.en: All electronic server rooms must be kept in a cool, climate-controlled environment.
example.zh: 所有電子伺服器機房均必須保持在涼爽且恆溫恆濕的空調環境中。

words.mnemonic: 設備維護環境：keep cool (保持涼爽)、cooling system (冷卻散熱系統)。

example.en: We hired an independent cybersecurity expert to conduct a thorough vulnerability penetration audit.
example.zh: 我們聘請了一位獨立的資安專家進行全面的系統漏洞滲透查核。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + peri (嘗試、經驗) ＝ 經驗極豐富的人 ＝ 專家 (expert advice)。

example.en: The newly released generative artificial intelligence tools sparked a massive wave of technological innovation.
example.zh: 新發表的生成式人工智慧工具引發了一股波瀾壯闊的技術創新浪潮。

words.mnemonic: 趨勢與潮湧：wave of innovation (創新浪潮)、heat wave (熱浪)。

example.en: The regional distribution logistics terminal is located ten kilometers south of the airport.
example.zh: 該區域物流集散航廈位於機場以南約十公里處。

words.mnemonic: 方位導引與出差位置：south of (在...之南)、South America (南美洲)。

example.en: Automation technology investments significantly reduced manufacturing factory operational labor costs.
example.zh: 自動化技術的投資顯著降低了工廠生產製造中的營運勞動人力成本。

words.mnemonic: 人資與生產核心字彙：labor cost (勞工成本)、skilled labor (熟練勞工)。

example.en: Inspectors verified that the titanium component surface was completely free of scratches.
example.zh: 檢驗人員核實了該鈦金屬零件表面完全沒有任何刮痕瑕疵。

words.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + face (面) ＝ 最上面那一層 ＝ 表面 (surface mail 地面陸運)。

example.en: Employees can access the corporate digital training video library through the internal intranet.
example.zh: 全體員工可透過企業內部網路隨時查閱公司的數位培訓影音資源庫。

words.mnemonic: libr- (書本) + -ary (場所) ＝ 圖書室，商務上常指數位資料檔案庫 (digital library)。

example.en: The newly recruited marketing specialist demonstrated an excellent command of corporate public relations.
example.zh: 新招募的行銷專員展現了對企業公共關係處理的極其出色的掌控能力。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cel (超越) + -ent ＝ 出類拔萃的 ＝ 優秀的 (excellent service)。

example.en: Proprietary automated manufacturing processes give our firm a distinct competitive edge.
example.zh: 專利的自動化製造工藝為我們公司帶來了顯著的市場競爭優勢。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：competitive edge (競爭優勢)、have an edge over (勝過)。

example.en: New technical recruits attend an intensive two-week software engineering training boot camp.
example.zh: 新進技術人員需參加為期兩週的密集軟體工程培訓訓練營。

words.mnemonic: 員工職前培訓常見搭配：training camp / boot camp (培訓訓練營)。

example.en: The commercial marketing presentation was tailored specifically to appeal to our target corporate audience.
example.zh: 這場商務行銷簡報經過專門量身規劃，以精準吸引我們的企業目標受眾族群。

words.mnemonic: audi- (聽) + -ence (名詞) ＝ 聆聽的受眾群 ＝ 聽眾、目標受眾 (target audience)。

example.en: The regulatory commerce committee officially voted to lift export trade restrictions on semiconductors.
example.zh: 商務監管委員會正式投票通過解除對半導體產品的出口貿易限制。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：lift restrictions (解除限制禁令) 或英式電梯 (take the lift)。

example.en: Follow the emergency procedure.
example.zh: 所有員工必須嚴格遵守安全作業程序。

words.mnemonic: 正式流程。

example.en: Please send a confirmation email with the signed non-disclosure agreement attached.
example.zh: 請發送一封隨附已簽署保密合約的確認電子郵件。

words.mnemonic: e (electronic) + mail ＝ 電子郵件 (confirmation email)。

example.en: Our international enterprise logistics network serves global corporate clients across five continents.
example.zh: 我們的跨國企業物流網路為橫跨五大洲的全球企業客戶提供優質服務。

words.mnemonic: globe (地球) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 全球性的 (global economy / market)。

example.en: Small retail shops often struggle to compete against large multinational discount e-commerce chains.
example.zh: 小型零售門市在與大型跨國平價電子商務連鎖集團競爭時往往苦苦苦苦支撐。

words.mnemonic: 商業困境常用：struggle to compete (艱困競爭)、struggle to survive (掙扎求存)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department will advertise the vacant engineering position online.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部將在網路上刊登招聘該出缺工程師職位的公開徵才廣告。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + vert (轉向) ＝ 把大眾注意力轉移過來 ＝ 登廣告 (advertise a position)。

example.en: The hiring committee will select the most qualified candidate for the manager post.
example.zh: 聘雇委員會將挑選出最適任該經理職位的人選。

words.mnemonic: se- (分開) + lect (挑選) ＝ 從眾多之中挑出。

example.en: The resort hotel is surrounded by tranquil tropical gardens and sandy beaches.
example.zh: 該度假飯店被寧靜的熱帶花園與沙灘所圍繞。

words.mnemonic: sur- (在上方、超過) + round (圓) ＝ 繞成一圈圍住。

example.en: Management launched an assessment to determine the full extent of the factory damage.
example.zh: 管理階層展開評估，以確定工廠受損的完整程度與範圍。

words.mnemonic: ex- (向外) + tend (伸展) ＝ 伸展到的距離 ＝ 程度、範圍。

example.en: The convention center offers scenic river views from all banquet hall rooms.
example.zh: 會議中心的所有宴會廳皆享有優美的河景風光。

words.mnemonic: 常見飯店地段描述：river view (河景客房)、river cruise (遊船)。

example.en: The company holds an annual meeting.
example.zh: 公司年度股東大會將於五月召開。

words.mnemonic: 每年一次。

example.en: Please ensure the corporate registration form is fully completed before submission.
example.zh: 提交之前，請務必確認企業註冊表格已完全填寫無誤。

words.mnemonic: full (滿的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 完全地、充分地。

example.en: In sharp contrast to last quarter, corporate retail revenues increased by twelve percent.
example.zh: 與上一季形成鮮明對比的是，企業零售營收增長了百分之十二。

words.mnemonic: contra- (反對、相反) + st (站立) ＝ 相反兩者擺在一起 ＝ 對比。

example.en: The telecommunications giant plans to roll out its fiber network nationwide this spring.
example.zh: 這家電信巨頭計劃於今年春季在全國範圍內推出鋪設其光纖網路。

words.mnemonic: 多益極高頻片語：roll out (正式推出新產品或服務)。

example.en: Budget planners must balance innovative design ambitions with fiscal reality.
example.zh: 預算規劃人員必須在創新的設計願景與財務現實之間取得平衡。

words.mnemonic: real (真實的) + -ity (名詞尾) ＝ 現實情況。

example.en: High-resolution product photographs must be uploaded to the promotional web catalog.
example.zh: 高解析度的產品照片必須上傳至線上促銷型錄。

words.mnemonic: photo- (光) + -graph (寫、畫) ＝ 用光線記錄的圖像 ＝ 照片。

example.en: Our advertising firm hired a talented digital artist to design the corporate logo.
example.zh: 我們的廣告公司聘請了一位極具才華的數位美工設計師來設計企業標誌。

words.mnemonic: art (藝術、技巧) + -ist (人) ＝ 藝術家或平面視覺設計師。

example.en: Due to a schedule conflict, the executive director postponed the quarterly review meeting.
example.zh: 由於行程衝突，執行董事推遲了季度審查會議。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + flict (打擊) ＝ 互撞衝突 ＝ schedule conflict (行程衝突)。

example.en: The chief executive commended the entire marketing department for outstanding quarterly results.
example.zh: 執行長讚揚了整個行銷部門卓越的季度業績表現。

words.mnemonic: en- (在內) + tire (完整無損) ＝ 完整的、整個的。

example.en: Our firm seeks to expand its commercial market presence across Southeast Asia.
example.zh: 我們公司致力於擴大在東南亞的商業市場版圖與影響力。

words.mnemonic: present (在場的) + -ence (名詞尾) ＝ 出席或市場佈局 (market presence)。

example.en: Large crowds gathered at the flagship electronics store for the weekend launch.
example.zh: 大批人潮聚集在旗艦電子商城門口，參加週末的上市活動。

words.mnemonic: 形容詞 crowded (擁擠的)，多益交通與商展常考情境。

example.en: The new express cafe is conveniently located on the corner of Maple and Main Street.
example.zh: 這間新開的快捷咖啡廳座落於楓樹街與主街的轉角處，交通非常便利。

words.mnemonic: 店面位置或辦公空間：on the corner (在轉角)、corner office (邊間高階主管辦公室)。

example.en: Rental car agreements require drivers to return the vehicle with a full tank of gas.
example.zh: 租車合約要求駕駛人在還車時必須將油箱加滿汽油。

words.mnemonic: 租車與能源常見搭配：gas station (加油站)、natural gas (天然氣)。

example.en: Assembly line factory technicians work in alternating eight-hour shifts.
example.zh: 組裝產線的工廠技術人員採取八小時輪班制工作。

words.mnemonic: 人資班表必備：day shift (日班)、night shift (夜班)、shift work (輪班工作)。
