example.en: The corporate annual financial report showed a twenty percent rise in net profit.
example.zh: 該企業年度財務報告顯示淨利成長了百分之二十。

words.mnemonic: 財務必考對比：gross (毛利/總計) vs net (淨利/實收)。

example.en: Office supplies and packaging materials are filed under separate expenditure categories.
example.zh: 辦公用品與包裝耗材歸屬於不同的支出分類項目下。

words.mnemonic: cata- (向下、完全) + agoreuein (公開宣布、聚集) ＝ 分門別類。

example.en: The executive secretary scheduled all overseas video conferences for senior management.
example.zh: 主管秘書為高階管理層安排了所有海外視訊會議。

words.mnemonic: secret (秘密) + -ary (人) ＝ 保守機密並協助主管處理政務的人 ＝ 秘書。

example.en: Upgrading firewall protocols provides an essential defense against cyber intrusions.
example.zh: 升級防火牆通訊協定為防範網路入侵提供了關鍵的防禦屏障。

words.mnemonic: de- (遠離) + fens (打擊、抵擋) ＝ 擋開外部打擊 ＝ 防禦。

example.en: We appreciate your quick response to our urgent corporate supplier inquiry.
example.zh: 感謝您針對我們先前緊急的企業供應商詢價所給予的迅速回覆。

words.mnemonic: 客戶溝通核心用詞：quick response / quick reply (迅速回覆)。

example.en: The hotel restaurant hired an executive head cook to revamp its dinner menu.
example.zh: 飯店餐廳聘請了一位行政主廚來全面重新設計晚餐菜單。

words.mnemonic: 餐飲宴會核心：cook meals (烹調餐點)；head cook / chef (主廚)。

example.en: Word of mouth helped spread news of our annual discount sale across town.
example.zh: 口碑傳播有助於將我們年度特賣活動的消息在全城散播開來。

words.mnemonic: 資訊傳播 (spread the word)；金融名詞指利差 (interest rate spread)。

example.en: The power utility operates nuclear energy generators under stringent safety guidelines.
example.zh: 這間電力公用事業公司在極為嚴格的安全規範下營運核能發電機組。

words.mnemonic: nucle- (核心、原子核) + -ar ＝ 核能發電 (nuclear power)。

example.en: Automated warehouse facilities achieve substantial economies of scale in distribution.
example.zh: 自動化倉儲設施在配送物流中實現了顯著的規模經濟效益。

words.mnemonic: 商業擴張極核心：economies of scale (規模經濟)、on a large scale (大規模)。

example.en: Customer satisfaction remains the key driver of corporate revenue growth this year.
example.zh: 客戶滿意度依然是今年推動企業營收成長的關鍵驅動因素。

words.mnemonic: drive (駕駛/驅動) + -er ＝ 司機或推動成長的要素 (growth driver)。

example.en: The charity gala dinner was held in the hotel's grand ballroom on the second floor.
example.zh: 慈善晚宴於飯店二樓的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

words.mnemonic: 飯店場地核心詞彙：ballroom (宴會廳、大廳)。

meaning: 大相徑庭(a far cry from)

example.en: The modern digital logistics terminal is a far cry from the cramped old warehouse.
example.zh: 這座現代化的數位物流航廈與過去那間狹小老舊的倉庫相比真可謂天差地別。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力閱讀常考成語：a far cry from (與...大相逕庭、相去甚遠)。

example.en: The introduction of automated ticketing kiosks significantly shortened airport lines.
example.zh: 自動取票機的引進大幅縮短了機場旅客的排隊等候時間。

words.mnemonic: intro- (向內) + duct (引導) + -ion ＝ 引導進入 ＝ 引進、介紹。

example.en: A bachelor's degree in engineering is a mandatory requirement for this technical post.
example.zh: 具備工程學士學位是應徵該技術職位的必要必備條件。

words.mnemonic: require (要求) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 招聘徵才條件 (job requirement)。

example.en: The regional distribution hub is located twenty kilometers north of downtown Seattle.
example.zh: 區域配送物流轉運中心位於西雅圖市中心以北二十公里處。

words.mnemonic: 交通地理指引：North Wing (北側大樓/航廈)、north of (在...以北)。

example.en: Please confirm your reservation by email.
example.zh: 請致電飯店以確認您的訂房資料。

words.mnemonic: confirm = make sure。

example.en: Senior management will convene next Tuesday to review the corporate expansion roadmap.
example.zh: 高階管理層將於下週二召開會議，以審議企業擴張藍圖。

words.mnemonic: sen- (年長、老) + -ior (較...) ＝ 年資較深、職級較高的 (senior manager)。

example.en: Please attach a recent digital passport-style photo to your employee ID application.
example.zh: 請在您的員工識別證申請表上附上一張近期的數位證件照。

words.mnemonic: photograph 的口語簡寫：photo ID (附照片的身分證件)。

example.en: The supplier refused to accept return packages without prior authorization codes.
example.zh: 供應商拒絕接收未附帶事先授權碼的退貨包裹。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + fuse (流、倒) ＝ 倒流回去不收 ＝ 拒絕接受 (refuse to accept)。

example.en: Public transport connections between the international airport and downtown are excellent.
example.zh: 國際機場與市中心之間的大眾運輸交通連結十分便捷優質。

words.mnemonic: trans- (跨越) + port (攜帶、搬運) ＝ 跨區運送 ＝ 運輸物流。

example.en: Renewable energy has emerged as a major sector for sustainable corporate investment.
example.zh: 再生能源已崛起浮現成為企業永續投資的主要關鍵產業領域。

words.mnemonic: e- (出) + merge (浸入、沒入) ＝ 從水中浮出 ＝ 嶄露頭角、浮現。

example.en: The conference registration packet includes a color campus facility map.
example.zh: 大會報到資料袋內附有一份彩色會場園區設施地圖。

words.mnemonic: 地圖；動詞片語 map out (周詳規劃藍圖)。

example.en: Design engineers introduced an eco-friendly concept car at the automotive exposition.
example.zh: 設計工程師在國際車展上展示發表了一款環保概念車。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + cept (拿取、抓住) ＝ 在腦海中共同抓住的構想 ＝ 概念。

example.en: The luxury resort hotel is located on a private tropical island accessible by boat.
example.zh: 這間奢華度假飯店座落於一座私人的熱帶島嶼上，需搭乘渡輪接駁抵達。

words.mnemonic: 注意字母 s 不發音 (/ˈaɪlənd/)；商場展售常見 display island。

example.en: The financial services board initiated regulatory reforms to enhance market transparency.
example.zh: 金融監理委員會發起法規改革，以提升整體市場透明度。

words.mnemonic: re- (再) + form (成形) ＝ 重新塑造成更好的形狀 ＝ 改革。

example.en: Neither the project director nor the lead engineer could attend today's symposium.
example.zh: 專案主管與首席工程師兩位今天都無法出席研討會。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法題高頻必考：neither A nor B (A和B兩者皆不是)。

example.en: Our marketing firm purchased prime television commercial slots during the championship football game.
example.zh: 我們的行銷公司在美式足球冠軍賽轉播期間買下了黃金電視廣告時段。

words.mnemonic: 廣告贊助常考：football stadium (球場)、commercial sponsor (贊助商)。

example.en: Few independent retail shops survived the prolonged regional economic downturn.
example.zh: 極少數獨立零售商能在這場持久的區域經濟低迷中維持營運生存下來。

words.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + viv (生命、生活) ＝ 在苦難之上活下來 ＝ 生存、度過難關。

example.en: Passengers are requested to arrive two hours before their scheduled flight departure time.
example.zh: 請旅客於預定航班起飛時間前兩小時抵達機場航廈辦理登機手續。

words.mnemonic: 多益機場必考：flight attendant (空服員)、connecting flight (轉機航班)。

meaning: 剩下的(leave 的過去分詞)

example.en: Turn left past the security checkpoint to locate boarding gates twelve through twenty.
example.zh: 穿過安檢站後請向左轉，即可找到十二號至二十號登機門。

words.mnemonic: 方向指引：turn left (左轉)；庫存剩餘：two units left (剩下兩件)。

example.en: Our technical support team worked diligently to solve the customer's network issue.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援團隊克盡職責迅速解決了客戶的網路連線障礙。

words.mnemonic: 名詞 solution (解決方案)；solve a problem (解決問題)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters invited commercial neighbors to an open house community preview.
example.zh: 企業總部邀請周邊鄰近的商戶夥伴參加開放日社區預覽會。

words.mnemonic: 衍生詞 neighborhood (鄰里街區、周邊周遭)。

example.en: The candidate has an impressive academic and professional background in corporate finance.
example.zh: 該應徵者在企業財務領域具備令人印象深刻的亮眼學歷與專業工作背景。

words.mnemonic: back (後方) + ground (地面、根基) ＝ 身後的累積資歷 ＝ 背景。

example.en: Staff members will attend a training workshop to master modern project management techniques.
example.zh: 員工將參加培訓工作坊，以熟練掌握現代專案管理技巧。

words.mnemonic: techn- (技能、工藝) + -ique (名詞尾) ＝ 具體的操作技巧技術。

example.en: The corporate website redesign resulted in a forty percent increase in monthly web traffic.
example.zh: 企業網站的重新改版讓每月的網路造訪流量大幅增加了百分之四十。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：公路車潮 (heavy traffic) 或網站訪客量 (website traffic)。

example.en: Staff suggestions led to significant improvements in warehouse inventory workflow safety.
example.zh: 員工的提案建議促使倉儲庫存工作流程的安全防護獲得了顯著的改善。

words.mnemonic: improve (改善) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 改善措施、進步。

example.en: Our digital project management tool enables seamless real-time team collaboration.
example.zh: 我們的數位專案管理軟體工具實現了流暢無間的即時團隊協作。

words.mnemonic: 實體工具或數位應用工具：analytical tool (分析工具)、software tool (軟體工具)。

example.en: Failing to fulfill safety compliance regulations may carry severe legal consequences.
example.zh: 未能嚴格履行安全法規標準可能將承擔嚴重的法律後果。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + sequ (跟隨) + -ence ＝ 隨之而來的後續結果 ＝ 後果。

example.en: Under no circumstances should confidential customer data be disclosed to unauthorized third parties.
example.zh: 在任何情況下，均嚴格不得將機密客戶資料外洩給未經授權的第三方。

words.mnemonic: circum- (環繞) + st (站立) + -ance ＝ 環繞在周圍的客觀局勢 ＝ 情況。

example.en: The corporate building policy strictly prohibits employees from smoking on the premises.
example.zh: 企業辦公大樓規章嚴格禁止員工在大樓場所範圍內吸菸。

words.mnemonic: 飯店與安全警報必備：smoke detector (煙霧偵測警報器)、non-smoking room (禁菸房)。

example.en: Initial consumer market reaction to the newly launched beverage line has been overwhelmingly positive.
example.zh: 消費者市場對這款新上市飲品系列的初期反響呈現壓倒性的正面好評。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + act (行動) + -ion ＝ 對外界刺激做出的反向動作 ＝ 反應。

example.en: The outdoor company summer picnic was relocated to the auditorium due to forecasted heavy rain.
example.zh: 由於天氣預報指出將有大雨，公司夏季戶外野餐活動已改至大禮堂舉行。

words.mnemonic: 多益天氣與活動延期考點：heavy rain (大雨)、rain date (雨天延期備案日期)。

example.en: The customer service hotline was unusually busy following the release of the software update.
example.zh: 在軟體更新版發布之後，客戶服務專線異常繁忙。

words.mnemonic: 繁忙期：busy season (旺季)、busy line (電話佔線通話中)。

example.en: The corporate retreat offered valuable lessons in crisis mitigation and effective team communication.
example.zh: 這場企業共識營為危機化解與高效團隊溝通提供了寶貴的經驗教訓。

words.mnemonic: 多益培訓與檢討：lessons learned (學習到的經驗教訓)。

example.en: The creative advertising department will brainstorm marketing strategies for the holiday campaign.
example.zh: 創意廣告部門將齊聚一堂進行腦力激盪，為假期促銷活動集思廣益。

words.mnemonic: 商務會議必考複合動詞：brainstorm (腦力激盪、集思廣益)。

meaning: 大眾的/大規模的(形容詞)

example.en: Mass transit subway links allow conference delegates to commute effortlessly across the city.
example.zh: 大眾捷運運輸路網讓與會代表得以毫不費力地在全城各處穿梭通勤。

words.mnemonic: 大眾普及核心詞：mass transit (大眾運輸)、mass production (大規模量產)。

example.en: The television commercial used a funny, relatable storyline to promote the new snack brand.
example.zh: 該電視廣告運用了幽默有趣且引發共鳴的故事情節來宣傳新款零食品牌。

words.mnemonic: fun (樂趣) + -y (形容詞尾) ＝ 幽默風趣的、吸睛的。

example.en: Every team member is strongly encouraged to contribute innovative ideas during the seminar.
example.zh: 大會非常鼓勵每一位團隊成員在研討會期間積極貢獻創新構想。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + tribute (給予、敬獻) ＝ 共同給予 ＝ 貢獻 (contribute to)。

example.en: Routine component servicing prevents unexpected mechanical power generator failure.
example.zh: 例行性的零組件保養可防止發電機發生意料之外的機械動力故障停擺。

words.mnemonic: fail (失敗、故障) + -ure (名詞尾) ＝ 機械故障 (equipment failure) 或未履約。

example.en: The meeting is scheduled for Monday.
example.zh: 新專案的時程表已發送給所有相關主管。

words.mnemonic: schedule for + 日期。

example.en: Dr. Vance will serve as the keynote guest speaker at tomorrow's healthcare industry conference.
example.zh: 范斯博士將擔任明天醫療保健產業高峰大會的主題演講貴賓。

words.mnemonic: speak (說) + -er (人/物) ＝ 演講貴賓 (keynote speaker) 或音響設備。

example.en: Automating logistical processes will significantly improve our company's ultimate bottom line.
example.zh: 自動化物流流程將顯著改善我們公司的最終財務底線盈虧狀況。

words.mnemonic: 商業必考成語：the bottom line (帳目底線、最終利潤損益)。

example.en: The board of directors resolved to adopt more environmentally sustainable manufacturing policies.
example.zh: 董事會決議採納施行更具環境永續性的製造生產政策。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + opt (選擇) ＝ 選中並納為己用 ＝ 採納、採用新方針。

example.en: The upcoming corporate merger will combine two of the nation's largest logistics distribution firms.
example.zh: 即將進行的企業合併將把全國最大的兩家物流倉儲發貨公司合而為一。

words.mnemonic: com- (共同) + bin (雙、兩者) ＝ 將兩者綁在一起 ＝ 結合、合併。

example.en: The alpine luxury mountain resort offers corporate retreat packages with conference rooms.
example.zh: 這間高山奢華度假勝地提供附帶專用會議室的企業共識營套裝行程。

words.mnemonic: 旅遊與度假村考題：mountain view (山景客房)、mountain resort。

example.en: Lean factory production methodologies help assembly plants reduce material waste significantly.
example.zh: 精實工廠生產管理手法有助於組裝廠大幅減少材料浪費與耗損。

words.mnemonic: 環保與成本控制：reduce waste (減少浪費)、waste management (廢棄物管理)。

example.en: Our transparent business billing pricing model ensures there are no hidden surprise fees.
example.zh: 我們公開透明的商業定價模式確保絕無任何隱藏的意外附加費用。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約與帳單極高頻：no hidden fees / hidden charges (無隱藏收費)。

example.en: The modern architecture design showcases a harmonious marriage of functionality and aesthetic appeal.
example.zh: 這座現代建築設計展現了實用機能性與美學吸引力的完美和諧結合。

words.mnemonic: 商務比喻常用：a marriage of A and B (A與B的完美結合/聯姻)。

example.en: Please submit an electronic IT support ticket to request assistance with network access.
example.zh: 請提交電子技術支援報修單，以申請網路存取障礙的排除協助。

words.mnemonic: 交通車票或 IT 支援報修單：round-trip ticket (來回票)、support ticket (報修單)。

example.en: Complimentary gourmet hot meals and beverages are served on all international flights.
example.zh: 所有國際長途航班均免費供應精緻熱食餐點與各類飲品。

words.mnemonic: 餐飲服務核心字：complimentary meal (免費招待餐點)、meal voucher (餐券)。

example.en: I will consult my senior colleagues in the legal department before replying to the proposal.
example.zh: 在回覆該企劃案之前，我會先諮詢法務部門的資深同事們。

words.mnemonic: col- (共同) + leg (挑選、代表) ＝ 共同被選在一起共事的人 ＝ 同事、同僚。

example.en: Passengers are allowed to bring one carry-on bag and one personal item on board.
example.zh: 旅客獲准攜帶一件手提登機行李袋以及一件個人隨身物品登機。

words.mnemonic: 機場航空必考：carry-on bag (手提隨身行李袋)、baggage (行李總稱)。

example.en: Our boutique hotel loyalty program rewards repeat guests with complimentary room upgrades.
example.zh: 我們精品飯店的會員忠誠回饋計畫為常客回頭客提供免費客房升等的禮遇。

words.mnemonic: 商業極重要搭配：repeat customer / repeat business (回頭客、再度光顧)。

example.en: Our firm is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to workforce diversity.
example.zh: 本公司很榮幸成為致力於推動多元包容職場的公平就業機會雇主。

words.mnemonic: 招聘政策必考條款：equal opportunity employer (均等就業機會雇主)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee submitted a formal written expression of interest in the project.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會對該合作專案正式提交了書面表達意願書 (EOI)。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + press (擠壓、按) + -ion ＝ 傳達表達出來；expression of interest (意向表達)。

example.en: The conference registration price is four hundred dollars plus applicable regional sales tax.
example.zh: 會議報名費為四百美元，外加適用的該地區消費營業稅。

words.mnemonic: 報價常用介系詞：price plus tax (價格外加稅金)；名詞指一大優勢 (a big plus)。

example.en: Senior management was extremely pleased with the outstanding marketing campaign results.
example.zh: 高階管理層對於本次行銷活動所展現的傑出亮眼成果感到極度欣慰滿意。

words.mnemonic: extreme (極端的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 非常極其 (extremely helpful)。

example.en: The commercial building owner agreed to renovate the lobby entrance and elevators.
example.zh: 這座商辦大樓的業主同意全面重新整修一樓迎賓大廳與電梯設備。

words.mnemonic: own (擁有) + -er (人) ＝ 房東業主或企業主 (business owner)。

example.en: Passengers will board the chartered cargo plane as soon as pre-flight checks are finished.
example.zh: 飛航前安全檢查一旦順利完成，搭機旅客便將隨即登上這架包機貨機。

words.mnemonic: 搭機登機常見：board a plane (登上飛機)、cargo plane (貨運機)。

example.en: The commercial promotes a new car.
example.zh: 這是一座供企業租用的現代化商辦大樓。

words.mnemonic: commercial break。

example.en: The master of ceremonies welcomed ladies and gentlemen to the annual awards banquet.
example.zh: 大會司儀盛情歡迎各位女士與先生蒞臨這場年度頒獎表揚晚宴。

words.mnemonic: 大會致詞禮貌開場：ladies and gentlemen (各位女士、各位先生)。

example.en: International travelers must declare all purchased retail goods subject to customs duty.
example.zh: 跨國入境旅客必須申報所有依法須課徵關稅的已購零售商品。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：job duties (工作職責) 或 duty-free shop (免稅商店)。

example.en: Our corporate SWOT strategic audit highlighted our regional customer loyalty strength.
example.zh: 我們的企業 SWOT 戰略分析審查突顯了我們在區域客戶忠誠度方面的強大優勢。

words.mnemonic: 商業分析核心：strengths and weaknesses (優勢與劣勢)。

example.en: The high-speed rail line directly connects the international airport to downtown financial offices.
example.zh: 該高鐵路線將國際機場與市中心金融商業辦公區直接緊密串連起來。

words.mnemonic: con- (共同) + nect (綁定、連結) ＝ 相互串聯 ＝ 連線、接駁 (connect to)。

example.en: Global management seminars train team leaders in overcoming cross-cultural communication challenges.
example.zh: 跨國管理研討會旨在培訓團隊領導者克服跨文化溝通協調中的挑戰。

words.mnemonic: culture (文化) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 跨文化 (cross-cultural)。

example.en: The corporate event planner will arrange hotel accommodations for visiting international delegations.
example.zh: 企業活動籌劃專員將為造訪的國際代表團安排預約飯店客房住宿。

words.mnemonic: 商務秘書排程必備：arrange a meeting (安排開會)、make arrangements。

example.en: Human resources introduced a competitive employee retirement pension savings scheme.
example.zh: 人力資源部推行了一項極具市場競爭力的員工退休年金儲蓄保障方案。

words.mnemonic: 英式商務常考指「正式規劃方案」：pension scheme (退休金方案)、incentive scheme。

example.en: Please remit electronic invoice payment via direct wire transfer within thirty business days.
example.zh: 請於三十個工作日內透過直接銀行電匯支付電子發票款項。

words.mnemonic: pay (支付) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 繳費支付 (make a payment)。

example.en: Unfortunately, all standard banquet conference rooms are fully booked for that weekend.
example.zh: 很遺憾地，該週末所有標準宴會會議室皆已被全數預約客滿。

words.mnemonic: 客服婉拒常用開頭詞：un- (不) + fortune (幸運) + -ate + -ly ＝ 遺憾抱歉的是。

example.en: The director will deliver a brief introductory presentation on upcoming product specifications.
example.zh: 處長將就即將推出的產品規格進行一段簡短的開場說明簡報。

words.mnemonic: 商務會談核心詞：brief presentation (簡要簡報)、brief someone on (向某人簡報)。

example.en: Attendees who register before next Friday qualify for an early bird discount rate.
example.zh: 在下週五前完成報名的與會者即可享有早鳥優惠折扣價。

words.mnemonic: 行銷促銷與報名必考：early bird discount (早鳥特惠優惠)。

example.en: A field engineer will demonstrate the new laser cutting machinery to prospective buyers.
example.zh: 現場工程師將親自向潛在採購客戶實機示範操作這台新款雷射切割機械。

words.mnemonic: de- (完全) + monstr (展示、顯示) + -ate ＝ 完整操作給人看 ＝ 示範 (demonstrate how to)。

example.en: Management commended employees for their outstanding contribution to corporate innovation.
example.zh: 管理階層對全體同仁在企業創新研發方面所做出的卓越貢獻深表嘉許。

words.mnemonic: contribute 的名詞形式；make a contribution to (對...做出貢獻)。

example.en: We sincerely appreciate your ongoing corporate patronage and support of our products.
example.zh: 我們由衷感謝您對本公司產品的持續愛護惠顧與大力支持。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + preti (價格、價值) + -ate ＝ 認可其價值 ＝ 感謝或資產升值。

example.en: The regional chapter of the international chamber of commerce convened its annual summit.
example.zh: 國際商會的該地區分會假本地召開了年度高峰代表大會。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：專業組織地方分會 (local chapter) 或重組破產保護 (Chapter 11)。

example.en: All research engineering personnel must sign binding trade secret non-disclosure agreements.
example.zh: 所有研發工程技術人員均必須簽署具備法律約束力的營業秘密保密合約。

words.mnemonic: 營業機密法規必考搭配：trade secret (營業秘密)、keep secret (保密)。

example.en: Apparently, the shipment delay was caused by severe weather at the transshipment port.
example.zh: 顯然，這次的出貨延誤是由轉運港口遭遇惡劣天候所導致的。

words.mnemonic: apparent (顯而易見的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 據了解、顯然地。

example.en: The research engineering group patented a novel approach to rechargeable lithium battery manufacturing.
example.zh: 該研發工程團隊為一種新穎創新的可充電鋰電池製造技術申請了專利。

words.mnemonic: nov- (新) ＝ 創新獨特的 (novel idea / novel approach)。

example.en: Management and labor union leaders negotiated the terms of the new collective wage contract.
example.zh: 管理階層與工會代表共同協商了新一期集體薪資勞動合約的各項條款。

words.mnemonic: uni- (單一) + -on (名詞) ＝ 團結為一體 ＝ 勞工工會 (labor union)。

example.en: The startup tech firm is closely tracking its monthly cash burn rate to secure runway.
example.zh: 該科技新創公司正密切追蹤其每月的現金消耗率，以確保營運資金維持充足。

words.mnemonic: 新創財務核心術語：burn rate (資金消耗率)；burnout (職場過勞)。

example.en: Industry market analysts highlighted a growing consumer trend toward eco-friendly packaging.
example.zh: 產業市場分析師指出消費者對環保包裝呈現日益增長的市場趨勢。

words.mnemonic: 商業分析必備：market trend (市場趨勢)、upward trend (上升走勢)。

example.en: The company completed its initial public offering on the international stock exchange.
example.zh: 該公司在國際證券交易所順利完成了首次公開發行上市 (IPO)。

words.mnemonic: init- (開始) + -ial ＝ 最初的 (initial investment / IPO)；動詞指在合約上簡簽。

example.en: It is our absolute pleasure to introduce our international keynote speaker this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午我們感到無比榮幸能為各位介紹本場國際主題演講貴賓。

words.mnemonic: 商務禮儀必備套話：It's a pleasure (很榮幸)；with pleasure (十分樂意)。

example.en: Employees are invited to drop workflow enhancement ideas into the suggestion box.
example.zh: 公司歡迎全體同仁將工作流程改進構想投入意見建議箱。

words.mnemonic: suggest (提議) + -ion (名詞尾) ；suggestion box (意見箱)。

example.en: Securing additional financing is critical to the timely completion of the infrastructure project.
example.zh: 獲得額外融資對於如期完成該項基礎建設計畫而言至關重要。

words.mnemonic: crit- (判斷、決定) + -ical ＝ 具決定性重大影響的 ＝ 關鍵重要的。

example.en: Market researchers gather quantitative survey feedback from prospective retail shoppers.
example.zh: 市場研究人員從潛在零售購物者那裡收集量化問卷回饋資料。

words.mnemonic: 收集資料或集會：gather information (收集資訊)、gather data (收集數據)。

example.en: Our digital software subscribers are mostly small to mid-sized commercial enterprises.
example.zh: 我們數位軟體的訂閱用戶主要多半是中小型商業企業。

words.mnemonic: most (最多) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 主要地、大體上。

example.en: Our manufacturing corporate pledge includes using only recyclable, earth-friendly materials.
example.zh: 我們製造業的企業承諾包括僅使用可回收的環保友善愛地球材質。

words.mnemonic: 企業環保永續：earth-friendly (環保的)、on earth。

example.en: The luxury fashion apparel retailer opened a pop-up boutique store in the mall atrium.
example.zh: 這間精品時尚服飾零售商在購物中心中庭開設了一間快閃旗艦概念店。

words.mnemonic: 新零售行銷必考名詞：pop-up store / pop-up shop (快閃店)。

example.en: Reliable high-speed broadband internet is essential for productive remote office work.
example.zh: 穩定可靠的高速寬頻網路對於維持高效遠距辦公而言是不可或缺的。

words.mnemonic: ess- (存在) + -ent + -ial ＝ 關乎生存存在的 ＝ 不可或缺的 (essential to/for)。

example.en: The candidate expressed a strong desire to assume international marketing responsibilities.
example.zh: 該應徵者表達了想要承擔跨國行銷業務職責的強烈意願。

words.mnemonic: 意願與期盼：express a desire (表達意願)、desired outcome (預期成果)。

example.en: The store will promote its new service.
example.zh: 由於績效優異，她獲得晉升為資深專案協調員。

words.mnemonic: 促銷或升職。

example.en: We are currently reviewing updated vendor quotes for the corporate office renovation.
example.zh: 我們目前正在審核各家廠商針對企業辦公室重新整修所提交的最新報價單。

words.mnemonic: current (當前的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 現在、現階段 (currently available)。

example.en: The high-tech manufacturing firm employs over two thousand skilled production technicians.
example.zh: 這家高科技製造公司在本地僱用了兩千多名熟練的產線技術人員。

words.mnemonic: em- (進入) + ploy (折疊、捲入) ＝ 延攬加入工作；名詞 employee (員工)。

example.en: The corporate management training program offers a clear path to executive promotion.
example.zh: 該企業儲備幹部培訓計畫為同仁晉升為高階主管提供了明確的職涯途徑。

words.mnemonic: 人資職涯發展常用：career path (職涯發展道路/升遷途徑)。

example.en: Cybersecurity compliance will be the main discussion topic at the quarterly board meeting.
example.zh: 網路安全合規標準將是本季度董事會會議上的主要討論主題。

words.mnemonic: top- (地方、位置) + -ic ＝ 會議中特定聚焦之處 ＝ 會議主題。

example.en: Guests can relax along the private beachfront or participate in guided water sports.
example.zh: 下榻貴賓可在專屬海灘邊悠閒放鬆，亦可參加專人指導的水上運動項目。

words.mnemonic: 度假勝地廣告常用：beachfront (海灘第一排)、beach resort (海濱度假村)。

example.en: The international trade symposium attracted business delegates from thirty-five countries.
example.zh: 這場國際商貿研討高峰會吸引了來自三十五個國家的企業商務代表參與。

words.mnemonic: ad- (向) + tract (拉、牽引) ＝ 拉攏過來 ＝ 吸引 (attract customers/investors)。

example.en: Our digital marketing team uses interactive social media contests to engage potential consumers.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷團隊透過互動式社群媒體競賽來深度吸引並串連潛在消費者。

words.mnemonic: en- (進入) + gage (保證、約定) ＝ 深度投身參與 (engage in / engage customers)。

example.en: Our cloud computing infrastructure features powerful data analytics software capabilities.
example.zh: 我們的雲端運算基礎架構具備強大卓越的巨量數據分析軟體運算能力。

words.mnemonic: power (力量、能力) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 功能強大高效能的。

example.en: Fresh flower arrangements were placed on all conference reception desks this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午所有大會接待櫃檯上都擺放了新鮮優雅的鮮花盆栽花藝。

words.mnemonic: 宴會接待細節：flower arrangement (花藝佈置)、fresh flowers。

example.en: The corporate public relations division enacted an emergency crisis communication protocol.
example.zh: 企業公共關係部門隨即啟動了緊急危機處理公關溝通作業程序。

words.mnemonic: 危機處理核心：crisis management (危機管理)、financial crisis (金融危機)。
roots: cris- (crit-) 分辨、審查、決定性時刻

example.en: Clients are kindly requested to settle outstanding hotel room invoices upon checkout.
example.zh: 請各位貴賓在退房辦理離店手續時結清尚未支付的客房消費帳款。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：settle an invoice / account (結清帳單) 或 settle a dispute (解決紛爭)。

example.en: The beachfront luxury resort offers complimentary scenic boat tours around the bay.
example.zh: 這間海濱奢華度假飯店提供免費的海灣專人導覽觀光遊船服務。

words.mnemonic: 出差差旅接駁：boat transfer (渡輪接駁)、boat tour (遊船觀光)。

example.en: Small business enterprises received direct financial aid from regional economic authorities.
example.zh: 小型企業獲得了該地區經濟主管機關發放的直接財政紓困補助金。

words.mnemonic: 急救與資助：financial aid (財務援助)、first aid (急救措施)。

example.en: Industrial cooling fans must be serviced periodically to maintain optimal warehouse airflow.
example.zh: 工業冷卻排風扇必須定期保養維護，以維持倉儲廠房內最佳的空氣對流。

words.mnemonic: 廠區排熱設備：cooling fan (冷卻散熱風扇)、exhaust fan (抽風機)。

example.en: Corporate executive suites include a fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances.
example.zh: 企業高級主管套房內配置了一間設備齊全且附有現代化家電的簡易廚房。

words.mnemonic: 商務套房設施：fully equipped kitchen (設備齊全的廚房)、kitchen appliances。

example.en: Facilities maintenance inspections are conducted twice a year to ensure safety compliance.
example.zh: 總務廠房維護檢查每年實施兩次，以確保完全符合安全標準規範。

words.mnemonic: 頻率排程詞彙：twice a year (一年兩次)、twice as much (兩倍之多)。

example.en: Bringing in an external consultant provides a fresh perspective on corporate restructuring.
example.zh: 聘請外部管理顧問能為企業組織重組帶來全新且跳脫框架的嶄新視角。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：fresh perspective (嶄新視角) 或 fresh food (生鮮食物)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the unexpected shipping delay caused by harsh winter blizzards.
example.zh: 對於嚴酷冬季暴風雪所造成的意外出貨延誤，我們由衷深表歉意。

words.mnemonic: 多益機場與出貨最高頻考點：flight delay (班機延誤)、shipping delay (運送延誤)。

example.en: All factory production employees must attend the mandatory annual workplace safety seminar.
example.zh: 所有工廠產線員工均必須參加每年一次的強制性職場工安研習營。

words.mnemonic: 工安規定必備：safety regulations (安全法規)、safety equipment (防護安全裝備)。

example.en: The chief systems engineer presented innovative architectural plans for the data center.
example.zh: 首席系統工程師提出了針對雲端數據中心的創新架構規劃設計圖。

words.mnemonic: engine (引擎、機器) + -eer (從業專業人士) ＝ 工程師 (software engineer)。

example.en: The hotel concierge provided rooms situated along a quiet corridor overlooking the courtyard.
example.zh: 飯店禮賓部為房客安排了位於安靜走廊且俯瞰中庭花園的靜謐客房。

words.mnemonic: 住宿與辦公環境需求：quiet room (安靜客房)、quiet area (靜音區)。

example.en: Freight shipping costs include comprehensive maritime cargo loss and damage insurance.
example.zh: 貨運運費內已涵蓋了全面的海運貨物遺失及損害賠償保險保障。

words.mnemonic: in- (進入) + sure (確定、安全) + -ance ＝ 確保萬全的保障機制 ＝ 保險。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness clinic is staffed by certified occupational health nurses.
example.zh: 企業員工健康照護中心由具備執照的專業職業衛生護理師駐診服務。

words.mnemonic: 員工健康中心駐點：occupational nurse (職業衛生護理師)。

example.en: The training seminar facilitator will divide attendees into small collaborative workshop groups.
example.zh: 研討培訓引導講師將把與會者分成數個協同合作的工作坊討論小組。

words.mnemonic: di- (分開) + vid (分開、看) ＝ 劃分 (divide into)。

example.en: The length of each keynote presentation will be strictly limited to twenty-five minutes.
example.zh: 每場主題演講的長度時間將被嚴格限制在二十五分鐘以內。

words.mnemonic: long (長的) 的名詞形式；成語 at length (詳細地、長篇大論)。

example.en: Safety regulators launched an investigation into the electrical equipment factory failure.
example.zh: 工安監理主管機關針對該工廠電氣設備故障意外展開了正式調查。

words.mnemonic: in- (進入) + vestig (足跡、痕跡) + -ation ＝ 順著痕跡追查到底 ＝ 調查。

example.en: The logistics carrier sent a tracking notification when the package left the warehouse.
example.zh: 當包裹離開物流倉儲發貨中心時，貨運物流業者發送了物流追蹤通知。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：寄送包裹 (parcel/package) 或薪酬福利套裝 (compensation package)。

example.en: Total expenditures for the branch office renovation are estimated somewhere around eighty thousand dollars.
example.zh: 分行辦公室重新整修的總預算支出估計大約在八萬美元上下。

words.mnemonic: 數額約計片語：somewhere around / between (大約在...左右)。

example.en: The retail chain plans to expand its presence by opening twenty new franchise outlets.
example.zh: 該連鎖零售集團計劃透過開設二十家全新加盟門市來拓展其市場版圖。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + pand (展開) ＝ 向外鋪展開來 ＝ 業務擴張 (expand business/presence)。

example.en: The board resolved to commit substantial financial resources to clean energy development.
example.zh: 董事會決議投入巨額資金財務資源以支持潔淨能源的技術研發。

words.mnemonic: com- (共同) + mit (送出、託付) ＝ 全力託付承諾 ＝ commit to (致力於)。

example.en: It is obvious that investing in employee training yields superior long-term productivity.
example.zh: 顯而易見的是，投資於員工培訓進修能帶來卓越亮眼的長期生產力回報。

words.mnemonic: ob- (在前方) + vi (道路) + -ous ＝ 擺在路正前方的 ＝ 顯而易見的。

example.en: Retail sales revenue jumped by twenty percent following the launch of the promotional campaign.
example.zh: 促銷活動正式推行發表之後，零售銷售營收暴漲攀升了百分之二十。

words.mnemonic: 多益財經圖表常見動詞：sales jumped (銷售跳躍式激增)。

meaning: 秘密武器(行銷/競爭手段)

example.en: Advanced data analytics is our firm's most potent competitive weapon in digital marketing.
example.zh: 先進的巨量數據分析是我們公司在數位行銷競爭中最有力的利器秘密武器。

words.mnemonic: 商業競爭引申義：competitive weapon (市場競爭利器)。

example.en: Our new cloud-based software subscription remains relatively inexpensive compared to rivals.
example.zh: 與同業競爭對手相較，我們這套新型雲端軟體訂閱方案依然維持相對便宜實惠。

words.mnemonic: relative (相對的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 相較之下 (relatively inexpensive)。

example.en: Our downtown corporate convention hotel will host the upcoming international trade summit.
example.zh: 我們位於市中心的商務會議大飯店將主辦即將到來的國際貿易高峰會。

words.mnemonic: 商務會展必備核心動詞：host an event / conference (主辦活動/大會)。

example.en: The alpine ski resort experiences its peak tourism booking occupancy during the winter season.
example.zh: 這間高山滑雪度假村在冬季期間迎來了其全年度旅遊預訂住房率的最高峰。

words.mnemonic: 排程與季報考點：winter recess (寒假休假)、winter season (冬季旅遊季)。

example.en: Our international consulting headquarters is strategically situated in the central financial district.
example.zh: 我們的跨國管理顧問總部策略性地座落於市中心的中央金融商務特區。

words.mnemonic: 商辦地段描述核心：financial district (金融特區)、business district (商務特區)。
roots: string- / strict- 拉緊、限制區域

example.en: Our expanded product portfolio appeals to a broad range of international retail customers.
example.zh: 我們擴大推出的產品系列組合能吸引廣泛多元的國際零售消費者群體。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業極常見搭配：broad range of (廣泛的...)、broad appeal (廣泛的吸引力)。

example.en: Corporate logistics delivery fleet vehicles undergo mandatory monthly tire pressure inspections.
example.zh: 企業物流運送車隊的所有車輛均必須接受每月定期的強制性胎壓安全檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 車隊保養與物流必備：tire pressure (胎壓)、spare tire (備胎)。

example.en: Our fashion retail brand will unveil its new spring clothing collection at next week's expo.
example.zh: 我們的時尚服飾品牌將在下週的博覽會上正式發表其全新春季服裝系列產品。

words.mnemonic: 季節促銷常見：spring collection (春季系列)、spring break (春假特惠)。

example.en: The corporate employee retreat successfully fostered a cooperative team spirit among departments.
example.zh: 這場企業員工共識營成功促進了各部門之間通力合作的團隊合作精神。

words.mnemonic: 職場考核特質：team spirit (團隊精神)；in the spirit of (秉持著...的宗旨精神)。

example.en: A complimentary buffet lunch will be provided to all registered trade conference attendees.
example.zh: 所有完成大會報到的商務代表均將獲招待享用免費的精緻自助午餐。

words.mnemonic: 會議日程表必見項目：lunch break (午餐休息)、business lunch (商務午餐)。

example.en: Actual project production expenditures closely matched our initial preliminary quarterly budget.
example.zh: 專案實際的生產支出花費與我們原先初步編列的季度預算十分高度吻合。

words.mnemonic: 財務對比極高頻：actual vs projected (實際數值對照預估數值)。

example.en: Our international recruitment drive attracted an exceptionally talented applicant pool.
example.zh: 我們的跨國人才招募活動吸引了素質極其優異頂尖的龐大求職人才庫。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：applicant pool / talent pool (應徵人才庫) 或 carpool (共乘制度)。

example.en: Streaming platforms are engaged in a fierce market battle for exclusive digital sports rights.
example.zh: 各大線上影音串流平台正展開激烈的市場商戰，爭奪體育賽事的獨家數位轉播權。

words.mnemonic: 商業競爭比喻：legal battle (訴訟大戰)、market battle (市佔率爭奪戰)。

example.en: In keeping with company tradition, the annual bonus announcements were made before the holidays.
example.zh: 依照公司的優良優勢傳統慣例，年終獎金的名額公布均在假期來臨前底定發布。

words.mnemonic: tra- (跨越、交付) + dit (給予) + -ion ＝ 代代相傳之事 ＝ 傳統慣例。

example.en: Retail customers who pay in cash are eligible for an immediate five percent store discount.
example.zh: 使用現金付款的零售門市顧客，即可享有立折百分之五的即時門市優惠。

words.mnemonic: 多益財務高頻：cash flow (現金流)、cash on delivery (貨到付款 COD)。

example.en: There was hardly any difference between the two competing supplier bids in terms of price.
example.zh: 在價格報價方面，這兩家競標供應商的競標條件之間幾乎沒有任何顯著差異。

words.mnemonic: 否定副詞，多益倒裝句或文法考點：hardly any (幾乎沒有任何...)。

example.en: The municipal authority officially awarded the subway construction contract to our firm.
example.zh: 市政府主管當局已正式將該項地鐵工程興建合約授予頒標給我們公司。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重核心義：award ceremony (頒獎典禮) 或 award a contract (授予合約)。

example.en: Corporate travel policies require all non-executive personnel to book flight coach class.
example.zh: 企業差旅報銷政策規定，所有非高階主管同仁出差均必須預訂機票經濟艙。

words.mnemonic: 機票艙等必考：coach class (經濟艙)；人資 executive coach (企業高階主管教練)。

example.en: The advertising team will experiment with personalized mobile app marketing notifications.
example.zh: 廣告行銷團隊將嘗試採用個人化手機應用程式推播通知進行行銷試驗。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + peri (嘗試、經歷) + -ment ＝ 實地嘗試 ＝ 實驗、嘗試新策略。

example.en: Environmental impact sustainability was a primary consideration during factory site selection.
example.zh: 在工廠新廠址選址過程中，環境影響與永續性是一項最首要的考量因素。

words.mnemonic: 片語：take into consideration (將...納入考慮)；under consideration (正在研議中)。

example.en: The plant operator halted the conveyor belt after noticing a strange clicking sound.
example.zh: 廠區作業員在注意到輸送帶發出異常的喀噠異音之後，立即將其緊急停機。

words.mnemonic: 設備異常回報常見：strange noise (異常噪音)、strange smell (異常氣味)。

example.en: All employees must review and sign the corporate ethical code of conduct annually.
example.zh: 全體同仁每年均必須仔細研讀並簽名同意遵守企業商業道德行為守則。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：code of conduct (行為守則) 或 promo code (促銷優惠代碼)。

meaning: 無論如何(用於加強語氣)

example.en: We will deliver the replacement equipment parts as quickly as humanly and possibly can.
example.zh: 我們將在人力所能及的前提下，以最快的速度將替換設備零件送達。

words.mnemonic: possible (可能的) + -ly (副詞尾)；as soon as possibly can。

example.en: Phishing emails and ransomware pose a severe cybersecurity threat to corporate financial databases.
example.zh: 網路釣魚信件與勒索軟體對企業金融資料庫構成了嚴峻的網路資安威脅。

words.mnemonic: 資安與商務競爭必備：cyber threat (資安威脅)、pose a threat to (對...構成威脅)。

example.en: The manufacturing plant celebrated one thousand consecutive work days without a lost-time accident.
example.zh: 該製造廠隆重慶祝了創下連續一千個工作天無人員工時損失之工安事故紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 工安常用搭配：workplace accident (職場工安意外)、by accident (偶然、意外地)。

example.en: Without additional temporary staff, completing the audit by Friday will be nearly impossible.
example.zh: 如果沒有額外增派臨時支援人力，要在本週五前完成這項審計作業將幾乎是不可能的。

words.mnemonic: im- (不) + possible (可能的) ＝ 辦不到的 (nearly impossible)。

example.en: Online sales increased the revenue.
example.zh: 公司本會計年度的總營業收入成長兩成。

words.mnemonic: 企業總收入。
roots: ven 來 → 回來的收入

example.en: Automated cloud enterprise software enables global distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly in real time.
example.zh: 自動化雲端企業軟體使全球各地的分散式團隊能夠即時流暢地進行協同合作。

words.mnemonic: en- (使...) + able (能夠) ＝ 使之具備能力 ＝ enable someone to do。

example.en: I am afraid that today's express courier pickup cutoff time has already passed.
example.zh: 恐怕今天的快遞專件截單收件時間已經截止過去了。

words.mnemonic: 客服禮貌委婉告知壞消息極高頻句型：I am afraid that... (我恐怕.../很抱歉...)。

example.en: Our mobile application has surpassed ten million monthly active consumer users.
example.zh: 我們的手機應用程式每月活躍消費者用戶數已正式突破一千萬大關。

words.mnemonic: 網路行銷與人資考核核心指標：active users (活躍用戶)、take an active role (積極參與)。

example.en: Representatives from both multinational corporations hope to conclude negotiations by tomorrow afternoon.
example.zh: 兩家跨國企業的商務協商代表均期盼能在明天下午前順利圓滿締結談判合約。

words.mnemonic: con- (完全) + clud (關閉) ＝ 完全收尾定案 ＝ 締結合約 (conclude an agreement)。

example.en: The corporate catering menu accommodates specific dietary preferences based on medical or religious reasons.
example.zh: 企業宴會餐飲菜單可充分配合基於醫療考量或宗教信仰的特定飲食偏好需求。

words.mnemonic: 飯店款待與餐飲需求必考情境：religious reasons (宗教因素飲食習慣)。

example.en: The executive employee healthcare plan covers comprehensive annual preventative cancer screenings.
example.zh: 這套高階員工醫療照護保障計畫涵蓋了每年一次的全方位預防性癌症篩檢檢查。

words.mnemonic: 員工健檢福利考點：cancer screening (癌症篩檢)、cancer treatment。

example.en: The sales director presented compelling market data to convince clients of our product reliability.
example.zh: 業務總監提出了極具說服力的市場數據，以使客戶完全信服我們產品的卓越可靠度。

words.mnemonic: con- (完全) + vinc (征服、戰勝) ＝ 在心理上徹底折服對方 ＝ 說服 (convince of)。

example.en: Freight delivery transit delivery times may vary significantly depending on international customs clearance.
example.zh: 貨運運送所需的抵達時間可能會因各國海關清關速度不同而有大幅差異。

words.mnemonic: 多益產品與服務條款極核心句型：vary depending on (隨...而有所變動)。

example.en: Our modern factory plant complies strictly with international ISO environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 我們的新式廠房完全嚴格遵守國際 ISO 環境保護安全認證標準。

words.mnemonic: ESG 與企業責任核心：environmental protection (環境保護)、environmental impact。

example.en: The corporate headquarters installed rooftop solar panels to harness energy from the sun.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓屋頂加裝了太陽能板，以充分汲取來自太陽光的再生能源。

words.mnemonic: 綠能發電常考：solar power (太陽能發電)；sun deck (日照甲板/泳池露台)。

example.en: Despite global inflation pressures, our enterprise maintains a very healthy financial balance sheet.
example.zh: 儘管面臨全球通膨壓力，我們企業依然維持著非常健全穩健的財務資產負債表。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：healthy lifestyle (健康生活) 或 healthy profit (健全豐厚的利潤)。

example.en: The unexpected cancellation of the municipal contract dealt a severe financial blow to the builder.
example.zh: 市政合約的意外遭到取消，對該工程建商造成了極其沉重的財務打擊。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業財經常見搭配：deal a severe blow to (對...造成嚴重沉重打擊)。

example.en: The store sells a large volume of goods.
example.zh: 本季度的出口貨物總量創下歷史新高。

words.mnemonic: 大量或音量。

example.en: The new office is in a convenient location.
example.zh: 新旗艦店的地理位置鄰近市中心主要捷運站。

words.mnemonic: 場所的位置。

example.en: The technology venture plans to invest twenty million dollars into artificial intelligence software research.
example.zh: 該科技創投公司計劃挹注投資兩千萬美元於人工智慧軟體的研發上。

words.mnemonic: in- (進入) + vest (穿上衣服、賦予職務) ＝ 資金投入進去 ＝ invest in (投資於)。

example.en: Passengers holding valid boarding passes should proceed immediately to gate forty-five.
example.zh: 持有有效登機證的旅客請立即前往四十五號登機門候機。

words.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + ceed (走) ＝ 向前行進 ＝ proceed with (繼續辦理)；proceeds (活動收益款)。

example.en: Hotel housekeeping staff wash all bed linens and bath towels using high-temperature sanitation cycles.
example.zh: 飯店房務人員使用高溫消毒程序清洗所有床單被套與浴巾。

words.mnemonic: 房務與清潔規定：wash and iron (洗熨服務)、car wash (洗車)。

example.en: Our marketing advertising firm hired an acclaimed television actor for the commercial campaign.
example.zh: 我們的廣告行銷公司聘請了一位備受讚譽的電視演員來為這場宣傳活動代言拍攝。

words.mnemonic: act (行動、表演) + -or (人) ＝ 廣告演員 (commercial actor)。

example.en: We are glad to inform you that your application for commercial credit financing has been approved.
example.zh: 我們非常高興且榮幸地通知您，您所申請的商業信用融資案已獲正式核准。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信常見禮貌開頭句型：We are glad to inform you that... (我們很高興通知您...)。

example.en: Warehouse dispatch staff use heavy-duty packaging tape to seal outbound cargo boxes securely.
example.zh: 倉儲出貨人員使用高強度的包裝專用膠帶將出境貨物紙箱妥善封緊。

words.mnemonic: 辦公耗材與物流包裝：packaging tape (包裝膠帶)、tape measure (捲尺)。

meaning: 鑒於(法律合約開頭前言)

example.en: Sales in North America increased by eight percent, whereas European branch revenues remained flat.
example.zh: 北美市場的銷售額成長了百分之八，反之歐洲分公司的營收則維持持平。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀與合約必考對比連接詞：whereas = while (然而、反之)。

example.en: The corporate convention center is conveniently situated directly opposite the main metro station.
example.zh: 這座商務會議展覽中心位置便利，就正正座落於中央捷運火車站的斜對面。

words.mnemonic: op- (相反、朝向) + posit (放置) ＝ 放在正對面的 ＝ directly opposite (正對面)。

example.en: Achieving profitability this fiscal quarter represents a major milestone for our software startup.
example.zh: 在本會計季度實現轉虧為盈，對我們的軟體新創公司而言是一座重大的里程碑。

words.mnemonic: 專案進度管理核心字彙：milestone (專案里程碑重要階段)。

example.en: The company invested a substantial sum of money into developing autonomous delivery vehicle prototypes.
example.zh: 該公司投入了一筆可觀的巨額資金，用於研發自動駕駛物流車的原型車輛。

words.mnemonic: 財務必備：lump sum (一次性整筆支付金額)、sum up (總結會議要點)。

example.en: Rush-hour highway traffic during the evening downtown commute can be absolute murder.
example.zh: 在晚間市中心通勤的交通尖峰時段，高速公路塞車簡直讓人痛苦難耐折騰萬分。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力日常誇飾用語：Rush-hour traffic is murder (尖峰塞車簡直是折磨)。

meaning: 電腦螢幕/監控儀器(名詞)

example.en: Quality control software engineers continuously monitor server performance to prevent outages.
example.zh: 品管軟體工程師隨時持續監控伺服器主機效能，以防止系統意外當機停擺。

words.mnemonic: monit- (警告、提醒) + -or ＝ 提醒注意狀態的人或儀器 ＝ 監視、電腦螢幕。

example.en: Despite severe logistical disruptions, the warehouse distribution team decided to soldier on.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的物流配送中斷阻礙，倉儲發貨團隊依然決定堅定奮戰克服困難。

words.mnemonic: 商業職場勵志片語：soldier on (不屈不撓堅定奮戰前行)。

example.en: The corporate commercial bank agreed to finance the construction of the new production plant.
example.zh: 該企業商業銀行同意為這座全新工廠的興建工程提供融資借貸資金支援。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業核心：finance department (財務部)、financial statement (財務報表)。

example.en: I hate to bother you during your annual leave, but we urgently need your client file password.
example.zh: 我實在很不願意在您的年休假期期間打擾您，但我們緊急需要您負責的客戶檔案密碼。

words.mnemonic: 職場客套委婉用語：I hate to bother you, but... (很過意不去打擾您，但是...)。

example.en: Our main objective is to reduce costs.
example.zh: 行銷部門本季度的首要目標是提升品牌知名度。

words.mnemonic: objective = goal。

example.en: The bank opened a new branch.
example.zh: 該銀行將於下個月在西區開設新分行。

words.mnemonic: 公司或銀行的分支。

example.en: The room has a capacity of 80 people.
example.zh: 宴會大廳最多可容納四百名賓客入席。

words.mnemonic: 可容納的人數。

example.en: All drivers must follow traffic regulations.
example.zh: 所有實驗室作業皆必須符合政府環保規章。

words.mnemonic: 正式規則。

example.en: The company plans to hire two assistants.
example.zh: 公司計畫於第四季度招募五名軟體工程師。

words.mnemonic: hire new staff。

example.en: Travel expenses will be reimbursed.
example.zh: 出差員工請在差旅結束後檢據申請差旅費核銷。

words.mnemonic: 常和 pay 或 cost 一起出現。
roots: pens 秤、花費 → 付出去

example.en: Analysts predict that sales will rise next quarter.
example.zh: 分析師預測下一季銷售額將上升。

words.mnemonic: pre-（預先）+ dict（說）＝事先說出來。

example.en: The product comes with a one-year guarantee.
example.zh: 所有電器設備皆附帶為期一年的品質保固。

words.mnemonic: 保證品質或結果。

example.en: Customers receive a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 凡大量訂購辦公文具者均可享有批量折扣。

words.mnemonic: 讓價格往下掉。

example.en: Read the instructions before use.
